<div class="line"><a name="l01087"></a><span class="lineno"> 1087</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      Undo processing</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01088"></a><span class="lineno"> 1088</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01089"></a><span class="lineno"> 1089</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// @OPTIMIZE: the undo/redo buffer should be circular</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01090"></a><span class="lineno"> 1090</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01091"></a><span class="lineno"> 1091</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stb_textedit_flush_redo(<a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_state.html">StbUndoState</a> *state)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01092"></a><span class="lineno"> 1092</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01093"></a><span class="lineno"> 1093</span>&#160;   state-&gt;redo_point = STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01094"></a><span class="lineno"> 1094</span>&#160;   state-&gt;redo_char_point = STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01095"></a><span class="lineno"> 1095</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01096"></a><span class="lineno"> 1096</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01097"></a><span class="lineno"> 1097</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// discard the oldest entry in the undo list</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01098"></a><span class="lineno"> 1098</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stb_textedit_discard_undo(<a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_state.html">StbUndoState</a> *state)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01099"></a><span class="lineno"> 1099</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01100"></a><span class="lineno"> 1100</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (state-&gt;undo_point &gt; 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01101"></a><span class="lineno"> 1101</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// if the 0th undo state has characters, clean those up</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01102"></a><span class="lineno"> 1102</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (state-&gt;undo_rec[0].char_storage &gt;= 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01103"></a><span class="lineno"> 1103</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n = state-&gt;undo_rec[0].insert_length, i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01104"></a><span class="lineno"> 1104</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// delete n characters from all other records</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01105"></a><span class="lineno"> 1105</span>&#160;         state-&gt;undo_char_point -= n;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01106"></a><span class="lineno"> 1106</span>&#160;         STB_TEXTEDIT_memmove(state-&gt;undo_char, state-&gt;undo_char + n, (<span class="keywordtype">size_t</span>) (state-&gt;undo_char_point*<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(STB_TEXTEDIT_CHARTYPE)));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01107"></a><span class="lineno"> 1107</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; state-&gt;undo_point; ++i)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01108"></a><span class="lineno"> 1108</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (state-&gt;undo_rec[i].char_storage &gt;= 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01109"></a><span class="lineno"> 1109</span>&#160;               state-&gt;undo_rec[i].char_storage -= n; <span class="comment">// @OPTIMIZE: get rid of char_storage and infer it</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01110"></a><span class="lineno"> 1110</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01111"></a><span class="lineno"> 1111</span>&#160;      --state-&gt;undo_point;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01112"></a><span class="lineno"> 1112</span>&#160;      STB_TEXTEDIT_memmove(state-&gt;undo_rec, state-&gt;undo_rec+1, (<span class="keywordtype">size_t</span>) (state-&gt;undo_point*<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(state-&gt;undo_rec[0])));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01113"></a><span class="lineno"> 1113</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01114"></a><span class="lineno"> 1114</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01115"></a><span class="lineno"> 1115</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01116"></a><span class="lineno"> 1116</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// discard the oldest entry in the redo list--it&#39;s bad if this</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01117"></a><span class="lineno"> 1117</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// ever happens, but because undo &amp; redo have to store the actual</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01118"></a><span class="lineno"> 1118</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// characters in different cases, the redo character buffer can</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01119"></a><span class="lineno"> 1119</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// fill up even though the undo buffer didn&#39;t</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01120"></a><span class="lineno"> 1120</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stb_textedit_discard_redo(<a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_state.html">StbUndoState</a> *state)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01121"></a><span class="lineno"> 1121</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01122"></a><span class="lineno"> 1122</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> k = STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT-1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01123"></a><span class="lineno"> 1123</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01124"></a><span class="lineno"> 1124</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (state-&gt;redo_point &lt;= k) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01125"></a><span class="lineno"> 1125</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// if the k&#39;th undo state has characters, clean those up</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01126"></a><span class="lineno"> 1126</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (state-&gt;undo_rec[k].char_storage &gt;= 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01127"></a><span class="lineno"> 1127</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n = state-&gt;undo_rec[k].insert_length, i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01128"></a><span class="lineno"> 1128</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// move the remaining redo character data to the end of the buffer</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01129"></a><span class="lineno"> 1129</span>&#160;         state-&gt;redo_char_point += n;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01130"></a><span class="lineno"> 1130</span>&#160;         STB_TEXTEDIT_memmove(state-&gt;undo_char + state-&gt;redo_char_point, state-&gt;undo_char + state-&gt;redo_char_point-n, (<span class="keywordtype">size_t</span>) ((STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT - state-&gt;redo_char_point)*<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(STB_TEXTEDIT_CHARTYPE)));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01131"></a><span class="lineno"> 1131</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// adjust the position of all the other records to account for above memmove</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01132"></a><span class="lineno"> 1132</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=state-&gt;redo_point; i &lt; k; ++i)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01133"></a><span class="lineno"> 1133</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (state-&gt;undo_rec[i].char_storage &gt;= 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01134"></a><span class="lineno"> 1134</span>&#160;               state-&gt;undo_rec[i].char_storage += n;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01135"></a><span class="lineno"> 1135</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01136"></a><span class="lineno"> 1136</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// now move all the redo records towards the end of the buffer; the first one is at &#39;redo_point&#39;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01137"></a><span class="lineno"> 1137</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// {DEAR IMGUI]</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01138"></a><span class="lineno"> 1138</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">size_t</span> move_size = (size_t)((STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT - state-&gt;redo_point - 1) * <span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(state-&gt;undo_rec[0]));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01139"></a><span class="lineno"> 1139</span>&#160;      <span class="keyword">const</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span>* buf_begin = (<span class="keywordtype">char</span>*)state-&gt;undo_rec; (<span class="keywordtype">void</span>)buf_begin;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01140"></a><span class="lineno"> 1140</span>&#160;      <span class="keyword">const</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span>* buf_end   = (<span class="keywordtype">char</span>*)state-&gt;undo_rec + <span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(state-&gt;undo_rec); (void)buf_end;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01141"></a><span class="lineno"> 1141</span>&#160;      IM_ASSERT(((<span class="keywordtype">char</span>*)(state-&gt;undo_rec + state-&gt;redo_point)) &gt;= buf_begin);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01142"></a><span class="lineno"> 1142</span>&#160;      IM_ASSERT(((<span class="keywordtype">char</span>*)(state-&gt;undo_rec + state-&gt;redo_point + 1) + move_size) &lt;= buf_end);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01143"></a><span class="lineno"> 1143</span>&#160;      STB_TEXTEDIT_memmove(state-&gt;undo_rec + state-&gt;redo_point+1, state-&gt;undo_rec + state-&gt;redo_point, move_size);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01144"></a><span class="lineno"> 1144</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01145"></a><span class="lineno"> 1145</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// now move redo_point to point to the new one</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01146"></a><span class="lineno"> 1146</span>&#160;      ++state-&gt;redo_point;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01147"></a><span class="lineno"> 1147</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01148"></a><span class="lineno"> 1148</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01149"></a><span class="lineno"> 1149</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01150"></a><span class="lineno"> 1150</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_record.html">StbUndoRecord</a> *stb_text_create_undo_record(<a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_state.html">StbUndoState</a> *state, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> numchars)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01151"></a><span class="lineno"> 1151</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01152"></a><span class="lineno"> 1152</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// any time we create a new undo record, we discard redo</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01153"></a><span class="lineno"> 1153</span>&#160;   stb_textedit_flush_redo(state);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01154"></a><span class="lineno"> 1154</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01155"></a><span class="lineno"> 1155</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// if we have no free records, we have to make room, by sliding the</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01156"></a><span class="lineno"> 1156</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// existing records down</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01157"></a><span class="lineno"> 1157</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (state-&gt;undo_point == STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01158"></a><span class="lineno"> 1158</span>&#160;      stb_textedit_discard_undo(state);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01159"></a><span class="lineno"> 1159</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01160"></a><span class="lineno"> 1160</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// if the characters to store won&#39;t possibly fit in the buffer, we can&#39;t undo</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01161"></a><span class="lineno"> 1161</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (numchars &gt; STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01162"></a><span class="lineno"> 1162</span>&#160;      state-&gt;undo_point = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01163"></a><span class="lineno"> 1163</span>&#160;      state-&gt;undo_char_point = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01164"></a><span class="lineno"> 1164</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01165"></a><span class="lineno"> 1165</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01166"></a><span class="lineno"> 1166</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01167"></a><span class="lineno"> 1167</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// if we don&#39;t have enough free characters in the buffer, we have to make room</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01168"></a><span class="lineno"> 1168</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (state-&gt;undo_char_point + numchars &gt; STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01169"></a><span class="lineno"> 1169</span>&#160;      stb_textedit_discard_undo(state);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01170"></a><span class="lineno"> 1170</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01171"></a><span class="lineno"> 1171</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> &amp;state-&gt;undo_rec[state-&gt;undo_point++];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01172"></a><span class="lineno"> 1172</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01173"></a><span class="lineno"> 1173</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01174"></a><span class="lineno"> 1174</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> STB_TEXTEDIT_CHARTYPE *stb_text_createundo(<a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_state.html">StbUndoState</a> *state, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> pos, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> insert_len, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> delete_len)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01175"></a><span class="lineno"> 1175</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01176"></a><span class="lineno"> 1176</span>&#160;   <a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_record.html">StbUndoRecord</a> *r = stb_text_create_undo_record(state, insert_len);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01177"></a><span class="lineno"> 1177</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (r == NULL)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01178"></a><span class="lineno"> 1178</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01179"></a><span class="lineno"> 1179</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01180"></a><span class="lineno"> 1180</span>&#160;   r-&gt;where = pos;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01181"></a><span class="lineno"> 1181</span>&#160;   r-&gt;insert_length = (STB_TEXTEDIT_POSITIONTYPE) insert_len;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01182"></a><span class="lineno"> 1182</span>&#160;   r-&gt;delete_length = (STB_TEXTEDIT_POSITIONTYPE) delete_len;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01183"></a><span class="lineno"> 1183</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01184"></a><span class="lineno"> 1184</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (insert_len == 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01185"></a><span class="lineno"> 1185</span>&#160;      r-&gt;char_storage = -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01186"></a><span class="lineno"> 1186</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01187"></a><span class="lineno"> 1187</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01188"></a><span class="lineno"> 1188</span>&#160;      r-&gt;char_storage = state-&gt;undo_char_point;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01189"></a><span class="lineno"> 1189</span>&#160;      state-&gt;undo_char_point += insert_len;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01190"></a><span class="lineno"> 1190</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> &amp;state-&gt;undo_char[r-&gt;char_storage];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01191"></a><span class="lineno"> 1191</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01192"></a><span class="lineno"> 1192</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01193"></a><span class="lineno"> 1193</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01194"></a><span class="lineno"> 1194</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stb_text_undo(STB_TEXTEDIT_STRING *str, <a class="code" href="struct_s_t_b___textedit_state.html">STB_TexteditState</a> *state)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01195"></a><span class="lineno"> 1195</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01196"></a><span class="lineno"> 1196</span>&#160;   <a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_state.html">StbUndoState</a> *s = &amp;state-&gt;undostate;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01197"></a><span class="lineno"> 1197</span>&#160;   <a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_record.html">StbUndoRecord</a> u, *r;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01198"></a><span class="lineno"> 1198</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s-&gt;undo_point == 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01199"></a><span class="lineno"> 1199</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01200"></a><span class="lineno"> 1200</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01201"></a><span class="lineno"> 1201</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// we need to do two things: apply the undo record, and create a redo record</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01202"></a><span class="lineno"> 1202</span>&#160;   u = s-&gt;undo_rec[s-&gt;undo_point-1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01203"></a><span class="lineno"> 1203</span>&#160;   r = &amp;s-&gt;undo_rec[s-&gt;redo_point-1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01204"></a><span class="lineno"> 1204</span>&#160;   r-&gt;char_storage = -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01205"></a><span class="lineno"> 1205</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01206"></a><span class="lineno"> 1206</span>&#160;   r-&gt;insert_length = u.delete_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01207"></a><span class="lineno"> 1207</span>&#160;   r-&gt;delete_length = u.insert_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01208"></a><span class="lineno"> 1208</span>&#160;   r-&gt;where = u.where;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01209"></a><span class="lineno"> 1209</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01210"></a><span class="lineno"> 1210</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (u.delete_length) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01211"></a><span class="lineno"> 1211</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// if the undo record says to delete characters, then the redo record will</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01212"></a><span class="lineno"> 1212</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// need to re-insert the characters that get deleted, so we need to store</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01213"></a><span class="lineno"> 1213</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// them.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01214"></a><span class="lineno"> 1214</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01215"></a><span class="lineno"> 1215</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// there are three cases:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01216"></a><span class="lineno"> 1216</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">//    there&#39;s enough room to store the characters</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01217"></a><span class="lineno"> 1217</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">//    characters stored for *redoing* don&#39;t leave room for redo</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01218"></a><span class="lineno"> 1218</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">//    characters stored for *undoing* don&#39;t leave room for redo</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01219"></a><span class="lineno"> 1219</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// if the last is true, we have to bail</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01220"></a><span class="lineno"> 1220</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01221"></a><span class="lineno"> 1221</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s-&gt;undo_char_point + u.delete_length &gt;= STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01222"></a><span class="lineno"> 1222</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// the undo records take up too much character space; there&#39;s no space to store the redo characters</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01223"></a><span class="lineno"> 1223</span>&#160;         r-&gt;insert_length = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01224"></a><span class="lineno"> 1224</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01225"></a><span class="lineno"> 1225</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01226"></a><span class="lineno"> 1226</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01227"></a><span class="lineno"> 1227</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// there&#39;s definitely room to store the characters eventually</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01228"></a><span class="lineno"> 1228</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (s-&gt;undo_char_point + u.delete_length &gt; s-&gt;redo_char_point) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01229"></a><span class="lineno"> 1229</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// should never happen:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01230"></a><span class="lineno"> 1230</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s-&gt;redo_point == STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01231"></a><span class="lineno"> 1231</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">return</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01232"></a><span class="lineno"> 1232</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// there&#39;s currently not enough room, so discard a redo record</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01233"></a><span class="lineno"> 1233</span>&#160;            stb_textedit_discard_redo(s);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01234"></a><span class="lineno"> 1234</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01235"></a><span class="lineno"> 1235</span>&#160;         r = &amp;s-&gt;undo_rec[s-&gt;redo_point-1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01236"></a><span class="lineno"> 1236</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01237"></a><span class="lineno"> 1237</span>&#160;         r-&gt;char_storage = s-&gt;redo_char_point - u.delete_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01238"></a><span class="lineno"> 1238</span>&#160;         s-&gt;redo_char_point = s-&gt;redo_char_point - u.delete_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01239"></a><span class="lineno"> 1239</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01240"></a><span class="lineno"> 1240</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// now save the characters</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01241"></a><span class="lineno"> 1241</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; u.delete_length; ++i)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01242"></a><span class="lineno"> 1242</span>&#160;            s-&gt;undo_char[r-&gt;char_storage + i] = STB_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str, u.where + i);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01243"></a><span class="lineno"> 1243</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01244"></a><span class="lineno"> 1244</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01245"></a><span class="lineno"> 1245</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// now we can carry out the deletion</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01246"></a><span class="lineno"> 1246</span>&#160;      STB_TEXTEDIT_DELETECHARS(str, u.where, u.delete_length);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01247"></a><span class="lineno"> 1247</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01248"></a><span class="lineno"> 1248</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01249"></a><span class="lineno"> 1249</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// check type of recorded action:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01250"></a><span class="lineno"> 1250</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (u.insert_length) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01251"></a><span class="lineno"> 1251</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// easy case: was a deletion, so we need to insert n characters</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01252"></a><span class="lineno"> 1252</span>&#160;      STB_TEXTEDIT_INSERTCHARS(str, u.where, &amp;s-&gt;undo_char[u.char_storage], u.insert_length);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01253"></a><span class="lineno"> 1253</span>&#160;      s-&gt;undo_char_point -= u.insert_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01254"></a><span class="lineno"> 1254</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01255"></a><span class="lineno"> 1255</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01256"></a><span class="lineno"> 1256</span>&#160;   state-&gt;cursor = u.where + u.insert_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01257"></a><span class="lineno"> 1257</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01258"></a><span class="lineno"> 1258</span>&#160;   s-&gt;undo_point--;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01259"></a><span class="lineno"> 1259</span>&#160;   s-&gt;redo_point--;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01260"></a><span class="lineno"> 1260</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01261"></a><span class="lineno"> 1261</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01262"></a><span class="lineno"> 1262</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stb_text_redo(STB_TEXTEDIT_STRING *str, <a class="code" href="struct_s_t_b___textedit_state.html">STB_TexteditState</a> *state)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01263"></a><span class="lineno"> 1263</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01264"></a><span class="lineno"> 1264</span>&#160;   <a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_state.html">StbUndoState</a> *s = &amp;state-&gt;undostate;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01265"></a><span class="lineno"> 1265</span>&#160;   <a class="code" href="struct_stb_undo_record.html">StbUndoRecord</a> *u, r;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01266"></a><span class="lineno"> 1266</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s-&gt;redo_point == STB_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01267"></a><span class="lineno"> 1267</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01268"></a><span class="lineno"> 1268</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01269"></a><span class="lineno"> 1269</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// we need to do two things: apply the redo record, and create an undo record</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01270"></a><span class="lineno"> 1270</span>&#160;   u = &amp;s-&gt;undo_rec[s-&gt;undo_point];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01271"></a><span class="lineno"> 1271</span>&#160;   r = s-&gt;undo_rec[s-&gt;redo_point];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01272"></a><span class="lineno"> 1272</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01273"></a><span class="lineno"> 1273</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// we KNOW there must be room for the undo record, because the redo record</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01274"></a><span class="lineno"> 1274</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// was derived from an undo record</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01275"></a><span class="lineno"> 1275</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01276"></a><span class="lineno"> 1276</span>&#160;   u-&gt;delete_length = r.insert_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01277"></a><span class="lineno"> 1277</span>&#160;   u-&gt;insert_length = r.delete_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01278"></a><span class="lineno"> 1278</span>&#160;   u-&gt;where = r.where;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01279"></a><span class="lineno"> 1279</span>&#160;   u-&gt;char_storage = -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01280"></a><span class="lineno"> 1280</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01281"></a><span class="lineno"> 1281</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (r.delete_length) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01282"></a><span class="lineno"> 1282</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// the redo record requires us to delete characters, so the undo record</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01283"></a><span class="lineno"> 1283</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// needs to store the characters</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01284"></a><span class="lineno"> 1284</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01285"></a><span class="lineno"> 1285</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s-&gt;undo_char_point + u-&gt;insert_length &gt; s-&gt;redo_char_point) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01286"></a><span class="lineno"> 1286</span>&#160;         u-&gt;insert_length = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01287"></a><span class="lineno"> 1287</span>&#160;         u-&gt;delete_length = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01288"></a><span class="lineno"> 1288</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01289"></a><span class="lineno"> 1289</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01290"></a><span class="lineno"> 1290</span>&#160;         u-&gt;char_storage = s-&gt;undo_char_point;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01291"></a><span class="lineno"> 1291</span>&#160;         s-&gt;undo_char_point = s-&gt;undo_char_point + u-&gt;insert_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01292"></a><span class="lineno"> 1292</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01293"></a><span class="lineno"> 1293</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// now save the characters</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01294"></a><span class="lineno"> 1294</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; u-&gt;insert_length; ++i)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01295"></a><span class="lineno"> 1295</span>&#160;            s-&gt;undo_char[u-&gt;char_storage + i] = STB_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str, u-&gt;where + i);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01296"></a><span class="lineno"> 1296</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01297"></a><span class="lineno"> 1297</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01298"></a><span class="lineno"> 1298</span>&#160;      STB_TEXTEDIT_DELETECHARS(str, r.where, r.delete_length);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01299"></a><span class="lineno"> 1299</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01300"></a><span class="lineno"> 1300</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01301"></a><span class="lineno"> 1301</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (r.insert_length) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01302"></a><span class="lineno"> 1302</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// easy case: need to insert n characters</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01303"></a><span class="lineno"> 1303</span>&#160;      STB_TEXTEDIT_INSERTCHARS(str, r.where, &amp;s-&gt;undo_char[r.char_storage], r.insert_length);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01304"></a><span class="lineno"> 1304</span>&#160;      s-&gt;redo_char_point += r.insert_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01305"></a><span class="lineno"> 1305</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01306"></a><span class="lineno"> 1306</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01307"></a><span class="lineno"> 1307</span>&#160;   state-&gt;cursor = r.where + r.insert_length;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01308"></a><span class="lineno"> 1308</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01309"></a><span class="lineno"> 1309</span>&#160;   s-&gt;undo_point++;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01310"></a><span class="lineno"> 1310</span>&#160;   s-&gt;redo_point++;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01311"></a><span class="lineno"> 1311</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01312"></a><span class="lineno"> 1312</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01313"></a><span class="lineno"> 1313</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stb_text_makeundo_insert(<a class="code" href="struct_s_t_b___textedit_state.html">STB_TexteditState</a> *state, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> where, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> length)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01314"></a><span class="lineno"> 1314</span>&#160;{</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l00121"></a><span class="lineno">  121</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   Starting with version 1.06, the rasterizer was replaced with a new,</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00122"></a><span class="lineno">  122</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   faster and generally-more-precise rasterizer. The new rasterizer more</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00123"></a><span class="lineno">  123</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   accurately measures pixel coverage for anti-aliasing, except in the case</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00124"></a><span class="lineno">  124</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   where multiple shapes overlap, in which case it overestimates the AA pixel</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00125"></a><span class="lineno">  125</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   coverage. Thus, anti-aliasing of intersecting shapes may look wrong. If</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00126"></a><span class="lineno">  126</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   this turns out to be a problem, you can re-enable the old rasterizer with</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00127"></a><span class="lineno">  127</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        #define STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION 1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00128"></a><span class="lineno">  128</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   which will incur about a 15% speed hit.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00129"></a><span class="lineno">  129</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00130"></a><span class="lineno">  130</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTATION</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00131"></a><span class="lineno">  131</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00132"></a><span class="lineno">  132</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   Immediately after this block comment are a series of sample programs.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00133"></a><span class="lineno">  133</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00134"></a><span class="lineno">  134</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   After the sample programs is the &quot;header file&quot; section. This section</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00135"></a><span class="lineno">  135</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   includes documentation for each API function.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00136"></a><span class="lineno">  136</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00137"></a><span class="lineno">  137</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   Some important concepts to understand to use this library:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00138"></a><span class="lineno">  138</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00139"></a><span class="lineno">  139</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      Codepoint</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00140"></a><span class="lineno">  140</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         Characters are defined by unicode codepoints, e.g. 65 is</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00141"></a><span class="lineno">  141</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         uppercase A, 231 is lowercase c with a cedilla, 0x7e30 is</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00142"></a><span class="lineno">  142</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         the hiragana for &quot;ma&quot;.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00143"></a><span class="lineno">  143</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00144"></a><span class="lineno">  144</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      Glyph</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00145"></a><span class="lineno">  145</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         A visual character shape (every codepoint is rendered as</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00146"></a><span class="lineno">  146</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         some glyph)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00147"></a><span class="lineno">  147</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00148"></a><span class="lineno">  148</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      Glyph index</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00149"></a><span class="lineno">  149</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         A font-specific integer ID representing a glyph</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00150"></a><span class="lineno">  150</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00151"></a><span class="lineno">  151</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      Baseline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00152"></a><span class="lineno">  152</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         Glyph shapes are defined relative to a baseline, which is the</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00153"></a><span class="lineno">  153</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         bottom of uppercase characters. Characters extend both above</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00154"></a><span class="lineno">  154</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         and below the baseline.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00155"></a><span class="lineno">  155</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00156"></a><span class="lineno">  156</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      Current Point</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00157"></a><span class="lineno">  157</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         As you draw text to the screen, you keep track of a &quot;current point&quot;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00158"></a><span class="lineno">  158</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         which is the origin of each character. The current point&#39;s vertical</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00159"></a><span class="lineno">  159</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         position is the baseline. Even &quot;baked fonts&quot; use this model.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00160"></a><span class="lineno">  160</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00161"></a><span class="lineno">  161</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      Vertical Font Metrics</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00162"></a><span class="lineno">  162</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         The vertical qualities of the font, used to vertically position</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00163"></a><span class="lineno">  163</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         and space the characters. See docs for stbtt_GetFontVMetrics.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00164"></a><span class="lineno">  164</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00165"></a><span class="lineno">  165</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      Font Size in Pixels or Points</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00166"></a><span class="lineno">  166</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         The preferred interface for specifying font sizes in stb_truetype</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00167"></a><span class="lineno">  167</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         is to specify how tall the font&#39;s vertical extent should be in pixels.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00168"></a><span class="lineno">  168</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         If that sounds good enough, skip the next paragraph.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00169"></a><span class="lineno">  169</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00170"></a><span class="lineno">  170</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         Most font APIs instead use &quot;points&quot;, which are a common typographic</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00171"></a><span class="lineno">  171</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         measurement for describing font size, defined as 72 points per inch.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00172"></a><span class="lineno">  172</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         stb_truetype provides a point API for compatibility. However, true</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00173"></a><span class="lineno">  173</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         &quot;per inch&quot; conventions don&#39;t make much sense on computer displays</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00174"></a><span class="lineno">  174</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         since different monitors have different number of pixels per</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00175"></a><span class="lineno">  175</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         inch. For example, Windows traditionally uses a convention that</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00176"></a><span class="lineno">  176</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         there are 96 pixels per inch, thus making &#39;inch&#39; measurements have</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00177"></a><span class="lineno">  177</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         nothing to do with inches, and thus effectively defining a point to</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00178"></a><span class="lineno">  178</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         be 1.333 pixels. Additionally, the TrueType font data provides</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00179"></a><span class="lineno">  179</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         an explicit scale factor to scale a given font&#39;s glyphs to points,</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00180"></a><span class="lineno">  180</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         but the author has observed that this scale factor is often wrong</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00181"></a><span class="lineno">  181</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         for non-commercial fonts, thus making fonts scaled in points</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00182"></a><span class="lineno">  182</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//         according to the TrueType spec incoherently sized in practice.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00183"></a><span class="lineno">  183</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00184"></a><span class="lineno">  184</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// DETAILED USAGE:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00185"></a><span class="lineno">  185</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00186"></a><span class="lineno">  186</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//  Scale:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00187"></a><span class="lineno">  187</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    Select how high you want the font to be, in points or pixels.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00188"></a><span class="lineno">  188</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    Call ScaleForPixelHeight or ScaleForMappingEmToPixels to compute</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00189"></a><span class="lineno">  189</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    a scale factor SF that will be used by all other functions.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00190"></a><span class="lineno">  190</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00191"></a><span class="lineno">  191</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//  Baseline:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00192"></a><span class="lineno">  192</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    You need to select a y-coordinate that is the baseline of where</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00193"></a><span class="lineno">  193</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    your text will appear. Call GetFontBoundingBox to get the baseline-relative</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00194"></a><span class="lineno">  194</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    bounding box for all characters. SF*-y0 will be the distance in pixels</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00195"></a><span class="lineno">  195</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    that the worst-case character could extend above the baseline, so if</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00196"></a><span class="lineno">  196</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    you want the top edge of characters to appear at the top of the</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00197"></a><span class="lineno">  197</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    screen where y=0, then you would set the baseline to SF*-y0.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00198"></a><span class="lineno">  198</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00199"></a><span class="lineno">  199</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//  Current point:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00200"></a><span class="lineno">  200</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    Set the current point where the first character will appear. The</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00201"></a><span class="lineno">  201</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    first character could extend left of the current point; this is font</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00202"></a><span class="lineno">  202</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    dependent. You can either choose a current point that is the leftmost</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00203"></a><span class="lineno">  203</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    point and hope, or add some padding, or check the bounding box or</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00204"></a><span class="lineno">  204</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    left-side-bearing of the first character to be displayed and set</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00205"></a><span class="lineno">  205</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    the current point based on that.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00206"></a><span class="lineno">  206</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00207"></a><span class="lineno">  207</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//  Displaying a character:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00208"></a><span class="lineno">  208</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    Compute the bounding box of the character. It will contain signed values</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00209"></a><span class="lineno">  209</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    relative to &lt;current_point, baseline&gt;. I.e. if it returns x0,y0,x1,y1,</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00210"></a><span class="lineno">  210</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    then the character should be displayed in the rectangle from</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00211"></a><span class="lineno">  211</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    &lt;current_point+SF*x0, baseline+SF*y0&gt; to &lt;current_point+SF*x1,baseline+SF*y1).</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00212"></a><span class="lineno">  212</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00213"></a><span class="lineno">  213</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//  Advancing for the next character:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00214"></a><span class="lineno">  214</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    Call GlyphHMetrics, and compute &#39;current_point += SF * advance&#39;.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00215"></a><span class="lineno">  215</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// </span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00216"></a><span class="lineno">  216</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00217"></a><span class="lineno">  217</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// ADVANCED USAGE</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00218"></a><span class="lineno">  218</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00219"></a><span class="lineno">  219</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   Quality:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00220"></a><span class="lineno">  220</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00221"></a><span class="lineno">  221</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    - Use the functions with Subpixel at the end to allow your characters</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00222"></a><span class="lineno">  222</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      to have subpixel positioning. Since the font is anti-aliased, not</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00223"></a><span class="lineno">  223</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      hinted, this is very import for quality. (This is not possible with</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00224"></a><span class="lineno">  224</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      baked fonts.)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00225"></a><span class="lineno">  225</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00226"></a><span class="lineno">  226</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    - Kerning is now supported, and if you&#39;re supporting subpixel rendering</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00227"></a><span class="lineno">  227</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      then kerning is worth using to give your text a polished look.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00228"></a><span class="lineno">  228</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00229"></a><span class="lineno">  229</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   Performance:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00230"></a><span class="lineno">  230</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00231"></a><span class="lineno">  231</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    - Convert Unicode codepoints to glyph indexes and operate on the glyphs;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00232"></a><span class="lineno">  232</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      if you don&#39;t do this, stb_truetype is forced to do the conversion on</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00233"></a><span class="lineno">  233</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      every call.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00234"></a><span class="lineno">  234</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00235"></a><span class="lineno">  235</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//    - There are a lot of memory allocations. We should modify it to take</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00236"></a><span class="lineno">  236</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      a temp buffer and allocate from the temp buffer (without freeing),</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00237"></a><span class="lineno">  237</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      should help performance a lot.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00238"></a><span class="lineno">  238</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00239"></a><span class="lineno">  239</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// NOTES</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00240"></a><span class="lineno">  240</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00241"></a><span class="lineno">  241</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   The system uses the raw data found in the .ttf file without changing it</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00242"></a><span class="lineno">  242</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   and without building auxiliary data structures. This is a bit inefficient</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00243"></a><span class="lineno">  243</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   on little-endian systems (the data is big-endian), but assuming you&#39;re</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00244"></a><span class="lineno">  244</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   caching the bitmaps or glyph shapes this shouldn&#39;t be a big deal.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00245"></a><span class="lineno">  245</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00246"></a><span class="lineno">  246</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   It appears to be very hard to programmatically determine what font a</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00247"></a><span class="lineno">  247</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   given file is in a general way. I provide an API for this, but I don&#39;t</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00248"></a><span class="lineno">  248</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   recommend it.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00249"></a><span class="lineno">  249</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00250"></a><span class="lineno">  250</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00251"></a><span class="lineno">  251</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// SOURCE STATISTICS (based on v0.6c, 2050 LOC)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00252"></a><span class="lineno">  252</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l00278"></a><span class="lineno">  278</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//  Incomplete text-in-3d-api example, which draws quads properly aligned to be lossless</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00279"></a><span class="lineno">  279</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00280"></a><span class="lineno">  280</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#if 0</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00281"></a><span class="lineno">  281</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STB_TRUETYPE_IMPLEMENTATION  // force following include to generate implementation</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00282"></a><span class="lineno">  282</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#include &quot;stb_truetype.h&quot;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00283"></a><span class="lineno">  283</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00284"></a><span class="lineno">  284</span>&#160;<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> ttf_buffer[1&lt;&lt;20];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00285"></a><span class="lineno">  285</span>&#160;<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> temp_bitmap[512*512];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00286"></a><span class="lineno">  286</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00287"></a><span class="lineno">  287</span>&#160;<a class="code" href="structstbtt__bakedchar.html">stbtt_bakedchar</a> cdata[96]; <span class="comment">// ASCII 32..126 is 95 glyphs</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00288"></a><span class="lineno">  288</span>&#160;GLuint ftex;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00289"></a><span class="lineno">  289</span>&#160; </div>

<div class="line"><a name="l00637"></a><span class="lineno">  637</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// Oversampling a font increases the quality by allowing higher-quality subpixel</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00638"></a><span class="lineno">  638</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// positioning, and is especially valuable at smaller text sizes.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00639"></a><span class="lineno">  639</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l00641"></a><span class="lineno">  641</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// stbtt_PackFontRange(s) or stbtt_PackFontRangesGatherRects for a given</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00642"></a><span class="lineno">  642</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// pack context. The default (no oversampling) is achieved by h_oversample=1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00643"></a><span class="lineno">  643</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// and v_oversample=1. The total number of pixels required is</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00644"></a><span class="lineno">  644</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// h_oversample*v_oversample larger than the default; for example, 2x2</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00645"></a><span class="lineno">  645</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// oversampling requires 4x the storage of 1x1. For best results, render</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l00933"></a><span class="lineno">  933</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// These functions compute a discretized SDF field for a single character, suitable for storing</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00934"></a><span class="lineno">  934</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// in a single-channel texture, sampling with bilinear filtering, and testing against</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00935"></a><span class="lineno">  935</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// larger than some threshold to produce scalable fonts.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00936"></a><span class="lineno">  936</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        info              --  the font</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00937"></a><span class="lineno">  937</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        scale             --  controls the size of the resulting SDF bitmap, same as it would be creating a regular bitmap</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00938"></a><span class="lineno">  938</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        glyph/codepoint   --  the character to generate the SDF for</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00939"></a><span class="lineno">  939</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        padding           --  extra &quot;pixels&quot; around the character which are filled with the distance to the character (not 0),</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00940"></a><span class="lineno">  940</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//                                 which allows effects like bit outlines</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00941"></a><span class="lineno">  941</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        onedge_value      --  value 0-255 to test the SDF against to reconstruct the character (i.e. the isocontour of the character)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00942"></a><span class="lineno">  942</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        pixel_dist_scale  --  what value the SDF should increase by when moving one SDF &quot;pixel&quot; away from the edge (on the 0..255 scale)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00943"></a><span class="lineno">  943</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//                                 if positive, &gt; onedge_value is inside; if negative, &lt; onedge_value is inside</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00944"></a><span class="lineno">  944</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        width,height      --  output height &amp; width of the SDF bitmap (including padding)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00945"></a><span class="lineno">  945</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        xoff,yoff         --  output origin of the character</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00946"></a><span class="lineno">  946</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//        return value      --  a 2D array of bytes 0..255, width*height in size</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00947"></a><span class="lineno">  947</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00948"></a><span class="lineno">  948</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// pixel_dist_scale &amp; onedge_value are a scale &amp; bias that allows you to make</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00949"></a><span class="lineno">  949</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// optimal use of the limited 0..255 for your application, trading off precision</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00950"></a><span class="lineno">  950</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// and special effects. SDF values outside the range 0..255 are clamped to 0..255.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00951"></a><span class="lineno">  951</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00952"></a><span class="lineno">  952</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// Example:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00953"></a><span class="lineno">  953</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      scale = stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight(22)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00954"></a><span class="lineno">  954</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      padding = 5</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00955"></a><span class="lineno">  955</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      onedge_value = 180</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00956"></a><span class="lineno">  956</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      pixel_dist_scale = 180/5.0 = 36.0</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00957"></a><span class="lineno">  957</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00958"></a><span class="lineno">  958</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      This will create an SDF bitmap in which the character is about 22 pixels</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00959"></a><span class="lineno">  959</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      high but the whole bitmap is about 22+5+5=32 pixels high. To produce a filled</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00960"></a><span class="lineno">  960</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      shape, sample the SDF at each pixel and fill the pixel if the SDF value</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00961"></a><span class="lineno">  961</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      is greater than or equal to 180/255. (You&#39;ll actually want to antialias,</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00962"></a><span class="lineno">  962</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      which is beyond the scope of this example.) Additionally, you can compute</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00963"></a><span class="lineno">  963</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      offset outlines (e.g. to stroke the character border inside &amp; outside,</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00964"></a><span class="lineno">  964</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      or only outside). For example, to fill outside the character up to 3 SDF</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00965"></a><span class="lineno">  965</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      pixels, you would compare against (180-36.0*3)/255 = 72/255. The above</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00966"></a><span class="lineno">  966</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      choice of variables maps a range from 5 pixels outside the shape to</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00967"></a><span class="lineno">  967</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      2 pixels inside the shape to 0..255; this is intended primarily for apply</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00968"></a><span class="lineno">  968</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      outside effects only (the interior range is needed to allow proper</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00969"></a><span class="lineno">  969</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//      antialiasing of the font at *smaller* sizes)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00970"></a><span class="lineno">  970</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00971"></a><span class="lineno">  971</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// The function computes the SDF analytically at each SDF pixel, not by e.g.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00972"></a><span class="lineno">  972</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// building a higher-res bitmap and approximating it. In theory the quality</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00973"></a><span class="lineno">  973</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// should be as high as possible for an SDF of this size &amp; representation, but</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00974"></a><span class="lineno">  974</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// unclear if this is true in practice (perhaps building a higher-res bitmap</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00975"></a><span class="lineno">  975</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// and computing from that can allow drop-out prevention).</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00976"></a><span class="lineno">  976</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00977"></a><span class="lineno">  977</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// The algorithm has not been optimized at all, so expect it to be slow</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00978"></a><span class="lineno">  978</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// if computing lots of characters or very large sizes. </span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00979"></a><span class="lineno">  979</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00980"></a><span class="lineno">  980</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00981"></a><span class="lineno">  981</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00983"></a><span class="lineno">  983</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00984"></a><span class="lineno">  984</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// Finding the right font...</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00985"></a><span class="lineno">  985</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00986"></a><span class="lineno">  986</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// You should really just solve this offline, keep your own tables</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00987"></a><span class="lineno">  987</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// of what font is what, and don&#39;t try to get it out of the .ttf file.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00988"></a><span class="lineno">  988</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// That&#39;s because getting it out of the .ttf file is really hard, because</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00989"></a><span class="lineno">  989</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// the names in the file can appear in many possible encodings, in many</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00990"></a><span class="lineno">  990</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// possible languages, and e.g. if you need a case-insensitive comparison,</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00991"></a><span class="lineno">  991</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// the details of that depend on the encoding &amp; language in a complex way</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00992"></a><span class="lineno">  992</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// (actually underspecified in truetype, but also gigantic).</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00993"></a><span class="lineno">  993</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00994"></a><span class="lineno">  994</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// But you can use the provided functions in two possible ways:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00995"></a><span class="lineno">  995</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//     stbtt_FindMatchingFont() will use *case-sensitive* comparisons on</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00996"></a><span class="lineno">  996</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//             unicode-encoded names to try to find the font you want;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00997"></a><span class="lineno">  997</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//             you can run this before calling stbtt_InitFont()</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00998"></a><span class="lineno">  998</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l00999"></a><span class="lineno">  999</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//     stbtt_GetFontNameString() lets you get any of the various strings</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01000"></a><span class="lineno"> 1000</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//             from the file yourself and do your own comparisons on them.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01001"></a><span class="lineno"> 1001</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//             You have to have called stbtt_InitFont() first.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01002"></a><span class="lineno"> 1002</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01003"></a><span class="lineno"> 1003</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01004"></a><span class="lineno"> 1004</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt_FindMatchingFont(<span class="keyword">const</span> <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *fontdata, <span class="keyword">const</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *name, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> flags);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01005"></a><span class="lineno"> 1005</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// returns the offset (not index) of the font that matches, or -1 if none</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01006"></a><span class="lineno"> 1006</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   if you use STBTT_MACSTYLE_DONTCARE, use a font name like &quot;Arial Bold&quot;.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01007"></a><span class="lineno"> 1007</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//   if you use any other flag, use a font name like &quot;Arial&quot;; this checks</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01008"></a><span class="lineno"> 1008</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//     the &#39;macStyle&#39; header field; i don&#39;t know if fonts set this consistently</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01009"></a><span class="lineno"> 1009</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_MACSTYLE_DONTCARE     0</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01010"></a><span class="lineno"> 1010</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_MACSTYLE_BOLD         1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01011"></a><span class="lineno"> 1011</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_MACSTYLE_ITALIC       2</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01012"></a><span class="lineno"> 1012</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_MACSTYLE_UNDERSCORE   4</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01013"></a><span class="lineno"> 1013</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_MACSTYLE_NONE         8   // &lt;= not same as 0, this makes us check the bitfield is 0</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01014"></a><span class="lineno"> 1014</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01015"></a><span class="lineno"> 1015</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian(<span class="keyword">const</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *s1, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> len1, <span class="keyword">const</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *s2, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> len2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01016"></a><span class="lineno"> 1016</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// returns 1/0 whether the first string interpreted as utf8 is identical to</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01249"></a><span class="lineno"> 1249</span>&#160;   STBTT_assert(i &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; i &lt; count);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01250"></a><span class="lineno"> 1250</span>&#160;   STBTT_assert(offsize &gt;= 1 &amp;&amp; offsize &lt;= 4);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01251"></a><span class="lineno"> 1251</span>&#160;   stbtt__buf_skip(&amp;b, i*offsize);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01252"></a><span class="lineno"> 1252</span>&#160;   start = stbtt__buf_get(&amp;b, offsize);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01253"></a><span class="lineno"> 1253</span>&#160;   end = stbtt__buf_get(&amp;b, offsize);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01254"></a><span class="lineno"> 1254</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> stbtt__buf_range(&amp;b, 2+(count+1)*offsize+start, end - start);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01270"></a><span class="lineno"> 1270</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> stbtt_int16 ttSHORT(stbtt_uint8 *p)   { <span class="keywordflow">return</span> p[0]*256 + p[1]; }</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01411"></a><span class="lineno"> 1411</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (fdarrayoff) {</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01417"></a><span class="lineno"> 1417</span>&#160;      }</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01422"></a><span class="lineno"> 1422</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01423"></a><span class="lineno"> 1423</span>&#160;   t = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, <span class="stringliteral">&quot;maxp&quot;</span>);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01424"></a><span class="lineno"> 1424</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (t)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01425"></a><span class="lineno"> 1425</span>&#160;      info-&gt;numGlyphs = ttUSHORT(data+t+4);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01426"></a><span class="lineno"> 1426</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01427"></a><span class="lineno"> 1427</span>&#160;      info-&gt;numGlyphs = 0xffff;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01428"></a><span class="lineno"> 1428</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01429"></a><span class="lineno"> 1429</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// find a cmap encoding table we understand *now* to avoid searching</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01430"></a><span class="lineno"> 1430</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// later. (todo: could make this installable)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01431"></a><span class="lineno"> 1431</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// the same regardless of glyph.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01432"></a><span class="lineno"> 1432</span>&#160;   numTables = ttUSHORT(data + cmap + 2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01433"></a><span class="lineno"> 1433</span>&#160;   info-&gt;index_map = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01434"></a><span class="lineno"> 1434</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; numTables; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01435"></a><span class="lineno"> 1435</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint32 encoding_record = cmap + 4 + 8 * i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01436"></a><span class="lineno"> 1436</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// find an encoding we understand:</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01440"></a><span class="lineno"> 1440</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">case</span> STBTT_MS_EID_UNICODE_BMP:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01441"></a><span class="lineno"> 1441</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">case</span> STBTT_MS_EID_UNICODE_FULL:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01442"></a><span class="lineno"> 1442</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">// MS/Unicode</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01443"></a><span class="lineno"> 1443</span>&#160;                  info-&gt;index_map = cmap + ttULONG(data+encoding_record+4);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01444"></a><span class="lineno"> 1444</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01446"></a><span class="lineno"> 1446</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01447"></a><span class="lineno"> 1447</span>&#160;        <span class="keywordflow">case</span> STBTT_PLATFORM_ID_UNICODE:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01448"></a><span class="lineno"> 1448</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// Mac/iOS has these</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01449"></a><span class="lineno"> 1449</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// all the encodingIDs are unicode, so we don&#39;t bother to check it</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01450"></a><span class="lineno"> 1450</span>&#160;            info-&gt;index_map = cmap + ttULONG(data+encoding_record+4);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01452"></a><span class="lineno"> 1452</span>&#160;      }</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01456"></a><span class="lineno"> 1456</span>&#160; </div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01458"></a><span class="lineno"> 1458</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 1;</div>
