<div class="line"><a name="l01460"></a><span class="lineno"> 1460</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01461"></a><span class="lineno"> 1461</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(<span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> *info, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> unicode_codepoint)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01462"></a><span class="lineno"> 1462</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01463"></a><span class="lineno"> 1463</span>&#160;   stbtt_uint8 *data = info-&gt;data;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01464"></a><span class="lineno"> 1464</span>&#160;   stbtt_uint32 index_map = info-&gt;index_map;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01465"></a><span class="lineno"> 1465</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01466"></a><span class="lineno"> 1466</span>&#160;   stbtt_uint16 format = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01467"></a><span class="lineno"> 1467</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (format == 0) { <span class="comment">// apple byte encoding</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01468"></a><span class="lineno"> 1468</span>&#160;      stbtt_int32 bytes = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01469"></a><span class="lineno"> 1469</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (unicode_codepoint &lt; bytes-6)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01470"></a><span class="lineno"> 1470</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">return</span> ttBYTE(data + index_map + 6 + unicode_codepoint);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01471"></a><span class="lineno"> 1471</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01472"></a><span class="lineno"> 1472</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (format == 6) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01473"></a><span class="lineno"> 1473</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint32 first = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 6);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01474"></a><span class="lineno"> 1474</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint32 count = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 8);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01475"></a><span class="lineno"> 1475</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> ((stbtt_uint32) unicode_codepoint &gt;= first &amp;&amp; (stbtt_uint32) unicode_codepoint &lt; first+count)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01476"></a><span class="lineno"> 1476</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">return</span> ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 10 + (unicode_codepoint - first)*2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01477"></a><span class="lineno"> 1477</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01478"></a><span class="lineno"> 1478</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (format == 2) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01479"></a><span class="lineno"> 1479</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(0); <span class="comment">// @TODO: high-byte mapping for japanese/chinese/korean</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01480"></a><span class="lineno"> 1480</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01481"></a><span class="lineno"> 1481</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (format == 4) { <span class="comment">// standard mapping for windows fonts: binary search collection of ranges</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01482"></a><span class="lineno"> 1482</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint16 segcount = ttUSHORT(data+index_map+6) &gt;&gt; 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01483"></a><span class="lineno"> 1483</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint16 searchRange = ttUSHORT(data+index_map+8) &gt;&gt; 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01484"></a><span class="lineno"> 1484</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint16 entrySelector = ttUSHORT(data+index_map+10);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01485"></a><span class="lineno"> 1485</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint16 rangeShift = ttUSHORT(data+index_map+12) &gt;&gt; 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01486"></a><span class="lineno"> 1486</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01487"></a><span class="lineno"> 1487</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// do a binary search of the segments</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01488"></a><span class="lineno"> 1488</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint32 endCount = index_map + 14;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01489"></a><span class="lineno"> 1489</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint32 search = endCount;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01490"></a><span class="lineno"> 1490</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01491"></a><span class="lineno"> 1491</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (unicode_codepoint &gt; 0xffff)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01492"></a><span class="lineno"> 1492</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01493"></a><span class="lineno"> 1493</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01494"></a><span class="lineno"> 1494</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// they lie from endCount .. endCount + segCount</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01495"></a><span class="lineno"> 1495</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// but searchRange is the nearest power of two, so...</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01496"></a><span class="lineno"> 1496</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (unicode_codepoint &gt;= ttUSHORT(data + search + rangeShift*2))</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01497"></a><span class="lineno"> 1497</span>&#160;         search += rangeShift*2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01498"></a><span class="lineno"> 1498</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01499"></a><span class="lineno"> 1499</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// now decrement to bias correctly to find smallest</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01500"></a><span class="lineno"> 1500</span>&#160;      search -= 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01501"></a><span class="lineno"> 1501</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (entrySelector) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01502"></a><span class="lineno"> 1502</span>&#160;         stbtt_uint16 end;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01503"></a><span class="lineno"> 1503</span>&#160;         searchRange &gt;&gt;= 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01504"></a><span class="lineno"> 1504</span>&#160;         end = ttUSHORT(data + search + searchRange*2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01505"></a><span class="lineno"> 1505</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (unicode_codepoint &gt; end)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01506"></a><span class="lineno"> 1506</span>&#160;            search += searchRange*2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01507"></a><span class="lineno"> 1507</span>&#160;         --entrySelector;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01508"></a><span class="lineno"> 1508</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01509"></a><span class="lineno"> 1509</span>&#160;      search += 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01510"></a><span class="lineno"> 1510</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01511"></a><span class="lineno"> 1511</span>&#160;      {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01512"></a><span class="lineno"> 1512</span>&#160;         stbtt_uint16 offset, start;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01513"></a><span class="lineno"> 1513</span>&#160;         stbtt_uint16 item = (stbtt_uint16) ((search - endCount) &gt;&gt; 1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01514"></a><span class="lineno"> 1514</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01515"></a><span class="lineno"> 1515</span>&#160;         STBTT_assert(unicode_codepoint &lt;= ttUSHORT(data + endCount + 2*item));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01516"></a><span class="lineno"> 1516</span>&#160;         start = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 14 + segcount*2 + 2 + 2*item);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01517"></a><span class="lineno"> 1517</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (unicode_codepoint &lt; start)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01518"></a><span class="lineno"> 1518</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01519"></a><span class="lineno"> 1519</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01520"></a><span class="lineno"> 1520</span>&#160;         offset = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 14 + segcount*6 + 2 + 2*item);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01521"></a><span class="lineno"> 1521</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (offset == 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01522"></a><span class="lineno"> 1522</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">return</span> (stbtt_uint16) (unicode_codepoint + ttSHORT(data + index_map + 14 + segcount*4 + 2 + 2*item));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01523"></a><span class="lineno"> 1523</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01524"></a><span class="lineno"> 1524</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">return</span> ttUSHORT(data + offset + (unicode_codepoint-start)*2 + index_map + 14 + segcount*6 + 2 + 2*item);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01525"></a><span class="lineno"> 1525</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01526"></a><span class="lineno"> 1526</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (format == 12 || format == 13) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01527"></a><span class="lineno"> 1527</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint32 ngroups = ttULONG(data+index_map+12);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01528"></a><span class="lineno"> 1528</span>&#160;      stbtt_int32 low,high;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01529"></a><span class="lineno"> 1529</span>&#160;      low = 0; high = (stbtt_int32)ngroups;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01530"></a><span class="lineno"> 1530</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// Binary search the right group.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01531"></a><span class="lineno"> 1531</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (low &lt; high) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01532"></a><span class="lineno"> 1532</span>&#160;         stbtt_int32 mid = low + ((high-low) &gt;&gt; 1); <span class="comment">// rounds down, so low &lt;= mid &lt; high</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01533"></a><span class="lineno"> 1533</span>&#160;         stbtt_uint32 start_char = ttULONG(data+index_map+16+mid*12);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01534"></a><span class="lineno"> 1534</span>&#160;         stbtt_uint32 end_char = ttULONG(data+index_map+16+mid*12+4);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01535"></a><span class="lineno"> 1535</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> ((stbtt_uint32) unicode_codepoint &lt; start_char)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01536"></a><span class="lineno"> 1536</span>&#160;            high = mid;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01537"></a><span class="lineno"> 1537</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> ((stbtt_uint32) unicode_codepoint &gt; end_char)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01538"></a><span class="lineno"> 1538</span>&#160;            low = mid+1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01539"></a><span class="lineno"> 1539</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01540"></a><span class="lineno"> 1540</span>&#160;            stbtt_uint32 start_glyph = ttULONG(data+index_map+16+mid*12+8);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01541"></a><span class="lineno"> 1541</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (format == 12)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01542"></a><span class="lineno"> 1542</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">return</span> start_glyph + unicode_codepoint-start_char;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01543"></a><span class="lineno"> 1543</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="comment">// format == 13</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01546"></a><span class="lineno"> 1546</span>&#160;      }</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01548"></a><span class="lineno"> 1548</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01549"></a><span class="lineno"> 1549</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// @TODO</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01550"></a><span class="lineno"> 1550</span>&#160;   STBTT_assert(0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01551"></a><span class="lineno"> 1551</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01568"></a><span class="lineno"> 1568</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt__GetGlyfOffset(<span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> *info, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> glyph_index)</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01623"></a><span class="lineno"> 1623</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt__close_shape(<a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a> *vertices, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_vertices, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> was_off, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> start_off,</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01629"></a><span class="lineno"> 1629</span>&#160;      stbtt_setvertex(&amp;vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vcurve, sx,sy,scx,scy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01630"></a><span class="lineno"> 1630</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01631"></a><span class="lineno"> 1631</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (was_off)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01632"></a><span class="lineno"> 1632</span>&#160;         stbtt_setvertex(&amp;vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vcurve,sx,sy,cx,cy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01633"></a><span class="lineno"> 1633</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01634"></a><span class="lineno"> 1634</span>&#160;         stbtt_setvertex(&amp;vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vline,sx,sy,0,0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01635"></a><span class="lineno"> 1635</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01636"></a><span class="lineno"> 1636</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> num_vertices;</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01639"></a><span class="lineno"> 1639</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt__GetGlyphShapeTT(<span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> *info, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> glyph_index, <a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a> **pvertices)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01640"></a><span class="lineno"> 1640</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01641"></a><span class="lineno"> 1641</span>&#160;   stbtt_int16 numberOfContours;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01642"></a><span class="lineno"> 1642</span>&#160;   stbtt_uint8 *endPtsOfContours;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01643"></a><span class="lineno"> 1643</span>&#160;   stbtt_uint8 *data = info-&gt;data;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01644"></a><span class="lineno"> 1644</span>&#160;   <a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a> *vertices=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01645"></a><span class="lineno"> 1645</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_vertices=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01646"></a><span class="lineno"> 1646</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> g = stbtt__GetGlyfOffset(info, glyph_index);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01647"></a><span class="lineno"> 1647</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01648"></a><span class="lineno"> 1648</span>&#160;   *pvertices = NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01649"></a><span class="lineno"> 1649</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01650"></a><span class="lineno"> 1650</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (g &lt; 0) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01651"></a><span class="lineno"> 1651</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01652"></a><span class="lineno"> 1652</span>&#160;   numberOfContours = ttSHORT(data + g);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01653"></a><span class="lineno"> 1653</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01654"></a><span class="lineno"> 1654</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (numberOfContours &gt; 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01655"></a><span class="lineno"> 1655</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint8 flags=0,flagcount;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01656"></a><span class="lineno"> 1656</span>&#160;      stbtt_int32 ins, i,j=0,m,n, next_move, was_off=0, off, start_off=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01657"></a><span class="lineno"> 1657</span>&#160;      stbtt_int32 x,y,cx,cy,sx,sy, scx,scy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01658"></a><span class="lineno"> 1658</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint8 *points;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01659"></a><span class="lineno"> 1659</span>&#160;      endPtsOfContours = (data + g + 10);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01660"></a><span class="lineno"> 1660</span>&#160;      ins = ttUSHORT(data + g + 10 + numberOfContours * 2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01661"></a><span class="lineno"> 1661</span>&#160;      points = data + g + 10 + numberOfContours * 2 + 2 + ins;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01662"></a><span class="lineno"> 1662</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01663"></a><span class="lineno"> 1663</span>&#160;      n = 1+ttUSHORT(endPtsOfContours + numberOfContours*2-2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01664"></a><span class="lineno"> 1664</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01665"></a><span class="lineno"> 1665</span>&#160;      m = n + 2*numberOfContours;  <span class="comment">// a loose bound on how many vertices we might need</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01666"></a><span class="lineno"> 1666</span>&#160;      vertices = (<a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a> *) STBTT_malloc(m * <span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(vertices[0]), info-&gt;userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01667"></a><span class="lineno"> 1667</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (vertices == 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01668"></a><span class="lineno"> 1668</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01669"></a><span class="lineno"> 1669</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01670"></a><span class="lineno"> 1670</span>&#160;      next_move = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01671"></a><span class="lineno"> 1671</span>&#160;      flagcount=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01672"></a><span class="lineno"> 1672</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01673"></a><span class="lineno"> 1673</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// in first pass, we load uninterpreted data into the allocated array</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01674"></a><span class="lineno"> 1674</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// above, shifted to the end of the array so we won&#39;t overwrite it when</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01675"></a><span class="lineno"> 1675</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// we create our final data starting from the front</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01676"></a><span class="lineno"> 1676</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01677"></a><span class="lineno"> 1677</span>&#160;      off = m - n; <span class="comment">// starting offset for uninterpreted data, regardless of how m ends up being calculated</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01678"></a><span class="lineno"> 1678</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01679"></a><span class="lineno"> 1679</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// first load flags</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01680"></a><span class="lineno"> 1680</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01681"></a><span class="lineno"> 1681</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; n; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01682"></a><span class="lineno"> 1682</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flagcount == 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01683"></a><span class="lineno"> 1683</span>&#160;            flags = *points++;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01684"></a><span class="lineno"> 1684</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flags &amp; 8)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01685"></a><span class="lineno"> 1685</span>&#160;               flagcount = *points++;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01686"></a><span class="lineno"> 1686</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01687"></a><span class="lineno"> 1687</span>&#160;            --flagcount;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01688"></a><span class="lineno"> 1688</span>&#160;         vertices[off+i].type = flags;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01689"></a><span class="lineno"> 1689</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01690"></a><span class="lineno"> 1690</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01691"></a><span class="lineno"> 1691</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// now load x coordinates</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01692"></a><span class="lineno"> 1692</span>&#160;      x=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01693"></a><span class="lineno"> 1693</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; n; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01694"></a><span class="lineno"> 1694</span>&#160;         flags = vertices[off+i].type;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01695"></a><span class="lineno"> 1695</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flags &amp; 2) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01696"></a><span class="lineno"> 1696</span>&#160;            stbtt_int16 dx = *points++;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01697"></a><span class="lineno"> 1697</span>&#160;            x += (flags &amp; 16) ? dx : -dx; <span class="comment">// ???</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01698"></a><span class="lineno"> 1698</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01699"></a><span class="lineno"> 1699</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!(flags &amp; 16)) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01700"></a><span class="lineno"> 1700</span>&#160;               x = x + (stbtt_int16) (points[0]*256 + points[1]);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01701"></a><span class="lineno"> 1701</span>&#160;               points += 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01702"></a><span class="lineno"> 1702</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01703"></a><span class="lineno"> 1703</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01704"></a><span class="lineno"> 1704</span>&#160;         vertices[off+i].x = (stbtt_int16) x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01705"></a><span class="lineno"> 1705</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01706"></a><span class="lineno"> 1706</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01707"></a><span class="lineno"> 1707</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// now load y coordinates</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01708"></a><span class="lineno"> 1708</span>&#160;      y=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01709"></a><span class="lineno"> 1709</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; n; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01710"></a><span class="lineno"> 1710</span>&#160;         flags = vertices[off+i].type;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01711"></a><span class="lineno"> 1711</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flags &amp; 4) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01712"></a><span class="lineno"> 1712</span>&#160;            stbtt_int16 dy = *points++;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01713"></a><span class="lineno"> 1713</span>&#160;            y += (flags &amp; 32) ? dy : -dy; <span class="comment">// ???</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01714"></a><span class="lineno"> 1714</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01715"></a><span class="lineno"> 1715</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!(flags &amp; 32)) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01716"></a><span class="lineno"> 1716</span>&#160;               y = y + (stbtt_int16) (points[0]*256 + points[1]);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01717"></a><span class="lineno"> 1717</span>&#160;               points += 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01718"></a><span class="lineno"> 1718</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01719"></a><span class="lineno"> 1719</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01720"></a><span class="lineno"> 1720</span>&#160;         vertices[off+i].y = (stbtt_int16) y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01721"></a><span class="lineno"> 1721</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01722"></a><span class="lineno"> 1722</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01723"></a><span class="lineno"> 1723</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// now convert them to our format</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01724"></a><span class="lineno"> 1724</span>&#160;      num_vertices=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01725"></a><span class="lineno"> 1725</span>&#160;      sx = sy = cx = cy = scx = scy = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01726"></a><span class="lineno"> 1726</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; n; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01727"></a><span class="lineno"> 1727</span>&#160;         flags = vertices[off+i].type;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01728"></a><span class="lineno"> 1728</span>&#160;         x     = (stbtt_int16) vertices[off+i].x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01729"></a><span class="lineno"> 1729</span>&#160;         y     = (stbtt_int16) vertices[off+i].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01730"></a><span class="lineno"> 1730</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01731"></a><span class="lineno"> 1731</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (next_move == i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01732"></a><span class="lineno"> 1732</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i != 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01733"></a><span class="lineno"> 1733</span>&#160;               num_vertices = stbtt__close_shape(vertices, num_vertices, was_off, start_off, sx,sy,scx,scy,cx,cy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01734"></a><span class="lineno"> 1734</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01735"></a><span class="lineno"> 1735</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// now start the new one               </span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01736"></a><span class="lineno"> 1736</span>&#160;            start_off = !(flags &amp; 1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01737"></a><span class="lineno"> 1737</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (start_off) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01738"></a><span class="lineno"> 1738</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// if we start off with an off-curve point, then when we need to find a point on the curve</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01739"></a><span class="lineno"> 1739</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// where we can start, and we need to save some state for when we wraparound.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01740"></a><span class="lineno"> 1740</span>&#160;               scx = x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01741"></a><span class="lineno"> 1741</span>&#160;               scy = y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01742"></a><span class="lineno"> 1742</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!(vertices[off+i+1].type &amp; 1)) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01743"></a><span class="lineno"> 1743</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">// next point is also a curve point, so interpolate an on-point curve</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01744"></a><span class="lineno"> 1744</span>&#160;                  sx = (x + (stbtt_int32) vertices[off+i+1].x) &gt;&gt; 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01745"></a><span class="lineno"> 1745</span>&#160;                  sy = (y + (stbtt_int32) vertices[off+i+1].y) &gt;&gt; 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01746"></a><span class="lineno"> 1746</span>&#160;               } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01747"></a><span class="lineno"> 1747</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">// otherwise just use the next point as our start point</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01748"></a><span class="lineno"> 1748</span>&#160;                  sx = (stbtt_int32) vertices[off+i+1].x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01749"></a><span class="lineno"> 1749</span>&#160;                  sy = (stbtt_int32) vertices[off+i+1].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01750"></a><span class="lineno"> 1750</span>&#160;                  ++i; <span class="comment">// we&#39;re using point i+1 as the starting point, so skip it</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01751"></a><span class="lineno"> 1751</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01752"></a><span class="lineno"> 1752</span>&#160;            } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01753"></a><span class="lineno"> 1753</span>&#160;               sx = x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01754"></a><span class="lineno"> 1754</span>&#160;               sy = y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01755"></a><span class="lineno"> 1755</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01756"></a><span class="lineno"> 1756</span>&#160;            stbtt_setvertex(&amp;vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vmove,sx,sy,0,0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01757"></a><span class="lineno"> 1757</span>&#160;            was_off = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01758"></a><span class="lineno"> 1758</span>&#160;            next_move = 1 + ttUSHORT(endPtsOfContours+j*2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01759"></a><span class="lineno"> 1759</span>&#160;            ++j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01760"></a><span class="lineno"> 1760</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01761"></a><span class="lineno"> 1761</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!(flags &amp; 1)) { <span class="comment">// if it&#39;s a curve</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01762"></a><span class="lineno"> 1762</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (was_off) <span class="comment">// two off-curve control points in a row means interpolate an on-curve midpoint</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01763"></a><span class="lineno"> 1763</span>&#160;                  stbtt_setvertex(&amp;vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vcurve, (cx+x)&gt;&gt;1, (cy+y)&gt;&gt;1, cx, cy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01764"></a><span class="lineno"> 1764</span>&#160;               cx = x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01765"></a><span class="lineno"> 1765</span>&#160;               cy = y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01766"></a><span class="lineno"> 1766</span>&#160;               was_off = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01767"></a><span class="lineno"> 1767</span>&#160;            } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01768"></a><span class="lineno"> 1768</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (was_off)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01769"></a><span class="lineno"> 1769</span>&#160;                  stbtt_setvertex(&amp;vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vcurve, x,y, cx, cy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01770"></a><span class="lineno"> 1770</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01771"></a><span class="lineno"> 1771</span>&#160;                  stbtt_setvertex(&amp;vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vline, x,y,0,0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01772"></a><span class="lineno"> 1772</span>&#160;               was_off = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01773"></a><span class="lineno"> 1773</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01774"></a><span class="lineno"> 1774</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01775"></a><span class="lineno"> 1775</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01776"></a><span class="lineno"> 1776</span>&#160;      num_vertices = stbtt__close_shape(vertices, num_vertices, was_off, start_off, sx,sy,scx,scy,cx,cy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01777"></a><span class="lineno"> 1777</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (numberOfContours == -1) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01778"></a><span class="lineno"> 1778</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// Compound shapes.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01779"></a><span class="lineno"> 1779</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">int</span> more = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01780"></a><span class="lineno"> 1780</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint8 *comp = data + g + 10;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01781"></a><span class="lineno"> 1781</span>&#160;      num_vertices = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01782"></a><span class="lineno"> 1782</span>&#160;      vertices = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01783"></a><span class="lineno"> 1783</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (more) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01784"></a><span class="lineno"> 1784</span>&#160;         stbtt_uint16 flags, gidx;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01785"></a><span class="lineno"> 1785</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> comp_num_verts = 0, i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01786"></a><span class="lineno"> 1786</span>&#160;         <a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a> *comp_verts = 0, *tmp = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01787"></a><span class="lineno"> 1787</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> mtx[6] = {1,0,0,1,0,0}, m, n;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01788"></a><span class="lineno"> 1788</span>&#160;         </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01789"></a><span class="lineno"> 1789</span>&#160;         flags = ttSHORT(comp); comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01790"></a><span class="lineno"> 1790</span>&#160;         gidx = ttSHORT(comp); comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01791"></a><span class="lineno"> 1791</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01792"></a><span class="lineno"> 1792</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flags &amp; 2) { <span class="comment">// XY values</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01793"></a><span class="lineno"> 1793</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flags &amp; 1) { <span class="comment">// shorts</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01794"></a><span class="lineno"> 1794</span>&#160;               mtx[4] = ttSHORT(comp); comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01795"></a><span class="lineno"> 1795</span>&#160;               mtx[5] = ttSHORT(comp); comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01796"></a><span class="lineno"> 1796</span>&#160;            } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01797"></a><span class="lineno"> 1797</span>&#160;               mtx[4] = ttCHAR(comp); comp+=1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01798"></a><span class="lineno"> 1798</span>&#160;               mtx[5] = ttCHAR(comp); comp+=1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01799"></a><span class="lineno"> 1799</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01800"></a><span class="lineno"> 1800</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01801"></a><span class="lineno"> 1801</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01802"></a><span class="lineno"> 1802</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// @TODO handle matching point</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01803"></a><span class="lineno"> 1803</span>&#160;            STBTT_assert(0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01804"></a><span class="lineno"> 1804</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01805"></a><span class="lineno"> 1805</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flags &amp; (1&lt;&lt;3)) { <span class="comment">// WE_HAVE_A_SCALE</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01806"></a><span class="lineno"> 1806</span>&#160;            mtx[0] = mtx[3] = ttSHORT(comp)/16384.0f; comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01807"></a><span class="lineno"> 1807</span>&#160;            mtx[1] = mtx[2] = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01808"></a><span class="lineno"> 1808</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flags &amp; (1&lt;&lt;6)) { <span class="comment">// WE_HAVE_AN_X_AND_YSCALE</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01809"></a><span class="lineno"> 1809</span>&#160;            mtx[0] = ttSHORT(comp)/16384.0f; comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01810"></a><span class="lineno"> 1810</span>&#160;            mtx[1] = mtx[2] = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01811"></a><span class="lineno"> 1811</span>&#160;            mtx[3] = ttSHORT(comp)/16384.0f; comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01812"></a><span class="lineno"> 1812</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flags &amp; (1&lt;&lt;7)) { <span class="comment">// WE_HAVE_A_TWO_BY_TWO</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01813"></a><span class="lineno"> 1813</span>&#160;            mtx[0] = ttSHORT(comp)/16384.0f; comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01814"></a><span class="lineno"> 1814</span>&#160;            mtx[1] = ttSHORT(comp)/16384.0f; comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01815"></a><span class="lineno"> 1815</span>&#160;            mtx[2] = ttSHORT(comp)/16384.0f; comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01816"></a><span class="lineno"> 1816</span>&#160;            mtx[3] = ttSHORT(comp)/16384.0f; comp+=2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01817"></a><span class="lineno"> 1817</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01818"></a><span class="lineno"> 1818</span>&#160;         </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01819"></a><span class="lineno"> 1819</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// Find transformation scales.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01820"></a><span class="lineno"> 1820</span>&#160;         m = (float) STBTT_sqrt(mtx[0]*mtx[0] + mtx[1]*mtx[1]);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01821"></a><span class="lineno"> 1821</span>&#160;         n = (float) STBTT_sqrt(mtx[2]*mtx[2] + mtx[3]*mtx[3]);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01822"></a><span class="lineno"> 1822</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01823"></a><span class="lineno"> 1823</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// Get indexed glyph.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01824"></a><span class="lineno"> 1824</span>&#160;         comp_num_verts = stbtt_GetGlyphShape(info, gidx, &amp;comp_verts);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01825"></a><span class="lineno"> 1825</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (comp_num_verts &gt; 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01826"></a><span class="lineno"> 1826</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// Transform vertices.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01827"></a><span class="lineno"> 1827</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i = 0; i &lt; comp_num_verts; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01828"></a><span class="lineno"> 1828</span>&#160;               <a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a>* v = &amp;comp_verts[i];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01829"></a><span class="lineno"> 1829</span>&#160;               stbtt_vertex_type x,y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01830"></a><span class="lineno"> 1830</span>&#160;               x=v-&gt;x; y=v-&gt;y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01831"></a><span class="lineno"> 1831</span>&#160;               v-&gt;x = (stbtt_vertex_type)(m * (mtx[0]*x + mtx[2]*y + mtx[4]));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01832"></a><span class="lineno"> 1832</span>&#160;               v-&gt;y = (stbtt_vertex_type)(n * (mtx[1]*x + mtx[3]*y + mtx[5]));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01833"></a><span class="lineno"> 1833</span>&#160;               x=v-&gt;cx; y=v-&gt;cy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01834"></a><span class="lineno"> 1834</span>&#160;               v-&gt;cx = (stbtt_vertex_type)(m * (mtx[0]*x + mtx[2]*y + mtx[4]));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01835"></a><span class="lineno"> 1835</span>&#160;               v-&gt;cy = (stbtt_vertex_type)(n * (mtx[1]*x + mtx[3]*y + mtx[5]));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01836"></a><span class="lineno"> 1836</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01837"></a><span class="lineno"> 1837</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// Append vertices.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01838"></a><span class="lineno"> 1838</span>&#160;            tmp = (<a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a>*)STBTT_malloc((num_vertices+comp_num_verts)*<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(<a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a>), info-&gt;userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01839"></a><span class="lineno"> 1839</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!tmp) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01840"></a><span class="lineno"> 1840</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (vertices) STBTT_free(vertices, info-&gt;userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01841"></a><span class="lineno"> 1841</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (comp_verts) STBTT_free(comp_verts, info-&gt;userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01842"></a><span class="lineno"> 1842</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01843"></a><span class="lineno"> 1843</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l01844"></a><span class="lineno"> 1844</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (num_vertices &gt; 0) STBTT_memcpy(tmp, vertices, num_vertices*<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(<a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a>)); <span class="comment">//-V595</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01848"></a><span class="lineno"> 1848</span>&#160;            STBTT_free(comp_verts, info-&gt;userdata);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l01853"></a><span class="lineno"> 1853</span>&#160;      }</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l02637"></a><span class="lineno"> 2637</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (iy1) *iy1 = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02638"></a><span class="lineno"> 2638</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02639"></a><span class="lineno"> 2639</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// move to integral bboxes (treating pixels as little squares, what pixels get touched)?</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02640"></a><span class="lineno"> 2640</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (ix0) *ix0 = STBTT_ifloor( x0 * scale_x + shift_x);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l02642"></a><span class="lineno"> 2642</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (ix1) *ix1 = STBTT_iceil ( x1 * scale_x + shift_x);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02643"></a><span class="lineno"> 2643</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (iy1) *iy1 = STBTT_iceil (-y0 * scale_y + shift_y);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02644"></a><span class="lineno"> 2644</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02645"></a><span class="lineno"> 2645</span>&#160;}</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l02666"></a><span class="lineno"> 2666</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">typedef</span> <span class="keyword">struct </span>stbtt__hheap_chunk</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02667"></a><span class="lineno"> 2667</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02668"></a><span class="lineno"> 2668</span>&#160;   <span class="keyword">struct </span>stbtt__hheap_chunk *next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02669"></a><span class="lineno"> 2669</span>&#160;} stbtt__hheap_chunk;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02670"></a><span class="lineno"> 2670</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02671"></a><span class="lineno"> 2671</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">typedef</span> <span class="keyword">struct </span>stbtt__hheap</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02672"></a><span class="lineno"> 2672</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02673"></a><span class="lineno"> 2673</span>&#160;   <span class="keyword">struct </span>stbtt__hheap_chunk *head;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02674"></a><span class="lineno"> 2674</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">void</span>   *first_free;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02675"></a><span class="lineno"> 2675</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span>    num_remaining_in_head_chunk;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02676"></a><span class="lineno"> 2676</span>&#160;} stbtt__hheap;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02677"></a><span class="lineno"> 2677</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02678"></a><span class="lineno"> 2678</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *stbtt__hheap_alloc(stbtt__hheap *hh, <span class="keywordtype">size_t</span> size, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02679"></a><span class="lineno"> 2679</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02680"></a><span class="lineno"> 2680</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (hh-&gt;first_free) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02681"></a><span class="lineno"> 2681</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *p = hh-&gt;first_free;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02682"></a><span class="lineno"> 2682</span>&#160;      hh-&gt;first_free = * (<span class="keywordtype">void</span> **) p;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02683"></a><span class="lineno"> 2683</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> p;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02684"></a><span class="lineno"> 2684</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02685"></a><span class="lineno"> 2685</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (hh-&gt;num_remaining_in_head_chunk == 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02686"></a><span class="lineno"> 2686</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> count = (size &lt; 32 ? 2000 : size &lt; 128 ? 800 : 100);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02687"></a><span class="lineno"> 2687</span>&#160;         stbtt__hheap_chunk *c = (stbtt__hheap_chunk *) STBTT_malloc(<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(stbtt__hheap_chunk) + size * count, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02688"></a><span class="lineno"> 2688</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (c == NULL)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02689"></a><span class="lineno"> 2689</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">return</span> NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02690"></a><span class="lineno"> 2690</span>&#160;         c-&gt;next = hh-&gt;head;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02691"></a><span class="lineno"> 2691</span>&#160;         hh-&gt;head = c;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02692"></a><span class="lineno"> 2692</span>&#160;         hh-&gt;num_remaining_in_head_chunk = count;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02693"></a><span class="lineno"> 2693</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02694"></a><span class="lineno"> 2694</span>&#160;      --hh-&gt;num_remaining_in_head_chunk;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02695"></a><span class="lineno"> 2695</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> (<span class="keywordtype">char</span> *) (hh-&gt;head) + <span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(stbtt__hheap_chunk) + size * hh-&gt;num_remaining_in_head_chunk;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02696"></a><span class="lineno"> 2696</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02697"></a><span class="lineno"> 2697</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02698"></a><span class="lineno"> 2698</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02699"></a><span class="lineno"> 2699</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__hheap_free(stbtt__hheap *hh, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *p)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02700"></a><span class="lineno"> 2700</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02701"></a><span class="lineno"> 2701</span>&#160;   *(<span class="keywordtype">void</span> **) p = hh-&gt;first_free;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02702"></a><span class="lineno"> 2702</span>&#160;   hh-&gt;first_free = p;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02703"></a><span class="lineno"> 2703</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02704"></a><span class="lineno"> 2704</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02705"></a><span class="lineno"> 2705</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__hheap_cleanup(stbtt__hheap *hh, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02706"></a><span class="lineno"> 2706</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02707"></a><span class="lineno"> 2707</span>&#160;   stbtt__hheap_chunk *c = hh-&gt;head;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02708"></a><span class="lineno"> 2708</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (c) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02709"></a><span class="lineno"> 2709</span>&#160;      stbtt__hheap_chunk *n = c-&gt;next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02710"></a><span class="lineno"> 2710</span>&#160;      STBTT_free(c, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02711"></a><span class="lineno"> 2711</span>&#160;      c = n;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02712"></a><span class="lineno"> 2712</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02713"></a><span class="lineno"> 2713</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02714"></a><span class="lineno"> 2714</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02715"></a><span class="lineno"> 2715</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">typedef</span> <span class="keyword">struct </span>stbtt__edge {</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l02721"></a><span class="lineno"> 2721</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">typedef</span> <span class="keyword">struct </span>stbtt__active_edge</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02722"></a><span class="lineno"> 2722</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02723"></a><span class="lineno"> 2723</span>&#160;   <span class="keyword">struct </span>stbtt__active_edge *next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02724"></a><span class="lineno"> 2724</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">   #if STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION==1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02725"></a><span class="lineno"> 2725</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x,dx;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02726"></a><span class="lineno"> 2726</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> ey;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02727"></a><span class="lineno"> 2727</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> direction;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02728"></a><span class="lineno"> 2728</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">   #elif STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION==2</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02729"></a><span class="lineno"> 2729</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> fx,fdx,fdy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02730"></a><span class="lineno"> 2730</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> direction;</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l02735"></a><span class="lineno"> 2735</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">   #endif</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02736"></a><span class="lineno"> 2736</span>&#160;} stbtt__active_edge;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02737"></a><span class="lineno"> 2737</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02738"></a><span class="lineno"> 2738</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#if STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02739"></a><span class="lineno"> 2739</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_FIXSHIFT   10</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02740"></a><span class="lineno"> 2740</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_FIX        (1 &lt;&lt; STBTT_FIXSHIFT)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02741"></a><span class="lineno"> 2741</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_FIXMASK    (STBTT_FIX-1)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02742"></a><span class="lineno"> 2742</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02743"></a><span class="lineno"> 2743</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> stbtt__active_edge *stbtt__new_active(stbtt__hheap *hh, stbtt__edge *e, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> off_x, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> start_point, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02744"></a><span class="lineno"> 2744</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02745"></a><span class="lineno"> 2745</span>&#160;   stbtt__active_edge *z = (stbtt__active_edge *) stbtt__hheap_alloc(hh, <span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(*z), userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02746"></a><span class="lineno"> 2746</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dxdy = (e-&gt;x1 - e-&gt;x0) / (e-&gt;y1 - e-&gt;y0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02747"></a><span class="lineno"> 2747</span>&#160;   STBTT_assert(z != NULL);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02748"></a><span class="lineno"> 2748</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!z) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> z;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02749"></a><span class="lineno"> 2749</span>&#160;   </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02750"></a><span class="lineno"> 2750</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// round dx down to avoid overshooting</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02751"></a><span class="lineno"> 2751</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (dxdy &lt; 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02752"></a><span class="lineno"> 2752</span>&#160;      z-&gt;dx = -STBTT_ifloor(STBTT_FIX * -dxdy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02753"></a><span class="lineno"> 2753</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02754"></a><span class="lineno"> 2754</span>&#160;      z-&gt;dx = STBTT_ifloor(STBTT_FIX * dxdy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02755"></a><span class="lineno"> 2755</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02756"></a><span class="lineno"> 2756</span>&#160;   z-&gt;x = STBTT_ifloor(STBTT_FIX * e-&gt;x0 + z-&gt;dx * (start_point - e-&gt;y0)); <span class="comment">// use z-&gt;dx so when we offset later it&#39;s by the same amount</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02757"></a><span class="lineno"> 2757</span>&#160;   z-&gt;x -= off_x * STBTT_FIX;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02758"></a><span class="lineno"> 2758</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02759"></a><span class="lineno"> 2759</span>&#160;   z-&gt;ey = e-&gt;y1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02760"></a><span class="lineno"> 2760</span>&#160;   z-&gt;next = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02761"></a><span class="lineno"> 2761</span>&#160;   z-&gt;direction = e-&gt;invert ? 1 : -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02762"></a><span class="lineno"> 2762</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> z;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02763"></a><span class="lineno"> 2763</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02764"></a><span class="lineno"> 2764</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#elif STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 2</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02765"></a><span class="lineno"> 2765</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> stbtt__active_edge *stbtt__new_active(stbtt__hheap *hh, stbtt__edge *e, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> off_x, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> start_point, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02766"></a><span class="lineno"> 2766</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02767"></a><span class="lineno"> 2767</span>&#160;   stbtt__active_edge *z = (stbtt__active_edge *) stbtt__hheap_alloc(hh, <span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(*z), userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02768"></a><span class="lineno"> 2768</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dxdy = (e-&gt;x1 - e-&gt;x0) / (e-&gt;y1 - e-&gt;y0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02769"></a><span class="lineno"> 2769</span>&#160;   STBTT_assert(z != NULL);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02770"></a><span class="lineno"> 2770</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">//STBTT_assert(e-&gt;y0 &lt;= start_point);</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02771"></a><span class="lineno"> 2771</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!z) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> z;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02772"></a><span class="lineno"> 2772</span>&#160;   z-&gt;fdx = dxdy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02773"></a><span class="lineno"> 2773</span>&#160;   z-&gt;fdy = dxdy != 0.0f ? (1.0f/dxdy) : 0.0f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02774"></a><span class="lineno"> 2774</span>&#160;   z-&gt;fx = e-&gt;x0 + dxdy * (start_point - e-&gt;y0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02775"></a><span class="lineno"> 2775</span>&#160;   z-&gt;fx -= off_x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02776"></a><span class="lineno"> 2776</span>&#160;   z-&gt;direction = e-&gt;invert ? 1.0f : -1.0f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02777"></a><span class="lineno"> 2777</span>&#160;   z-&gt;sy = e-&gt;y0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02778"></a><span class="lineno"> 2778</span>&#160;   z-&gt;ey = e-&gt;y1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02779"></a><span class="lineno"> 2779</span>&#160;   z-&gt;next = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02780"></a><span class="lineno"> 2780</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> z;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02781"></a><span class="lineno"> 2781</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02782"></a><span class="lineno"> 2782</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02783"></a><span class="lineno"> 2783</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#error &quot;Unrecognized value of STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION&quot;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02784"></a><span class="lineno"> 2784</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#endif</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02785"></a><span class="lineno"> 2785</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02786"></a><span class="lineno"> 2786</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#if STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02787"></a><span class="lineno"> 2787</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// note: this routine clips fills that extend off the edges... ideally this</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02788"></a><span class="lineno"> 2788</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// wouldn&#39;t happen, but it could happen if the truetype glyph bounding boxes</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02789"></a><span class="lineno"> 2789</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// are wrong, or if the user supplies a too-small bitmap</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02790"></a><span class="lineno"> 2790</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__fill_active_edges(<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *scanline, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> len, stbtt__active_edge *e, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> max_weight)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02791"></a><span class="lineno"> 2791</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02792"></a><span class="lineno"> 2792</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// non-zero winding fill</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02793"></a><span class="lineno"> 2793</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x0=0, w=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02794"></a><span class="lineno"> 2794</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02795"></a><span class="lineno"> 2795</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (e) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02796"></a><span class="lineno"> 2796</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (w == 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02797"></a><span class="lineno"> 2797</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// if we&#39;re currently at zero, we need to record the edge start point</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02798"></a><span class="lineno"> 2798</span>&#160;         x0 = e-&gt;x; w += e-&gt;direction;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02799"></a><span class="lineno"> 2799</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02800"></a><span class="lineno"> 2800</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x1 = e-&gt;x; w += e-&gt;direction;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02801"></a><span class="lineno"> 2801</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// if we went to zero, we need to draw</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02802"></a><span class="lineno"> 2802</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (w == 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02803"></a><span class="lineno"> 2803</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i = x0 &gt;&gt; STBTT_FIXSHIFT;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02804"></a><span class="lineno"> 2804</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">int</span> j = x1 &gt;&gt; STBTT_FIXSHIFT;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02805"></a><span class="lineno"> 2805</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02806"></a><span class="lineno"> 2806</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i &lt; len &amp;&amp; j &gt;= 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02807"></a><span class="lineno"> 2807</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i == j) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02808"></a><span class="lineno"> 2808</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">// x0,x1 are the same pixel, so compute combined coverage</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02809"></a><span class="lineno"> 2809</span>&#160;                  scanline[i] = scanline[i] + (stbtt_uint8) ((x1 - x0) * max_weight &gt;&gt; STBTT_FIXSHIFT);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02810"></a><span class="lineno"> 2810</span>&#160;               } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02811"></a><span class="lineno"> 2811</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i &gt;= 0) <span class="comment">// add antialiasing for x0</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02812"></a><span class="lineno"> 2812</span>&#160;                     scanline[i] = scanline[i] + (stbtt_uint8) (((STBTT_FIX - (x0 &amp; STBTT_FIXMASK)) * max_weight) &gt;&gt; STBTT_FIXSHIFT);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02813"></a><span class="lineno"> 2813</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02814"></a><span class="lineno"> 2814</span>&#160;                     i = -1; <span class="comment">// clip</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02815"></a><span class="lineno"> 2815</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02816"></a><span class="lineno"> 2816</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (j &lt; len) <span class="comment">// add antialiasing for x1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02817"></a><span class="lineno"> 2817</span>&#160;                     scanline[j] = scanline[j] + (stbtt_uint8) (((x1 &amp; STBTT_FIXMASK) * max_weight) &gt;&gt; STBTT_FIXSHIFT);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02818"></a><span class="lineno"> 2818</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02819"></a><span class="lineno"> 2819</span>&#160;                     j = len; <span class="comment">// clip</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02820"></a><span class="lineno"> 2820</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02821"></a><span class="lineno"> 2821</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (++i; i &lt; j; ++i) <span class="comment">// fill pixels between x0 and x1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02822"></a><span class="lineno"> 2822</span>&#160;                     scanline[i] = scanline[i] + (stbtt_uint8) max_weight;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02823"></a><span class="lineno"> 2823</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02824"></a><span class="lineno"> 2824</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02825"></a><span class="lineno"> 2825</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02826"></a><span class="lineno"> 2826</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02827"></a><span class="lineno"> 2827</span>&#160;      </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02828"></a><span class="lineno"> 2828</span>&#160;      e = e-&gt;next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02829"></a><span class="lineno"> 2829</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02830"></a><span class="lineno"> 2830</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02831"></a><span class="lineno"> 2831</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02832"></a><span class="lineno"> 2832</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__rasterize_sorted_edges(<a class="code" href="structstbtt____bitmap.html">stbtt__bitmap</a> *result, stbtt__edge *e, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> vsubsample, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> off_x, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> off_y, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02833"></a><span class="lineno"> 2833</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02834"></a><span class="lineno"> 2834</span>&#160;   stbtt__hheap hh = { 0, 0, 0 };</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02835"></a><span class="lineno"> 2835</span>&#160;   stbtt__active_edge *active = NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02836"></a><span class="lineno"> 2836</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> y,j=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02837"></a><span class="lineno"> 2837</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> max_weight = (255 / vsubsample);  <span class="comment">// weight per vertical scanline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02838"></a><span class="lineno"> 2838</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> s; <span class="comment">// vertical subsample index</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02839"></a><span class="lineno"> 2839</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> scanline_data[512], *scanline;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02840"></a><span class="lineno"> 2840</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02841"></a><span class="lineno"> 2841</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (result-&gt;w &gt; 512)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02842"></a><span class="lineno"> 2842</span>&#160;      scanline = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *) STBTT_malloc(result-&gt;w, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02843"></a><span class="lineno"> 2843</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02844"></a><span class="lineno"> 2844</span>&#160;      scanline = scanline_data;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02845"></a><span class="lineno"> 2845</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02846"></a><span class="lineno"> 2846</span>&#160;   y = off_y * vsubsample;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02847"></a><span class="lineno"> 2847</span>&#160;   e[n].y0 = (off_y + result-&gt;h) * (<span class="keywordtype">float</span>) vsubsample + 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02848"></a><span class="lineno"> 2848</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02849"></a><span class="lineno"> 2849</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (j &lt; result-&gt;h) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02850"></a><span class="lineno"> 2850</span>&#160;      STBTT_memset(scanline, 0, result-&gt;w);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02851"></a><span class="lineno"> 2851</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (s=0; s &lt; vsubsample; ++s) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02852"></a><span class="lineno"> 2852</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// find center of pixel for this scanline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02853"></a><span class="lineno"> 2853</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scan_y = y + 0.5f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02854"></a><span class="lineno"> 2854</span>&#160;         stbtt__active_edge **step = &amp;active;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02855"></a><span class="lineno"> 2855</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02856"></a><span class="lineno"> 2856</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// update all active edges;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02857"></a><span class="lineno"> 2857</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// remove all active edges that terminate before the center of this scanline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02858"></a><span class="lineno"> 2858</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (*step) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02859"></a><span class="lineno"> 2859</span>&#160;            stbtt__active_edge * z = *step;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02860"></a><span class="lineno"> 2860</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (z-&gt;ey &lt;= scan_y) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02861"></a><span class="lineno"> 2861</span>&#160;               *step = z-&gt;next; <span class="comment">// delete from list</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02862"></a><span class="lineno"> 2862</span>&#160;               STBTT_assert(z-&gt;direction);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02863"></a><span class="lineno"> 2863</span>&#160;               z-&gt;direction = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02864"></a><span class="lineno"> 2864</span>&#160;               stbtt__hheap_free(&amp;hh, z);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02865"></a><span class="lineno"> 2865</span>&#160;            } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02866"></a><span class="lineno"> 2866</span>&#160;               z-&gt;x += z-&gt;dx; <span class="comment">// advance to position for current scanline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02867"></a><span class="lineno"> 2867</span>&#160;               step = &amp;((*step)-&gt;next); <span class="comment">// advance through list</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02868"></a><span class="lineno"> 2868</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02869"></a><span class="lineno"> 2869</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02870"></a><span class="lineno"> 2870</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02871"></a><span class="lineno"> 2871</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// resort the list if needed</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02872"></a><span class="lineno"> 2872</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">for</span>(;;) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02873"></a><span class="lineno"> 2873</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">int</span> changed=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02874"></a><span class="lineno"> 2874</span>&#160;            step = &amp;active;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02875"></a><span class="lineno"> 2875</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (*step &amp;&amp; (*step)-&gt;next) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02876"></a><span class="lineno"> 2876</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> ((*step)-&gt;x &gt; (*step)-&gt;next-&gt;x) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02877"></a><span class="lineno"> 2877</span>&#160;                  stbtt__active_edge *t = *step;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02878"></a><span class="lineno"> 2878</span>&#160;                  stbtt__active_edge *q = t-&gt;next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02879"></a><span class="lineno"> 2879</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02880"></a><span class="lineno"> 2880</span>&#160;                  t-&gt;next = q-&gt;next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02881"></a><span class="lineno"> 2881</span>&#160;                  q-&gt;next = t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02882"></a><span class="lineno"> 2882</span>&#160;                  *step = q;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02883"></a><span class="lineno"> 2883</span>&#160;                  changed = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02884"></a><span class="lineno"> 2884</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02885"></a><span class="lineno"> 2885</span>&#160;               step = &amp;(*step)-&gt;next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02886"></a><span class="lineno"> 2886</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02887"></a><span class="lineno"> 2887</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!changed) <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02888"></a><span class="lineno"> 2888</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02889"></a><span class="lineno"> 2889</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02890"></a><span class="lineno"> 2890</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// insert all edges that start before the center of this scanline -- omit ones that also end on this scanline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02891"></a><span class="lineno"> 2891</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (e-&gt;y0 &lt;= scan_y) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02892"></a><span class="lineno"> 2892</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (e-&gt;y1 &gt; scan_y) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02893"></a><span class="lineno"> 2893</span>&#160;               stbtt__active_edge *z = stbtt__new_active(&amp;hh, e, off_x, scan_y, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02894"></a><span class="lineno"> 2894</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (z != NULL) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02895"></a><span class="lineno"> 2895</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">// find insertion point</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02896"></a><span class="lineno"> 2896</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (active == NULL)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02897"></a><span class="lineno"> 2897</span>&#160;                     active = z;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02898"></a><span class="lineno"> 2898</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (z-&gt;x &lt; active-&gt;x) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02899"></a><span class="lineno"> 2899</span>&#160;                     <span class="comment">// insert at front</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02900"></a><span class="lineno"> 2900</span>&#160;                     z-&gt;next = active;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02901"></a><span class="lineno"> 2901</span>&#160;                     active = z;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02902"></a><span class="lineno"> 2902</span>&#160;                  } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02903"></a><span class="lineno"> 2903</span>&#160;                     <span class="comment">// find thing to insert AFTER</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02904"></a><span class="lineno"> 2904</span>&#160;                     stbtt__active_edge *p = active;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02905"></a><span class="lineno"> 2905</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (p-&gt;next &amp;&amp; p-&gt;next-&gt;x &lt; z-&gt;x)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02906"></a><span class="lineno"> 2906</span>&#160;                        p = p-&gt;next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02907"></a><span class="lineno"> 2907</span>&#160;                     <span class="comment">// at this point, p-&gt;next-&gt;x is NOT &lt; z-&gt;x</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02908"></a><span class="lineno"> 2908</span>&#160;                     z-&gt;next = p-&gt;next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02909"></a><span class="lineno"> 2909</span>&#160;                     p-&gt;next = z;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02910"></a><span class="lineno"> 2910</span>&#160;                  }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02911"></a><span class="lineno"> 2911</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02912"></a><span class="lineno"> 2912</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02913"></a><span class="lineno"> 2913</span>&#160;            ++e;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02914"></a><span class="lineno"> 2914</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02915"></a><span class="lineno"> 2915</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02916"></a><span class="lineno"> 2916</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// now process all active edges in XOR fashion</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02917"></a><span class="lineno"> 2917</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (active)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02918"></a><span class="lineno"> 2918</span>&#160;            stbtt__fill_active_edges(scanline, result-&gt;w, active, max_weight);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02919"></a><span class="lineno"> 2919</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02920"></a><span class="lineno"> 2920</span>&#160;         ++y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02921"></a><span class="lineno"> 2921</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02922"></a><span class="lineno"> 2922</span>&#160;      STBTT_memcpy(result-&gt;pixels + j * result-&gt;stride, scanline, result-&gt;w);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02923"></a><span class="lineno"> 2923</span>&#160;      ++j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02924"></a><span class="lineno"> 2924</span>&#160;   }</div>
