<div class="line"><a name="l02925"></a><span class="lineno"> 2925</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02926"></a><span class="lineno"> 2926</span>&#160;   stbtt__hheap_cleanup(&amp;hh, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02927"></a><span class="lineno"> 2927</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02928"></a><span class="lineno"> 2928</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (scanline != scanline_data)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02929"></a><span class="lineno"> 2929</span>&#160;      STBTT_free(scanline, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02930"></a><span class="lineno"> 2930</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02931"></a><span class="lineno"> 2931</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02932"></a><span class="lineno"> 2932</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#elif STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 2</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02933"></a><span class="lineno"> 2933</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02934"></a><span class="lineno"> 2934</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// the edge passed in here does not cross the vertical line at x or the vertical line at x+1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02935"></a><span class="lineno"> 2935</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// (i.e. it has already been clipped to those)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02936"></a><span class="lineno"> 2936</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(<span class="keywordtype">float</span> *scanline, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x, stbtt__active_edge *e, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x0, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y0, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x1, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y1)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02937"></a><span class="lineno"> 2937</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02938"></a><span class="lineno"> 2938</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y0 == y1) <span class="keywordflow">return</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02939"></a><span class="lineno"> 2939</span>&#160;   STBTT_assert(y0 &lt; y1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02940"></a><span class="lineno"> 2940</span>&#160;   STBTT_assert(e-&gt;sy &lt;= e-&gt;ey);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02941"></a><span class="lineno"> 2941</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y0 &gt; e-&gt;ey) <span class="keywordflow">return</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02942"></a><span class="lineno"> 2942</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y1 &lt; e-&gt;sy) <span class="keywordflow">return</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02943"></a><span class="lineno"> 2943</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y0 &lt; e-&gt;sy) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02944"></a><span class="lineno"> 2944</span>&#160;      x0 += (x1-x0) * (e-&gt;sy - y0) / (y1-y0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02945"></a><span class="lineno"> 2945</span>&#160;      y0 = e-&gt;sy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02946"></a><span class="lineno"> 2946</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02947"></a><span class="lineno"> 2947</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y1 &gt; e-&gt;ey) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02948"></a><span class="lineno"> 2948</span>&#160;      x1 += (x1-x0) * (e-&gt;ey - y1) / (y1-y0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02949"></a><span class="lineno"> 2949</span>&#160;      y1 = e-&gt;ey;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02950"></a><span class="lineno"> 2950</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02951"></a><span class="lineno"> 2951</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02952"></a><span class="lineno"> 2952</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 == x)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02953"></a><span class="lineno"> 2953</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(x1 &lt;= x+1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02954"></a><span class="lineno"> 2954</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 == x+1)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02955"></a><span class="lineno"> 2955</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(x1 &gt;= x);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02956"></a><span class="lineno"> 2956</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 &lt;= x)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02957"></a><span class="lineno"> 2957</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(x1 &lt;= x);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02958"></a><span class="lineno"> 2958</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 &gt;= x+1)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02959"></a><span class="lineno"> 2959</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(x1 &gt;= x+1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02960"></a><span class="lineno"> 2960</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02961"></a><span class="lineno"> 2961</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(x1 &gt;= x &amp;&amp; x1 &lt;= x+1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02962"></a><span class="lineno"> 2962</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02963"></a><span class="lineno"> 2963</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 &lt;= x &amp;&amp; x1 &lt;= x)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02964"></a><span class="lineno"> 2964</span>&#160;      scanline[x] += e-&gt;direction * (y1-y0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02965"></a><span class="lineno"> 2965</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 &gt;= x+1 &amp;&amp; x1 &gt;= x+1)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02966"></a><span class="lineno"> 2966</span>&#160;      ;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02967"></a><span class="lineno"> 2967</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02968"></a><span class="lineno"> 2968</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(x0 &gt;= x &amp;&amp; x0 &lt;= x+1 &amp;&amp; x1 &gt;= x &amp;&amp; x1 &lt;= x+1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02969"></a><span class="lineno"> 2969</span>&#160;      scanline[x] += e-&gt;direction * (y1-y0) * (1-((x0-x)+(x1-x))/2); <span class="comment">// coverage = 1 - average x position</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02970"></a><span class="lineno"> 2970</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02971"></a><span class="lineno"> 2971</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02972"></a><span class="lineno"> 2972</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02973"></a><span class="lineno"> 2973</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__fill_active_edges_new(<span class="keywordtype">float</span> *scanline, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *scanline_fill, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> len, stbtt__active_edge *e, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y_top)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02974"></a><span class="lineno"> 2974</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02975"></a><span class="lineno"> 2975</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y_bottom = y_top+1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02976"></a><span class="lineno"> 2976</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02977"></a><span class="lineno"> 2977</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (e) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02978"></a><span class="lineno"> 2978</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// brute force every pixel</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02979"></a><span class="lineno"> 2979</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02980"></a><span class="lineno"> 2980</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// compute intersection points with top &amp; bottom</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02981"></a><span class="lineno"> 2981</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(e-&gt;ey &gt;= y_top);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02982"></a><span class="lineno"> 2982</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02983"></a><span class="lineno"> 2983</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (e-&gt;fdx == 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02984"></a><span class="lineno"> 2984</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x0 = e-&gt;fx;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02985"></a><span class="lineno"> 2985</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 &lt; len) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02986"></a><span class="lineno"> 2986</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 &gt;= 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02987"></a><span class="lineno"> 2987</span>&#160;               stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,(<span class="keywordtype">int</span>) x0,e, x0,y_top, x0,y_bottom);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02988"></a><span class="lineno"> 2988</span>&#160;               stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline_fill-1,(<span class="keywordtype">int</span>) x0+1,e, x0,y_top, x0,y_bottom);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02989"></a><span class="lineno"> 2989</span>&#160;            } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02990"></a><span class="lineno"> 2990</span>&#160;               stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline_fill-1,0,e, x0,y_top, x0,y_bottom);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02991"></a><span class="lineno"> 2991</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02992"></a><span class="lineno"> 2992</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02993"></a><span class="lineno"> 2993</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02994"></a><span class="lineno"> 2994</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x0 = e-&gt;fx;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02995"></a><span class="lineno"> 2995</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dx = e-&gt;fdx;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02996"></a><span class="lineno"> 2996</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> xb = x0 + dx;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02997"></a><span class="lineno"> 2997</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x_top, x_bottom;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02998"></a><span class="lineno"> 2998</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> sy0,sy1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l02999"></a><span class="lineno"> 2999</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dy = e-&gt;fdy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03000"></a><span class="lineno"> 3000</span>&#160;         STBTT_assert(e-&gt;sy &lt;= y_bottom &amp;&amp; e-&gt;ey &gt;= y_top);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03001"></a><span class="lineno"> 3001</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03002"></a><span class="lineno"> 3002</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// compute endpoints of line segment clipped to this scanline (if the</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03003"></a><span class="lineno"> 3003</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// line segment starts on this scanline. x0 is the intersection of the</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03004"></a><span class="lineno"> 3004</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// line with y_top, but that may be off the line segment.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03005"></a><span class="lineno"> 3005</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (e-&gt;sy &gt; y_top) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03006"></a><span class="lineno"> 3006</span>&#160;            x_top = x0 + dx * (e-&gt;sy - y_top);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03007"></a><span class="lineno"> 3007</span>&#160;            sy0 = e-&gt;sy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03008"></a><span class="lineno"> 3008</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03009"></a><span class="lineno"> 3009</span>&#160;            x_top = x0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03010"></a><span class="lineno"> 3010</span>&#160;            sy0 = y_top;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03011"></a><span class="lineno"> 3011</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03012"></a><span class="lineno"> 3012</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (e-&gt;ey &lt; y_bottom) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03013"></a><span class="lineno"> 3013</span>&#160;            x_bottom = x0 + dx * (e-&gt;ey - y_top);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03014"></a><span class="lineno"> 3014</span>&#160;            sy1 = e-&gt;ey;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03015"></a><span class="lineno"> 3015</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03016"></a><span class="lineno"> 3016</span>&#160;            x_bottom = xb;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03017"></a><span class="lineno"> 3017</span>&#160;            sy1 = y_bottom;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03018"></a><span class="lineno"> 3018</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03019"></a><span class="lineno"> 3019</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03020"></a><span class="lineno"> 3020</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x_top &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; x_bottom &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; x_top &lt; len &amp;&amp; x_bottom &lt; len) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03021"></a><span class="lineno"> 3021</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// from here on, we don&#39;t have to range check x values</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03022"></a><span class="lineno"> 3022</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03023"></a><span class="lineno"> 3023</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> ((<span class="keywordtype">int</span>) x_top == (int) x_bottom) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03024"></a><span class="lineno"> 3024</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> height;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03025"></a><span class="lineno"> 3025</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// simple case, only spans one pixel</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03026"></a><span class="lineno"> 3026</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x = (int) x_top;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03027"></a><span class="lineno"> 3027</span>&#160;               height = sy1 - sy0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03028"></a><span class="lineno"> 3028</span>&#160;               STBTT_assert(x &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; x &lt; len);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03029"></a><span class="lineno"> 3029</span>&#160;               scanline[x] += e-&gt;direction * (1-((x_top - x) + (x_bottom-x))/2)  * height;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03030"></a><span class="lineno"> 3030</span>&#160;               scanline_fill[x] += e-&gt;direction * height; <span class="comment">// everything right of this pixel is filled</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03031"></a><span class="lineno"> 3031</span>&#160;            } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03032"></a><span class="lineno"> 3032</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x,x1,x2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03033"></a><span class="lineno"> 3033</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y_crossing, step, sign, area;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03034"></a><span class="lineno"> 3034</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// covers 2+ pixels</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03035"></a><span class="lineno"> 3035</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x_top &gt; x_bottom) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03036"></a><span class="lineno"> 3036</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">// flip scanline vertically; signed area is the same</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03037"></a><span class="lineno"> 3037</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03038"></a><span class="lineno"> 3038</span>&#160;                  sy0 = y_bottom - (sy0 - y_top);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03039"></a><span class="lineno"> 3039</span>&#160;                  sy1 = y_bottom - (sy1 - y_top);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03040"></a><span class="lineno"> 3040</span>&#160;                  t = sy0, sy0 = sy1, sy1 = t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03041"></a><span class="lineno"> 3041</span>&#160;                  t = x_bottom, x_bottom = x_top, x_top = t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03042"></a><span class="lineno"> 3042</span>&#160;                  dx = -dx;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03043"></a><span class="lineno"> 3043</span>&#160;                  dy = -dy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03044"></a><span class="lineno"> 3044</span>&#160;                  t = x0, x0 = xb, xb = t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03045"></a><span class="lineno"> 3045</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">// [DEAR IMGUI] Fix static analyzer warning</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03046"></a><span class="lineno"> 3046</span>&#160;                  (void)dx; <span class="comment">// [ImGui: fix static analyzer warning]</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03047"></a><span class="lineno"> 3047</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03048"></a><span class="lineno"> 3048</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03049"></a><span class="lineno"> 3049</span>&#160;               x1 = (int) x_top;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03050"></a><span class="lineno"> 3050</span>&#160;               x2 = (int) x_bottom;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03051"></a><span class="lineno"> 3051</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// compute intersection with y axis at x1+1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03052"></a><span class="lineno"> 3052</span>&#160;               y_crossing = (x1+1 - x0) * dy + y_top;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03053"></a><span class="lineno"> 3053</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03054"></a><span class="lineno"> 3054</span>&#160;               sign = e-&gt;direction;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03055"></a><span class="lineno"> 3055</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// area of the rectangle covered from y0..y_crossing</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03056"></a><span class="lineno"> 3056</span>&#160;               area = sign * (y_crossing-sy0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03057"></a><span class="lineno"> 3057</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// area of the triangle (x_top,y0), (x+1,y0), (x+1,y_crossing)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03058"></a><span class="lineno"> 3058</span>&#160;               scanline[x1] += area * (1-((x_top - x1)+(x1+1-x1))/2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03059"></a><span class="lineno"> 3059</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03060"></a><span class="lineno"> 3060</span>&#160;               step = sign * dy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03061"></a><span class="lineno"> 3061</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (x = x1+1; x &lt; x2; ++x) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03062"></a><span class="lineno"> 3062</span>&#160;                  scanline[x] += area + step/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03063"></a><span class="lineno"> 3063</span>&#160;                  area += step;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03064"></a><span class="lineno"> 3064</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03065"></a><span class="lineno"> 3065</span>&#160;               y_crossing += dy * (x2 - (x1+1));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03066"></a><span class="lineno"> 3066</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03067"></a><span class="lineno"> 3067</span>&#160;               STBTT_assert(STBTT_fabs(area) &lt;= 1.01f);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03068"></a><span class="lineno"> 3068</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03069"></a><span class="lineno"> 3069</span>&#160;               scanline[x2] += area + sign * (1-((x2-x2)+(x_bottom-x2))/2) * (sy1-y_crossing);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03070"></a><span class="lineno"> 3070</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03071"></a><span class="lineno"> 3071</span>&#160;               scanline_fill[x2] += sign * (sy1-sy0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03072"></a><span class="lineno"> 3072</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03073"></a><span class="lineno"> 3073</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03074"></a><span class="lineno"> 3074</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// if edge goes outside of box we&#39;re drawing, we require</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03075"></a><span class="lineno"> 3075</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// clipping logic. since this does not match the intended use</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03076"></a><span class="lineno"> 3076</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// of this library, we use a different, very slow brute</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03077"></a><span class="lineno"> 3077</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// force implementation</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03078"></a><span class="lineno"> 3078</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03079"></a><span class="lineno"> 3079</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (x=0; x &lt; len; ++x) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03080"></a><span class="lineno"> 3080</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// cases:</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03081"></a><span class="lineno"> 3081</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03082"></a><span class="lineno"> 3082</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// there can be up to two intersections with the pixel. any intersection</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03083"></a><span class="lineno"> 3083</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// with left or right edges can be handled by splitting into two (or three)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03084"></a><span class="lineno"> 3084</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// regions. intersections with top &amp; bottom do not necessitate case-wise logic.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03085"></a><span class="lineno"> 3085</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03086"></a><span class="lineno"> 3086</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// the old way of doing this found the intersections with the left &amp; right edges,</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03087"></a><span class="lineno"> 3087</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// then used some simple logic to produce up to three segments in sorted order</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03088"></a><span class="lineno"> 3088</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// from top-to-bottom. however, this had a problem: if an x edge was epsilon</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03089"></a><span class="lineno"> 3089</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// across the x border, then the corresponding y position might not be distinct</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03090"></a><span class="lineno"> 3090</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// from the other y segment, and it might ignored as an empty segment. to avoid</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03091"></a><span class="lineno"> 3091</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// that, we need to explicitly produce segments based on x positions.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03092"></a><span class="lineno"> 3092</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03093"></a><span class="lineno"> 3093</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// rename variables to clearly-defined pairs</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03094"></a><span class="lineno"> 3094</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y0 = y_top;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03095"></a><span class="lineno"> 3095</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x1 = (float) (x);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03096"></a><span class="lineno"> 3096</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x2 = (float) (x+1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03097"></a><span class="lineno"> 3097</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x3 = xb;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03098"></a><span class="lineno"> 3098</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y3 = y_bottom;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03099"></a><span class="lineno"> 3099</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03100"></a><span class="lineno"> 3100</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// x = e-&gt;x + e-&gt;dx * (y-y_top)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03101"></a><span class="lineno"> 3101</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// (y-y_top) = (x - e-&gt;x) / e-&gt;dx</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03102"></a><span class="lineno"> 3102</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// y = (x - e-&gt;x) / e-&gt;dx + y_top</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03103"></a><span class="lineno"> 3103</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y1 = (x - x0) / dx + y_top;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03104"></a><span class="lineno"> 3104</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y2 = (x+1 - x0) / dx + y_top;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03105"></a><span class="lineno"> 3105</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03106"></a><span class="lineno"> 3106</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 &lt; x1 &amp;&amp; x3 &gt; x2) {         <span class="comment">// three segments descending down-right</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03107"></a><span class="lineno"> 3107</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x0,y0, x1,y1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03108"></a><span class="lineno"> 3108</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x1,y1, x2,y2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03109"></a><span class="lineno"> 3109</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x2,y2, x3,y3);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03110"></a><span class="lineno"> 3110</span>&#160;               } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x3 &lt; x1 &amp;&amp; x0 &gt; x2) {  <span class="comment">// three segments descending down-left</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03111"></a><span class="lineno"> 3111</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x0,y0, x2,y2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03112"></a><span class="lineno"> 3112</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x2,y2, x1,y1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03113"></a><span class="lineno"> 3113</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x1,y1, x3,y3);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03114"></a><span class="lineno"> 3114</span>&#160;               } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 &lt; x1 &amp;&amp; x3 &gt; x1) {  <span class="comment">// two segments across x, down-right</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03115"></a><span class="lineno"> 3115</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x0,y0, x1,y1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03116"></a><span class="lineno"> 3116</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x1,y1, x3,y3);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03117"></a><span class="lineno"> 3117</span>&#160;               } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x3 &lt; x1 &amp;&amp; x0 &gt; x1) {  <span class="comment">// two segments across x, down-left</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03118"></a><span class="lineno"> 3118</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x0,y0, x1,y1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03119"></a><span class="lineno"> 3119</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x1,y1, x3,y3);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03120"></a><span class="lineno"> 3120</span>&#160;               } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x0 &lt; x2 &amp;&amp; x3 &gt; x2) {  <span class="comment">// two segments across x+1, down-right</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03121"></a><span class="lineno"> 3121</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x0,y0, x2,y2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03122"></a><span class="lineno"> 3122</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x2,y2, x3,y3);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03123"></a><span class="lineno"> 3123</span>&#160;               } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x3 &lt; x2 &amp;&amp; x0 &gt; x2) {  <span class="comment">// two segments across x+1, down-left</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03124"></a><span class="lineno"> 3124</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x0,y0, x2,y2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03125"></a><span class="lineno"> 3125</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x2,y2, x3,y3);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03126"></a><span class="lineno"> 3126</span>&#160;               } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {  <span class="comment">// one segment</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03127"></a><span class="lineno"> 3127</span>&#160;                  stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline,x,e, x0,y0, x3,y3);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03128"></a><span class="lineno"> 3128</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03129"></a><span class="lineno"> 3129</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03130"></a><span class="lineno"> 3130</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03131"></a><span class="lineno"> 3131</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03132"></a><span class="lineno"> 3132</span>&#160;      e = e-&gt;next;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03133"></a><span class="lineno"> 3133</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03134"></a><span class="lineno"> 3134</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03135"></a><span class="lineno"> 3135</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03136"></a><span class="lineno"> 3136</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// directly AA rasterize edges w/o supersampling</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03137"></a><span class="lineno"> 3137</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__rasterize_sorted_edges(<a class="code" href="structstbtt____bitmap.html">stbtt__bitmap</a> *result, stbtt__edge *e, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> vsubsample, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> off_x, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> off_y, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03138"></a><span class="lineno"> 3138</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03139"></a><span class="lineno"> 3139</span>&#160;   stbtt__hheap hh = { 0, 0, 0 };</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03140"></a><span class="lineno"> 3140</span>&#160;   stbtt__active_edge *active = NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03141"></a><span class="lineno"> 3141</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> y,j=0, i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03142"></a><span class="lineno"> 3142</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scanline_data[129], *scanline, *scanline2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03143"></a><span class="lineno"> 3143</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03144"></a><span class="lineno"> 3144</span>&#160;   STBTT__NOTUSED(vsubsample);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03145"></a><span class="lineno"> 3145</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03146"></a><span class="lineno"> 3146</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (result-&gt;w &gt; 64)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03147"></a><span class="lineno"> 3147</span>&#160;      scanline = (<span class="keywordtype">float</span> *) STBTT_malloc((result-&gt;w*2+1) * <span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(float), userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03148"></a><span class="lineno"> 3148</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03149"></a><span class="lineno"> 3149</span>&#160;      scanline = scanline_data;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03150"></a><span class="lineno"> 3150</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03151"></a><span class="lineno"> 3151</span>&#160;   scanline2 = scanline + result-&gt;w;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03152"></a><span class="lineno"> 3152</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03153"></a><span class="lineno"> 3153</span>&#160;   y = off_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03154"></a><span class="lineno"> 3154</span>&#160;   e[n].y0 = (float) (off_y + result-&gt;h) + 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03155"></a><span class="lineno"> 3155</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03156"></a><span class="lineno"> 3156</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (j &lt; result-&gt;h) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03157"></a><span class="lineno"> 3157</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// find center of pixel for this scanline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03158"></a><span class="lineno"> 3158</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scan_y_top    = y + 0.0f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03159"></a><span class="lineno"> 3159</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scan_y_bottom = y + 1.0f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03160"></a><span class="lineno"> 3160</span>&#160;      stbtt__active_edge **step = &amp;active;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03161"></a><span class="lineno"> 3161</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03162"></a><span class="lineno"> 3162</span>&#160;      STBTT_memset(scanline , 0, result-&gt;w*<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(scanline[0]));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03163"></a><span class="lineno"> 3163</span>&#160;      STBTT_memset(scanline2, 0, (result-&gt;w+1)*<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(scanline[0]));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03164"></a><span class="lineno"> 3164</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03165"></a><span class="lineno"> 3165</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// update all active edges;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03166"></a><span class="lineno"> 3166</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// remove all active edges that terminate before the top of this scanline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03167"></a><span class="lineno"> 3167</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (*step) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03168"></a><span class="lineno"> 3168</span>&#160;         stbtt__active_edge * z = *step;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03169"></a><span class="lineno"> 3169</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (z-&gt;ey &lt;= scan_y_top) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03170"></a><span class="lineno"> 3170</span>&#160;            *step = z-&gt;next; <span class="comment">// delete from list</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03171"></a><span class="lineno"> 3171</span>&#160;            STBTT_assert(z-&gt;direction);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03172"></a><span class="lineno"> 3172</span>&#160;            z-&gt;direction = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03173"></a><span class="lineno"> 3173</span>&#160;            stbtt__hheap_free(&amp;hh, z);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03174"></a><span class="lineno"> 3174</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03175"></a><span class="lineno"> 3175</span>&#160;            step = &amp;((*step)-&gt;next); <span class="comment">// advance through list</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03176"></a><span class="lineno"> 3176</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03177"></a><span class="lineno"> 3177</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03178"></a><span class="lineno"> 3178</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03179"></a><span class="lineno"> 3179</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// insert all edges that start before the bottom of this scanline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03180"></a><span class="lineno"> 3180</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (e-&gt;y0 &lt;= scan_y_bottom) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03181"></a><span class="lineno"> 3181</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (e-&gt;y0 != e-&gt;y1) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03182"></a><span class="lineno"> 3182</span>&#160;            stbtt__active_edge *z = stbtt__new_active(&amp;hh, e, off_x, scan_y_top, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03183"></a><span class="lineno"> 3183</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (z != NULL) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03184"></a><span class="lineno"> 3184</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (j == 0 &amp;&amp; off_y != 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03185"></a><span class="lineno"> 3185</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (z-&gt;ey &lt; scan_y_top) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03186"></a><span class="lineno"> 3186</span>&#160;                     <span class="comment">// this can happen due to subpixel positioning and some kind of fp rounding error i think</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03187"></a><span class="lineno"> 3187</span>&#160;                     z-&gt;ey = scan_y_top;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03188"></a><span class="lineno"> 3188</span>&#160;                  }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03189"></a><span class="lineno"> 3189</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03190"></a><span class="lineno"> 3190</span>&#160;               STBTT_assert(z-&gt;ey &gt;= scan_y_top); <span class="comment">// if we get really unlucky a tiny bit of an edge can be out of bounds</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03191"></a><span class="lineno"> 3191</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// insert at front</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03192"></a><span class="lineno"> 3192</span>&#160;               z-&gt;next = active;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03193"></a><span class="lineno"> 3193</span>&#160;               active = z;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03194"></a><span class="lineno"> 3194</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03195"></a><span class="lineno"> 3195</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03196"></a><span class="lineno"> 3196</span>&#160;         ++e;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03197"></a><span class="lineno"> 3197</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03198"></a><span class="lineno"> 3198</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03199"></a><span class="lineno"> 3199</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// now process all active edges</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03200"></a><span class="lineno"> 3200</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (active)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03201"></a><span class="lineno"> 3201</span>&#160;         stbtt__fill_active_edges_new(scanline, scanline2+1, result-&gt;w, active, scan_y_top);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03202"></a><span class="lineno"> 3202</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03203"></a><span class="lineno"> 3203</span>&#160;      {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03204"></a><span class="lineno"> 3204</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> sum = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03205"></a><span class="lineno"> 3205</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; result-&gt;w; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03206"></a><span class="lineno"> 3206</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> k;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03207"></a><span class="lineno"> 3207</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">int</span> m;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03208"></a><span class="lineno"> 3208</span>&#160;            sum += scanline2[i];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03209"></a><span class="lineno"> 3209</span>&#160;            k = scanline[i] + sum;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03210"></a><span class="lineno"> 3210</span>&#160;            k = (float) STBTT_fabs(k)*255 + 0.5f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03211"></a><span class="lineno"> 3211</span>&#160;            m = (int) k;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03212"></a><span class="lineno"> 3212</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (m &gt; 255) m = 255;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03213"></a><span class="lineno"> 3213</span>&#160;            result-&gt;pixels[j*result-&gt;stride + i] = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> char) m;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03214"></a><span class="lineno"> 3214</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03215"></a><span class="lineno"> 3215</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03216"></a><span class="lineno"> 3216</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// advance all the edges</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03217"></a><span class="lineno"> 3217</span>&#160;      step = &amp;active;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03218"></a><span class="lineno"> 3218</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (*step) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03219"></a><span class="lineno"> 3219</span>&#160;         stbtt__active_edge *z = *step;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03220"></a><span class="lineno"> 3220</span>&#160;         z-&gt;fx += z-&gt;fdx; <span class="comment">// advance to position for current scanline</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03221"></a><span class="lineno"> 3221</span>&#160;         step = &amp;((*step)-&gt;next); <span class="comment">// advance through list</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03222"></a><span class="lineno"> 3222</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03223"></a><span class="lineno"> 3223</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03224"></a><span class="lineno"> 3224</span>&#160;      ++y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03225"></a><span class="lineno"> 3225</span>&#160;      ++j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03226"></a><span class="lineno"> 3226</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03227"></a><span class="lineno"> 3227</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03228"></a><span class="lineno"> 3228</span>&#160;   stbtt__hheap_cleanup(&amp;hh, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03229"></a><span class="lineno"> 3229</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03230"></a><span class="lineno"> 3230</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (scanline != scanline_data)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03231"></a><span class="lineno"> 3231</span>&#160;      STBTT_free(scanline, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03232"></a><span class="lineno"> 3232</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03233"></a><span class="lineno"> 3233</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03234"></a><span class="lineno"> 3234</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#error &quot;Unrecognized value of STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION&quot;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03235"></a><span class="lineno"> 3235</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#endif</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03236"></a><span class="lineno"> 3236</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03237"></a><span class="lineno"> 3237</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT__COMPARE(a,b)  ((a)-&gt;y0 &lt; (b)-&gt;y0)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03238"></a><span class="lineno"> 3238</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03239"></a><span class="lineno"> 3239</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__sort_edges_ins_sort(stbtt__edge *p, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03240"></a><span class="lineno"> 3240</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03241"></a><span class="lineno"> 3241</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i,j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03242"></a><span class="lineno"> 3242</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=1; i &lt; n; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03243"></a><span class="lineno"> 3243</span>&#160;      stbtt__edge t = p[i], *a = &amp;t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03244"></a><span class="lineno"> 3244</span>&#160;      j = i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03245"></a><span class="lineno"> 3245</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (j &gt; 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03246"></a><span class="lineno"> 3246</span>&#160;         stbtt__edge *b = &amp;p[j-1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03247"></a><span class="lineno"> 3247</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> c = STBTT__COMPARE(a,b);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03248"></a><span class="lineno"> 3248</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!c) <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03249"></a><span class="lineno"> 3249</span>&#160;         p[j] = p[j-1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03250"></a><span class="lineno"> 3250</span>&#160;         --j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03251"></a><span class="lineno"> 3251</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03252"></a><span class="lineno"> 3252</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i != j)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03253"></a><span class="lineno"> 3253</span>&#160;         p[j] = t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03254"></a><span class="lineno"> 3254</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03255"></a><span class="lineno"> 3255</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03256"></a><span class="lineno"> 3256</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03257"></a><span class="lineno"> 3257</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__sort_edges_quicksort(stbtt__edge *p, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03258"></a><span class="lineno"> 3258</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03259"></a><span class="lineno"> 3259</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">/* threshold for transitioning to insertion sort */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03260"></a><span class="lineno"> 3260</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (n &gt; 12) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03261"></a><span class="lineno"> 3261</span>&#160;      stbtt__edge t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03262"></a><span class="lineno"> 3262</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">int</span> c01,c12,c,m,i,j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03263"></a><span class="lineno"> 3263</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03264"></a><span class="lineno"> 3264</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">/* compute median of three */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03265"></a><span class="lineno"> 3265</span>&#160;      m = n &gt;&gt; 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03266"></a><span class="lineno"> 3266</span>&#160;      c01 = STBTT__COMPARE(&amp;p[0],&amp;p[m]);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03267"></a><span class="lineno"> 3267</span>&#160;      c12 = STBTT__COMPARE(&amp;p[m],&amp;p[n-1]);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03268"></a><span class="lineno"> 3268</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">/* if 0 &gt;= mid &gt;= end, or 0 &lt; mid &lt; end, then use mid */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03269"></a><span class="lineno"> 3269</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (c01 != c12) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03270"></a><span class="lineno"> 3270</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">/* otherwise, we&#39;ll need to swap something else to middle */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03271"></a><span class="lineno"> 3271</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> z;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03272"></a><span class="lineno"> 3272</span>&#160;         c = STBTT__COMPARE(&amp;p[0],&amp;p[n-1]);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03273"></a><span class="lineno"> 3273</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">/* 0&gt;mid &amp;&amp; mid&lt;n:  0&gt;n =&gt; n; 0&lt;n =&gt; 0 */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03274"></a><span class="lineno"> 3274</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">/* 0&lt;mid &amp;&amp; mid&gt;n:  0&gt;n =&gt; 0; 0&lt;n =&gt; n */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03275"></a><span class="lineno"> 3275</span>&#160;         z = (c == c12) ? 0 : n-1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03276"></a><span class="lineno"> 3276</span>&#160;         t = p[z];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03277"></a><span class="lineno"> 3277</span>&#160;         p[z] = p[m];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03278"></a><span class="lineno"> 3278</span>&#160;         p[m] = t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03279"></a><span class="lineno"> 3279</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03280"></a><span class="lineno"> 3280</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">/* now p[m] is the median-of-three */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03281"></a><span class="lineno"> 3281</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">/* swap it to the beginning so it won&#39;t move around */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03282"></a><span class="lineno"> 3282</span>&#160;      t = p[0];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03283"></a><span class="lineno"> 3283</span>&#160;      p[0] = p[m];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03284"></a><span class="lineno"> 3284</span>&#160;      p[m] = t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03285"></a><span class="lineno"> 3285</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03286"></a><span class="lineno"> 3286</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">/* partition loop */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03287"></a><span class="lineno"> 3287</span>&#160;      i=1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03288"></a><span class="lineno"> 3288</span>&#160;      j=n-1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03289"></a><span class="lineno"> 3289</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span>(;;) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03290"></a><span class="lineno"> 3290</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">/* handling of equality is crucial here */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03291"></a><span class="lineno"> 3291</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">/* for sentinels &amp; efficiency with duplicates */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03292"></a><span class="lineno"> 3292</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (;;++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03293"></a><span class="lineno"> 3293</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!STBTT__COMPARE(&amp;p[i], &amp;p[0])) <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03294"></a><span class="lineno"> 3294</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03295"></a><span class="lineno"> 3295</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (;;--j) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03296"></a><span class="lineno"> 3296</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!STBTT__COMPARE(&amp;p[0], &amp;p[j])) <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03297"></a><span class="lineno"> 3297</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03298"></a><span class="lineno"> 3298</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">/* make sure we haven&#39;t crossed */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03299"></a><span class="lineno"> 3299</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i &gt;= j) <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03300"></a><span class="lineno"> 3300</span>&#160;         t = p[i];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03301"></a><span class="lineno"> 3301</span>&#160;         p[i] = p[j];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03302"></a><span class="lineno"> 3302</span>&#160;         p[j] = t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03303"></a><span class="lineno"> 3303</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03304"></a><span class="lineno"> 3304</span>&#160;         ++i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03305"></a><span class="lineno"> 3305</span>&#160;         --j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03306"></a><span class="lineno"> 3306</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03307"></a><span class="lineno"> 3307</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">/* recurse on smaller side, iterate on larger */</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03308"></a><span class="lineno"> 3308</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (j &lt; (n-i)) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03309"></a><span class="lineno"> 3309</span>&#160;         stbtt__sort_edges_quicksort(p,j);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03310"></a><span class="lineno"> 3310</span>&#160;         p = p+i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03311"></a><span class="lineno"> 3311</span>&#160;         n = n-i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03312"></a><span class="lineno"> 3312</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03313"></a><span class="lineno"> 3313</span>&#160;         stbtt__sort_edges_quicksort(p+i, n-i);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03314"></a><span class="lineno"> 3314</span>&#160;         n = j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03315"></a><span class="lineno"> 3315</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03316"></a><span class="lineno"> 3316</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03317"></a><span class="lineno"> 3317</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03318"></a><span class="lineno"> 3318</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03319"></a><span class="lineno"> 3319</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__sort_edges(stbtt__edge *p, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03320"></a><span class="lineno"> 3320</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03321"></a><span class="lineno"> 3321</span>&#160;   stbtt__sort_edges_quicksort(p, n);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03322"></a><span class="lineno"> 3322</span>&#160;   stbtt__sort_edges_ins_sort(p, n);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03323"></a><span class="lineno"> 3323</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03324"></a><span class="lineno"> 3324</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03325"></a><span class="lineno"> 3325</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">typedef</span> <span class="keyword">struct</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03326"></a><span class="lineno"> 3326</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03327"></a><span class="lineno"> 3327</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x,y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03328"></a><span class="lineno"> 3328</span>&#160;} stbtt__point;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03329"></a><span class="lineno"> 3329</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03330"></a><span class="lineno"> 3330</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__rasterize(<a class="code" href="structstbtt____bitmap.html">stbtt__bitmap</a> *result, stbtt__point *pts, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *wcount, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> windings, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale_x, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale_y, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> shift_x, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> shift_y, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> off_x, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> off_y, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> invert, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03331"></a><span class="lineno"> 3331</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03332"></a><span class="lineno"> 3332</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y_scale_inv = invert ? -scale_y : scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03333"></a><span class="lineno"> 3333</span>&#160;   stbtt__edge *e;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03334"></a><span class="lineno"> 3334</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n,i,j,k,m;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03335"></a><span class="lineno"> 3335</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#if STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 1</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03336"></a><span class="lineno"> 3336</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> vsubsample = result-&gt;h &lt; 8 ? 15 : 5;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03337"></a><span class="lineno"> 3337</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#elif STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 2</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03338"></a><span class="lineno"> 3338</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> vsubsample = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03339"></a><span class="lineno"> 3339</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03340"></a><span class="lineno"> 3340</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">   #error &quot;Unrecognized value of STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION&quot;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03341"></a><span class="lineno"> 3341</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#endif</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03342"></a><span class="lineno"> 3342</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// vsubsample should divide 255 evenly; otherwise we won&#39;t reach full opacity</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03343"></a><span class="lineno"> 3343</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03344"></a><span class="lineno"> 3344</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// now we have to blow out the windings into explicit edge lists</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03345"></a><span class="lineno"> 3345</span>&#160;   n = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03346"></a><span class="lineno"> 3346</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; windings; ++i)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03347"></a><span class="lineno"> 3347</span>&#160;      n += wcount[i];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03348"></a><span class="lineno"> 3348</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03349"></a><span class="lineno"> 3349</span>&#160;   e = (stbtt__edge *) STBTT_malloc(<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(*e) * (n+1), userdata); <span class="comment">// add an extra one as a sentinel</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03350"></a><span class="lineno"> 3350</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (e == 0) <span class="keywordflow">return</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03351"></a><span class="lineno"> 3351</span>&#160;   n = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03352"></a><span class="lineno"> 3352</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03353"></a><span class="lineno"> 3353</span>&#160;   m=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03354"></a><span class="lineno"> 3354</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; windings; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03355"></a><span class="lineno"> 3355</span>&#160;      stbtt__point *p = pts + m;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03356"></a><span class="lineno"> 3356</span>&#160;      m += wcount[i];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03357"></a><span class="lineno"> 3357</span>&#160;      j = wcount[i]-1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03358"></a><span class="lineno"> 3358</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (k=0; k &lt; wcount[i]; j=k++) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03359"></a><span class="lineno"> 3359</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> a=k,b=j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03360"></a><span class="lineno"> 3360</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// skip the edge if horizontal</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03361"></a><span class="lineno"> 3361</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (p[j].y == p[k].y)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03362"></a><span class="lineno"> 3362</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">continue</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03363"></a><span class="lineno"> 3363</span>&#160;         <span class="comment">// add edge from j to k to the list</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03364"></a><span class="lineno"> 3364</span>&#160;         e[n].invert = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03365"></a><span class="lineno"> 3365</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (invert ? p[j].y &gt; p[k].y : p[j].y &lt; p[k].y) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03366"></a><span class="lineno"> 3366</span>&#160;            e[n].invert = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03367"></a><span class="lineno"> 3367</span>&#160;            a=j,b=k;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03368"></a><span class="lineno"> 3368</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03369"></a><span class="lineno"> 3369</span>&#160;         e[n].x0 = p[a].x * scale_x + shift_x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03370"></a><span class="lineno"> 3370</span>&#160;         e[n].y0 = (p[a].y * y_scale_inv + shift_y) * vsubsample;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03371"></a><span class="lineno"> 3371</span>&#160;         e[n].x1 = p[b].x * scale_x + shift_x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03372"></a><span class="lineno"> 3372</span>&#160;         e[n].y1 = (p[b].y * y_scale_inv + shift_y) * vsubsample;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03373"></a><span class="lineno"> 3373</span>&#160;         ++n;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03374"></a><span class="lineno"> 3374</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03375"></a><span class="lineno"> 3375</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03376"></a><span class="lineno"> 3376</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03377"></a><span class="lineno"> 3377</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// now sort the edges by their highest point (should snap to integer, and then by x)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03378"></a><span class="lineno"> 3378</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">//STBTT_sort(e, n, sizeof(e[0]), stbtt__edge_compare);</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03379"></a><span class="lineno"> 3379</span>&#160;   stbtt__sort_edges(e, n);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03380"></a><span class="lineno"> 3380</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03381"></a><span class="lineno"> 3381</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// now, traverse the scanlines and find the intersections on each scanline, use xor winding rule</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03382"></a><span class="lineno"> 3382</span>&#160;   stbtt__rasterize_sorted_edges(result, e, n, vsubsample, off_x, off_y, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03383"></a><span class="lineno"> 3383</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03384"></a><span class="lineno"> 3384</span>&#160;   STBTT_free(e, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03385"></a><span class="lineno"> 3385</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03386"></a><span class="lineno"> 3386</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03387"></a><span class="lineno"> 3387</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__add_point(stbtt__point *points, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03388"></a><span class="lineno"> 3388</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03389"></a><span class="lineno"> 3389</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!points) <span class="keywordflow">return</span>; <span class="comment">// during first pass, it&#39;s unallocated</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03390"></a><span class="lineno"> 3390</span>&#160;   points[n].x = x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03391"></a><span class="lineno"> 3391</span>&#160;   points[n].y = y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03392"></a><span class="lineno"> 3392</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03393"></a><span class="lineno"> 3393</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03394"></a><span class="lineno"> 3394</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// tessellate until threshold p is happy... @TODO warped to compensate for non-linear stretching</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03395"></a><span class="lineno"> 3395</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt__tesselate_curve(stbtt__point *points, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *num_points, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x0, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y0, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x1, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y1, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x2, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y2, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> objspace_flatness_squared, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03396"></a><span class="lineno"> 3396</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03397"></a><span class="lineno"> 3397</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// midpoint</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03398"></a><span class="lineno"> 3398</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> mx = (x0 + 2*x1 + x2)/4;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03399"></a><span class="lineno"> 3399</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> my = (y0 + 2*y1 + y2)/4;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03400"></a><span class="lineno"> 3400</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// versus directly drawn line</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03401"></a><span class="lineno"> 3401</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dx = (x0+x2)/2 - mx;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03402"></a><span class="lineno"> 3402</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dy = (y0+y2)/2 - my;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03403"></a><span class="lineno"> 3403</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (n &gt; 16) <span class="comment">// 65536 segments on one curve better be enough!</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03404"></a><span class="lineno"> 3404</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03405"></a><span class="lineno"> 3405</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (dx*dx+dy*dy &gt; objspace_flatness_squared) { <span class="comment">// half-pixel error allowed... need to be smaller if AA</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03406"></a><span class="lineno"> 3406</span>&#160;      stbtt__tesselate_curve(points, num_points, x0,y0, (x0+x1)/2.0f,(y0+y1)/2.0f, mx,my, objspace_flatness_squared,n+1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03407"></a><span class="lineno"> 3407</span>&#160;      stbtt__tesselate_curve(points, num_points, mx,my, (x1+x2)/2.0f,(y1+y2)/2.0f, x2,y2, objspace_flatness_squared,n+1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03408"></a><span class="lineno"> 3408</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03409"></a><span class="lineno"> 3409</span>&#160;      stbtt__add_point(points, *num_points,x2,y2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03410"></a><span class="lineno"> 3410</span>&#160;      *num_points = *num_points+1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03411"></a><span class="lineno"> 3411</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03412"></a><span class="lineno"> 3412</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03413"></a><span class="lineno"> 3413</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03414"></a><span class="lineno"> 3414</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03415"></a><span class="lineno"> 3415</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__tesselate_cubic(stbtt__point *points, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *num_points, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x0, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y0, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x1, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y1, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x2, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y2, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x3, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y3, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> objspace_flatness_squared, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> n)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03416"></a><span class="lineno"> 3416</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03417"></a><span class="lineno"> 3417</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// @TODO this &quot;flatness&quot; calculation is just made-up nonsense that seems to work well enough</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03418"></a><span class="lineno"> 3418</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dx0 = x1-x0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03419"></a><span class="lineno"> 3419</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dy0 = y1-y0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03420"></a><span class="lineno"> 3420</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dx1 = x2-x1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03421"></a><span class="lineno"> 3421</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dy1 = y2-y1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03422"></a><span class="lineno"> 3422</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dx2 = x3-x2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03423"></a><span class="lineno"> 3423</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dy2 = y3-y2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03424"></a><span class="lineno"> 3424</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dx = x3-x0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03425"></a><span class="lineno"> 3425</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dy = y3-y0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03426"></a><span class="lineno"> 3426</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> longlen = (float) (STBTT_sqrt(dx0*dx0+dy0*dy0)+STBTT_sqrt(dx1*dx1+dy1*dy1)+STBTT_sqrt(dx2*dx2+dy2*dy2));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03427"></a><span class="lineno"> 3427</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> shortlen = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03428"></a><span class="lineno"> 3428</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> flatness_squared = longlen*longlen-shortlen*shortlen;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03429"></a><span class="lineno"> 3429</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03430"></a><span class="lineno"> 3430</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (n &gt; 16) <span class="comment">// 65536 segments on one curve better be enough!</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03431"></a><span class="lineno"> 3431</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03432"></a><span class="lineno"> 3432</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03433"></a><span class="lineno"> 3433</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (flatness_squared &gt; objspace_flatness_squared) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03434"></a><span class="lineno"> 3434</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x01 = (x0+x1)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03435"></a><span class="lineno"> 3435</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y01 = (y0+y1)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03436"></a><span class="lineno"> 3436</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x12 = (x1+x2)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03437"></a><span class="lineno"> 3437</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y12 = (y1+y2)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03438"></a><span class="lineno"> 3438</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x23 = (x2+x3)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03439"></a><span class="lineno"> 3439</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y23 = (y2+y3)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03440"></a><span class="lineno"> 3440</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03441"></a><span class="lineno"> 3441</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> xa = (x01+x12)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03442"></a><span class="lineno"> 3442</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> ya = (y01+y12)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03443"></a><span class="lineno"> 3443</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> xb = (x12+x23)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03444"></a><span class="lineno"> 3444</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> yb = (y12+y23)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03445"></a><span class="lineno"> 3445</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03446"></a><span class="lineno"> 3446</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> mx = (xa+xb)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03447"></a><span class="lineno"> 3447</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> my = (ya+yb)/2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03448"></a><span class="lineno"> 3448</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03449"></a><span class="lineno"> 3449</span>&#160;      stbtt__tesselate_cubic(points, num_points, x0,y0, x01,y01, xa,ya, mx,my, objspace_flatness_squared,n+1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03450"></a><span class="lineno"> 3450</span>&#160;      stbtt__tesselate_cubic(points, num_points, mx,my, xb,yb, x23,y23, x3,y3, objspace_flatness_squared,n+1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03451"></a><span class="lineno"> 3451</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03452"></a><span class="lineno"> 3452</span>&#160;      stbtt__add_point(points, *num_points,x3,y3);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03453"></a><span class="lineno"> 3453</span>&#160;      *num_points = *num_points+1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03454"></a><span class="lineno"> 3454</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03455"></a><span class="lineno"> 3455</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03456"></a><span class="lineno"> 3456</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03457"></a><span class="lineno"> 3457</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// returns number of contours</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03458"></a><span class="lineno"> 3458</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> stbtt__point *stbtt_FlattenCurves(<a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a> *vertices, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_verts, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> objspace_flatness, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> **contour_lengths, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *num_contours, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03459"></a><span class="lineno"> 3459</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03460"></a><span class="lineno"> 3460</span>&#160;   stbtt__point *points=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03461"></a><span class="lineno"> 3461</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_points=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03462"></a><span class="lineno"> 3462</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03463"></a><span class="lineno"> 3463</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> objspace_flatness_squared = objspace_flatness * objspace_flatness;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03464"></a><span class="lineno"> 3464</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i,n=0,start=0, pass;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03465"></a><span class="lineno"> 3465</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03466"></a><span class="lineno"> 3466</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// count how many &quot;moves&quot; there are to get the contour count</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03467"></a><span class="lineno"> 3467</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; num_verts; ++i)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03468"></a><span class="lineno"> 3468</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (vertices[i].type == STBTT_vmove)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03469"></a><span class="lineno"> 3469</span>&#160;         ++n;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03470"></a><span class="lineno"> 3470</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03471"></a><span class="lineno"> 3471</span>&#160;   *num_contours = n;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03472"></a><span class="lineno"> 3472</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (n == 0) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03473"></a><span class="lineno"> 3473</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03474"></a><span class="lineno"> 3474</span>&#160;   *contour_lengths = (<span class="keywordtype">int</span> *) STBTT_malloc(<span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(**contour_lengths) * n, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03475"></a><span class="lineno"> 3475</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03476"></a><span class="lineno"> 3476</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (*contour_lengths == 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03477"></a><span class="lineno"> 3477</span>&#160;      *num_contours = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03478"></a><span class="lineno"> 3478</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03479"></a><span class="lineno"> 3479</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03480"></a><span class="lineno"> 3480</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03481"></a><span class="lineno"> 3481</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// make two passes through the points so we don&#39;t need to realloc</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03482"></a><span class="lineno"> 3482</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (pass=0; pass &lt; 2; ++pass) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03483"></a><span class="lineno"> 3483</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x=0,y=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03484"></a><span class="lineno"> 3484</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (pass == 1) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03485"></a><span class="lineno"> 3485</span>&#160;         points = (stbtt__point *) STBTT_malloc(num_points * <span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(points[0]), userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03486"></a><span class="lineno"> 3486</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (points == NULL) <span class="keywordflow">goto</span> error;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03487"></a><span class="lineno"> 3487</span>&#160;      }</div>
