<div class="line"><a name="l03488"></a><span class="lineno"> 3488</span>&#160;      num_points = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03489"></a><span class="lineno"> 3489</span>&#160;      n= -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03490"></a><span class="lineno"> 3490</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; num_verts; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03491"></a><span class="lineno"> 3491</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">switch</span> (vertices[i].type) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03492"></a><span class="lineno"> 3492</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">case</span> STBTT_vmove:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03493"></a><span class="lineno"> 3493</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// start the next contour</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03494"></a><span class="lineno"> 3494</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (n &gt;= 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03495"></a><span class="lineno"> 3495</span>&#160;                  (*contour_lengths)[n] = num_points - start;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03496"></a><span class="lineno"> 3496</span>&#160;               ++n;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03497"></a><span class="lineno"> 3497</span>&#160;               start = num_points;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03498"></a><span class="lineno"> 3498</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03499"></a><span class="lineno"> 3499</span>&#160;               x = vertices[i].x, y = vertices[i].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03500"></a><span class="lineno"> 3500</span>&#160;               stbtt__add_point(points, num_points++, x,y);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03501"></a><span class="lineno"> 3501</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03502"></a><span class="lineno"> 3502</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">case</span> STBTT_vline:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03503"></a><span class="lineno"> 3503</span>&#160;               x = vertices[i].x, y = vertices[i].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03504"></a><span class="lineno"> 3504</span>&#160;               stbtt__add_point(points, num_points++, x, y);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03505"></a><span class="lineno"> 3505</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03506"></a><span class="lineno"> 3506</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">case</span> STBTT_vcurve:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03507"></a><span class="lineno"> 3507</span>&#160;               stbtt__tesselate_curve(points, &amp;num_points, x,y,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03508"></a><span class="lineno"> 3508</span>&#160;                                        vertices[i].cx, vertices[i].cy,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03509"></a><span class="lineno"> 3509</span>&#160;                                        vertices[i].x,  vertices[i].y,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03510"></a><span class="lineno"> 3510</span>&#160;                                        objspace_flatness_squared, 0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03511"></a><span class="lineno"> 3511</span>&#160;               x = vertices[i].x, y = vertices[i].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03512"></a><span class="lineno"> 3512</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03513"></a><span class="lineno"> 3513</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">case</span> STBTT_vcubic:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03514"></a><span class="lineno"> 3514</span>&#160;               stbtt__tesselate_cubic(points, &amp;num_points, x,y,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03515"></a><span class="lineno"> 3515</span>&#160;                                        vertices[i].cx, vertices[i].cy,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03516"></a><span class="lineno"> 3516</span>&#160;                                        vertices[i].cx1, vertices[i].cy1,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03517"></a><span class="lineno"> 3517</span>&#160;                                        vertices[i].x,  vertices[i].y,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03518"></a><span class="lineno"> 3518</span>&#160;                                        objspace_flatness_squared, 0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03519"></a><span class="lineno"> 3519</span>&#160;               x = vertices[i].x, y = vertices[i].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03520"></a><span class="lineno"> 3520</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03521"></a><span class="lineno"> 3521</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03522"></a><span class="lineno"> 3522</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03523"></a><span class="lineno"> 3523</span>&#160;      (*contour_lengths)[n] = num_points - start;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03524"></a><span class="lineno"> 3524</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03525"></a><span class="lineno"> 3525</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03526"></a><span class="lineno"> 3526</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> points;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03527"></a><span class="lineno"> 3527</span>&#160;error:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03528"></a><span class="lineno"> 3528</span>&#160;   STBTT_free(points, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03529"></a><span class="lineno"> 3529</span>&#160;   STBTT_free(*contour_lengths, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03530"></a><span class="lineno"> 3530</span>&#160;   *contour_lengths = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03531"></a><span class="lineno"> 3531</span>&#160;   *num_contours = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03532"></a><span class="lineno"> 3532</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03533"></a><span class="lineno"> 3533</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03534"></a><span class="lineno"> 3534</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03535"></a><span class="lineno"> 3535</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt_Rasterize(<a class="code" href="structstbtt____bitmap.html">stbtt__bitmap</a> *result, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> flatness_in_pixels, <a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a> *vertices, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_verts, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale_x, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale_y, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> shift_x, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> shift_y, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x_off, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> y_off, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> invert, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03536"></a><span class="lineno"> 3536</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03537"></a><span class="lineno"> 3537</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale            = scale_x &gt; scale_y ? scale_y : scale_x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03538"></a><span class="lineno"> 3538</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> winding_count      = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03539"></a><span class="lineno"> 3539</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *winding_lengths   = NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03540"></a><span class="lineno"> 3540</span>&#160;   stbtt__point *windings = stbtt_FlattenCurves(vertices, num_verts, flatness_in_pixels / scale, &amp;winding_lengths, &amp;winding_count, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03541"></a><span class="lineno"> 3541</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (windings) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03542"></a><span class="lineno"> 3542</span>&#160;      stbtt__rasterize(result, windings, winding_lengths, winding_count, scale_x, scale_y, shift_x, shift_y, x_off, y_off, invert, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03543"></a><span class="lineno"> 3543</span>&#160;      STBTT_free(winding_lengths, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03544"></a><span class="lineno"> 3544</span>&#160;      STBTT_free(windings, userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03545"></a><span class="lineno"> 3545</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03546"></a><span class="lineno"> 3546</span>&#160;}</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03587"></a><span class="lineno"> 3587</span>&#160;      }</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03591"></a><span class="lineno"> 3591</span>&#160;}   </div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03642"></a><span class="lineno"> 3642</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt_MakeCodepointBitmap(<span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> *info, <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *output, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> out_w, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> out_h, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> out_stride, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale_x, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale_y, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> codepoint)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03643"></a><span class="lineno"> 3643</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03644"></a><span class="lineno"> 3644</span>&#160;   stbtt_MakeCodepointBitmapSubpixel(info, output, out_w, out_h, out_stride, scale_x, scale_y, 0.0f,0.0f, codepoint);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03645"></a><span class="lineno"> 3645</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03646"></a><span class="lineno"> 3646</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03648"></a><span class="lineno"> 3648</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03649"></a><span class="lineno"> 3649</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// bitmap baking</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03650"></a><span class="lineno"> 3650</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03651"></a><span class="lineno"> 3651</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// This is SUPER-CRAPPY packing to keep source code small</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03652"></a><span class="lineno"> 3652</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03653"></a><span class="lineno"> 3653</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt_BakeFontBitmap_internal(<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *data, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> offset,  <span class="comment">// font location (use offset=0 for plain .ttf)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03654"></a><span class="lineno"> 3654</span>&#160;                                <span class="keywordtype">float</span> pixel_height,                     <span class="comment">// height of font in pixels</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03655"></a><span class="lineno"> 3655</span>&#160;                                <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *pixels, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> pw, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> ph,  <span class="comment">// bitmap to be filled in</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03656"></a><span class="lineno"> 3656</span>&#160;                                <span class="keywordtype">int</span> first_char, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_chars,          <span class="comment">// characters to bake</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03657"></a><span class="lineno"> 3657</span>&#160;                                <a class="code" href="structstbtt__bakedchar.html">stbtt_bakedchar</a> *chardata)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03658"></a><span class="lineno"> 3658</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03659"></a><span class="lineno"> 3659</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03660"></a><span class="lineno"> 3660</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x,y,bottom_y, i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03661"></a><span class="lineno"> 3661</span>&#160;   <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03662"></a><span class="lineno"> 3662</span>&#160;   f.userdata = NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03663"></a><span class="lineno"> 3663</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!stbtt_InitFont(&amp;f, data, offset))</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03664"></a><span class="lineno"> 3664</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03665"></a><span class="lineno"> 3665</span>&#160;   STBTT_memset(pixels, 0, pw*ph); <span class="comment">// background of 0 around pixels</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03666"></a><span class="lineno"> 3666</span>&#160;   x=y=1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03667"></a><span class="lineno"> 3667</span>&#160;   bottom_y = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03668"></a><span class="lineno"> 3668</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03669"></a><span class="lineno"> 3669</span>&#160;   scale = stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight(&amp;f, pixel_height);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03670"></a><span class="lineno"> 3670</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03671"></a><span class="lineno"> 3671</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; num_chars; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03672"></a><span class="lineno"> 3672</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">int</span> advance, lsb, x0,y0,x1,y1,gw,gh;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03673"></a><span class="lineno"> 3673</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">int</span> g = stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(&amp;f, first_char + i);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03674"></a><span class="lineno"> 3674</span>&#160;      stbtt_GetGlyphHMetrics(&amp;f, g, &amp;advance, &amp;lsb);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03675"></a><span class="lineno"> 3675</span>&#160;      stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBox(&amp;f, g, scale,scale, &amp;x0,&amp;y0,&amp;x1,&amp;y1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03676"></a><span class="lineno"> 3676</span>&#160;      gw = x1-x0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03677"></a><span class="lineno"> 3677</span>&#160;      gh = y1-y0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03678"></a><span class="lineno"> 3678</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x + gw + 1 &gt;= pw)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03679"></a><span class="lineno"> 3679</span>&#160;         y = bottom_y, x = 1; <span class="comment">// advance to next row</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03680"></a><span class="lineno"> 3680</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y + gh + 1 &gt;= ph) <span class="comment">// check if it fits vertically AFTER potentially moving to next row</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03681"></a><span class="lineno"> 3681</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03682"></a><span class="lineno"> 3682</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(x+gw &lt; pw);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03683"></a><span class="lineno"> 3683</span>&#160;      STBTT_assert(y+gh &lt; ph);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03684"></a><span class="lineno"> 3684</span>&#160;      stbtt_MakeGlyphBitmap(&amp;f, pixels+x+y*pw, gw,gh,pw, scale,scale, g);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03685"></a><span class="lineno"> 3685</span>&#160;      chardata[i].x0 = (stbtt_int16) x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03686"></a><span class="lineno"> 3686</span>&#160;      chardata[i].y0 = (stbtt_int16) y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03687"></a><span class="lineno"> 3687</span>&#160;      chardata[i].x1 = (stbtt_int16) (x + gw);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03688"></a><span class="lineno"> 3688</span>&#160;      chardata[i].y1 = (stbtt_int16) (y + gh);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03689"></a><span class="lineno"> 3689</span>&#160;      chardata[i].xadvance = scale * advance;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03690"></a><span class="lineno"> 3690</span>&#160;      chardata[i].xoff     = (float) x0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03691"></a><span class="lineno"> 3691</span>&#160;      chardata[i].yoff     = (float) y0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03692"></a><span class="lineno"> 3692</span>&#160;      x = x + gw + 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03693"></a><span class="lineno"> 3693</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y+gh+1 &gt; bottom_y)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03694"></a><span class="lineno"> 3694</span>&#160;         bottom_y = y+gh+1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03695"></a><span class="lineno"> 3695</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03696"></a><span class="lineno"> 3696</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> bottom_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03697"></a><span class="lineno"> 3697</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03698"></a><span class="lineno"> 3698</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03699"></a><span class="lineno"> 3699</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt_GetBakedQuad(<span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__bakedchar.html">stbtt_bakedchar</a> *chardata, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> pw, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> ph, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> char_index, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *xpos, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *ypos, <a class="code" href="structstbtt__aligned__quad.html">stbtt_aligned_quad</a> *q, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> opengl_fillrule)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03700"></a><span class="lineno"> 3700</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03701"></a><span class="lineno"> 3701</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> d3d_bias = opengl_fillrule ? 0 : -0.5f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03702"></a><span class="lineno"> 3702</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> ipw = 1.0f / pw, iph = 1.0f / ph;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03703"></a><span class="lineno"> 3703</span>&#160;   <span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__bakedchar.html">stbtt_bakedchar</a> *b = chardata + char_index;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03704"></a><span class="lineno"> 3704</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> round_x = STBTT_ifloor((*xpos + b-&gt;xoff) + 0.5f);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03705"></a><span class="lineno"> 3705</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> round_y = STBTT_ifloor((*ypos + b-&gt;yoff) + 0.5f);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03706"></a><span class="lineno"> 3706</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03707"></a><span class="lineno"> 3707</span>&#160;   q-&gt;x0 = round_x + d3d_bias;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03708"></a><span class="lineno"> 3708</span>&#160;   q-&gt;y0 = round_y + d3d_bias;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03709"></a><span class="lineno"> 3709</span>&#160;   q-&gt;x1 = round_x + b-&gt;x1 - b-&gt;x0 + d3d_bias;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03710"></a><span class="lineno"> 3710</span>&#160;   q-&gt;y1 = round_y + b-&gt;y1 - b-&gt;y0 + d3d_bias;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03711"></a><span class="lineno"> 3711</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03712"></a><span class="lineno"> 3712</span>&#160;   q-&gt;s0 = b-&gt;x0 * ipw;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03713"></a><span class="lineno"> 3713</span>&#160;   q-&gt;t0 = b-&gt;y0 * iph;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03714"></a><span class="lineno"> 3714</span>&#160;   q-&gt;s1 = b-&gt;x1 * ipw;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03715"></a><span class="lineno"> 3715</span>&#160;   q-&gt;t1 = b-&gt;y1 * iph;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03716"></a><span class="lineno"> 3716</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03717"></a><span class="lineno"> 3717</span>&#160;   *xpos += b-&gt;xadvance;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03718"></a><span class="lineno"> 3718</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03719"></a><span class="lineno"> 3719</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03721"></a><span class="lineno"> 3721</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03740"></a><span class="lineno"> 3740</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">typedef</span> <span class="keyword">struct</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03741"></a><span class="lineno"> 3741</span>&#160;{</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03744"></a><span class="lineno"> 3744</span>&#160;} <a class="code" href="structstbrp__context.html">stbrp_context</a>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03745"></a><span class="lineno"> 3745</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03746"></a><span class="lineno"> 3746</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">typedef</span> <span class="keyword">struct</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03747"></a><span class="lineno"> 3747</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03748"></a><span class="lineno"> 3748</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03749"></a><span class="lineno"> 3749</span>&#160;} <a class="code" href="structstbrp__node.html">stbrp_node</a>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03750"></a><span class="lineno"> 3750</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03751"></a><span class="lineno"> 3751</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">struct </span><a class="code" href="structstbrp__rect.html">stbrp_rect</a></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03753"></a><span class="lineno"> 3753</span>&#160;   stbrp_coord x,y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03754"></a><span class="lineno"> 3754</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> id,w,h,was_packed;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03755"></a><span class="lineno"> 3755</span>&#160;};</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03756"></a><span class="lineno"> 3756</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03757"></a><span class="lineno"> 3757</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbrp_init_target(<a class="code" href="structstbrp__context.html">stbrp_context</a> *con, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> pw, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> ph, <a class="code" href="structstbrp__node.html">stbrp_node</a> *nodes, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_nodes)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03758"></a><span class="lineno"> 3758</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03759"></a><span class="lineno"> 3759</span>&#160;   con-&gt;width  = pw;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03760"></a><span class="lineno"> 3760</span>&#160;   con-&gt;height = ph;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03761"></a><span class="lineno"> 3761</span>&#160;   con-&gt;x = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03762"></a><span class="lineno"> 3762</span>&#160;   con-&gt;y = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03763"></a><span class="lineno"> 3763</span>&#160;   con-&gt;bottom_y = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03764"></a><span class="lineno"> 3764</span>&#160;   STBTT__NOTUSED(nodes);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03765"></a><span class="lineno"> 3765</span>&#160;   STBTT__NOTUSED(num_nodes);   </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03766"></a><span class="lineno"> 3766</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03767"></a><span class="lineno"> 3767</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03768"></a><span class="lineno"> 3768</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbrp_pack_rects(<a class="code" href="structstbrp__context.html">stbrp_context</a> *con, <a class="code" href="structstbrp__rect.html">stbrp_rect</a> *rects, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_rects)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03769"></a><span class="lineno"> 3769</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03770"></a><span class="lineno"> 3770</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03771"></a><span class="lineno"> 3771</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; num_rects; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03772"></a><span class="lineno"> 3772</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (con-&gt;x + rects[i].w &gt; con-&gt;width) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03773"></a><span class="lineno"> 3773</span>&#160;         con-&gt;x = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03774"></a><span class="lineno"> 3774</span>&#160;         con-&gt;y = con-&gt;bottom_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03775"></a><span class="lineno"> 3775</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03776"></a><span class="lineno"> 3776</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (con-&gt;y + rects[i].h &gt; con-&gt;height)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03777"></a><span class="lineno"> 3777</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03778"></a><span class="lineno"> 3778</span>&#160;      rects[i].x = con-&gt;x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03779"></a><span class="lineno"> 3779</span>&#160;      rects[i].y = con-&gt;y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03780"></a><span class="lineno"> 3780</span>&#160;      rects[i].was_packed = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03781"></a><span class="lineno"> 3781</span>&#160;      con-&gt;x += rects[i].w;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03782"></a><span class="lineno"> 3782</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (con-&gt;y + rects[i].h &gt; con-&gt;bottom_y)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03783"></a><span class="lineno"> 3783</span>&#160;         con-&gt;bottom_y = con-&gt;y + rects[i].h;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03784"></a><span class="lineno"> 3784</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03785"></a><span class="lineno"> 3785</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (   ; i &lt; num_rects; ++i)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03786"></a><span class="lineno"> 3786</span>&#160;      rects[i].was_packed = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03787"></a><span class="lineno"> 3787</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03788"></a><span class="lineno"> 3788</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#endif</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03789"></a><span class="lineno"> 3789</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03791"></a><span class="lineno"> 3791</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03792"></a><span class="lineno"> 3792</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// bitmap baking</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03793"></a><span class="lineno"> 3793</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03794"></a><span class="lineno"> 3794</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// This is SUPER-AWESOME (tm Ryan Gordon) packing using stb_rect_pack.h. If</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03795"></a><span class="lineno"> 3795</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// stb_rect_pack.h isn&#39;t available, it uses the BakeFontBitmap strategy.</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03852"></a><span class="lineno"> 3852</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt__h_prefilter(<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *pixels, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> w, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> h, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stride_in_bytes, <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> kernel_width)</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03854"></a><span class="lineno"> 3854</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> buffer[STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03855"></a><span class="lineno"> 3855</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> safe_w = w - kernel_width;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03856"></a><span class="lineno"> 3856</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03857"></a><span class="lineno"> 3857</span>&#160;   STBTT_memset(buffer, 0, STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE); <span class="comment">// suppress bogus warning from VS2013 -analyze</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03860"></a><span class="lineno"> 3860</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> total;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03861"></a><span class="lineno"> 3861</span>&#160;      STBTT_memset(buffer, 0, kernel_width);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03862"></a><span class="lineno"> 3862</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03863"></a><span class="lineno"> 3863</span>&#160;      total = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03864"></a><span class="lineno"> 3864</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03865"></a><span class="lineno"> 3865</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// make kernel_width a constant in common cases so compiler can optimize out the divide</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03866"></a><span class="lineno"> 3866</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">switch</span> (kernel_width) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03867"></a><span class="lineno"> 3867</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">case</span> 2:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03868"></a><span class="lineno"> 3868</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt;= safe_w; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03869"></a><span class="lineno"> 3869</span>&#160;               total += pixels[i] - buffer[i &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03870"></a><span class="lineno"> 3870</span>&#160;               buffer[(i+kernel_width) &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i];</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03873"></a><span class="lineno"> 3873</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03874"></a><span class="lineno"> 3874</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">case</span> 3:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03875"></a><span class="lineno"> 3875</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt;= safe_w; ++i) {</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03877"></a><span class="lineno"> 3877</span>&#160;               buffer[(i+kernel_width) &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03878"></a><span class="lineno"> 3878</span>&#160;               pixels[i] = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> char) (total / 3);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03880"></a><span class="lineno"> 3880</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03888"></a><span class="lineno"> 3888</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">case</span> 5:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03889"></a><span class="lineno"> 3889</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt;= safe_w; ++i) {</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03894"></a><span class="lineno"> 3894</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03895"></a><span class="lineno"> 3895</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">default</span>:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03896"></a><span class="lineno"> 3896</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt;= safe_w; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03897"></a><span class="lineno"> 3897</span>&#160;               total += pixels[i] - buffer[i &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03898"></a><span class="lineno"> 3898</span>&#160;               buffer[(i+kernel_width) &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i];</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03901"></a><span class="lineno"> 3901</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03902"></a><span class="lineno"> 3902</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03903"></a><span class="lineno"> 3903</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03904"></a><span class="lineno"> 3904</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (; i &lt; w; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03905"></a><span class="lineno"> 3905</span>&#160;         STBTT_assert(pixels[i] == 0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03906"></a><span class="lineno"> 3906</span>&#160;         total -= buffer[i &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03907"></a><span class="lineno"> 3907</span>&#160;         pixels[i] = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> char) (total / kernel_width);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03923"></a><span class="lineno"> 3923</span>&#160;      STBTT_memset(buffer, 0, kernel_width);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03926"></a><span class="lineno"> 3926</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03927"></a><span class="lineno"> 3927</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// make kernel_width a constant in common cases so compiler can optimize out the divide</span></div>

<div class="line"><a name="l03942"></a><span class="lineno"> 3942</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03943"></a><span class="lineno"> 3943</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">case</span> 4:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03944"></a><span class="lineno"> 3944</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt;= safe_h; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03945"></a><span class="lineno"> 3945</span>&#160;               total += pixels[i*stride_in_bytes] - buffer[i &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03946"></a><span class="lineno"> 3946</span>&#160;               buffer[(i+kernel_width) &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i*stride_in_bytes];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03947"></a><span class="lineno"> 3947</span>&#160;               pixels[i*stride_in_bytes] = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> char) (total / 4);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03948"></a><span class="lineno"> 3948</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03949"></a><span class="lineno"> 3949</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03950"></a><span class="lineno"> 3950</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">case</span> 5:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03951"></a><span class="lineno"> 3951</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt;= safe_h; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03952"></a><span class="lineno"> 3952</span>&#160;               total += pixels[i*stride_in_bytes] - buffer[i &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03953"></a><span class="lineno"> 3953</span>&#160;               buffer[(i+kernel_width) &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i*stride_in_bytes];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03954"></a><span class="lineno"> 3954</span>&#160;               pixels[i*stride_in_bytes] = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> char) (total / 5);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03955"></a><span class="lineno"> 3955</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03956"></a><span class="lineno"> 3956</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03957"></a><span class="lineno"> 3957</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">default</span>:</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03958"></a><span class="lineno"> 3958</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt;= safe_h; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03959"></a><span class="lineno"> 3959</span>&#160;               total += pixels[i*stride_in_bytes] - buffer[i &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03960"></a><span class="lineno"> 3960</span>&#160;               buffer[(i+kernel_width) &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i*stride_in_bytes];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03961"></a><span class="lineno"> 3961</span>&#160;               pixels[i*stride_in_bytes] = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> char) (total / kernel_width);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03962"></a><span class="lineno"> 3962</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03963"></a><span class="lineno"> 3963</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">break</span>;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03964"></a><span class="lineno"> 3964</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03965"></a><span class="lineno"> 3965</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03966"></a><span class="lineno"> 3966</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (; i &lt; h; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03967"></a><span class="lineno"> 3967</span>&#160;         STBTT_assert(pixels[i*stride_in_bytes] == 0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03968"></a><span class="lineno"> 3968</span>&#160;         total -= buffer[i &amp; STBTT__OVER_MASK];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03969"></a><span class="lineno"> 3969</span>&#160;         pixels[i*stride_in_bytes] = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> char) (total / kernel_width);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03970"></a><span class="lineno"> 3970</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03971"></a><span class="lineno"> 3971</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03972"></a><span class="lineno"> 3972</span>&#160;      pixels += 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03973"></a><span class="lineno"> 3973</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03974"></a><span class="lineno"> 3974</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03975"></a><span class="lineno"> 3975</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03976"></a><span class="lineno"> 3976</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">float</span> stbtt__oversample_shift(<span class="keywordtype">int</span> oversample)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03977"></a><span class="lineno"> 3977</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03978"></a><span class="lineno"> 3978</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (!oversample)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03979"></a><span class="lineno"> 3979</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0.0f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03980"></a><span class="lineno"> 3980</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03981"></a><span class="lineno"> 3981</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// The prefilter is a box filter of width &quot;oversample&quot;,</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03982"></a><span class="lineno"> 3982</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// which shifts phase by (oversample - 1)/2 pixels in</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03983"></a><span class="lineno"> 3983</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// oversampled space. We want to shift in the opposite</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03984"></a><span class="lineno"> 3984</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// direction to counter this.</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03985"></a><span class="lineno"> 3985</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> (<span class="keywordtype">float</span>)-(oversample - 1) / (2.0f * (<span class="keywordtype">float</span>)oversample);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03986"></a><span class="lineno"> 3986</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03987"></a><span class="lineno"> 3987</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03988"></a><span class="lineno"> 3988</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// rects array must be big enough to accommodate all characters in the given ranges</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03989"></a><span class="lineno"> 3989</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt_PackFontRangesGatherRects(<a class="code" href="structstbtt__pack__context.html">stbtt_pack_context</a> *spc, <span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> *info, <a class="code" href="structstbtt__pack__range.html">stbtt_pack_range</a> *ranges, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_ranges, <a class="code" href="structstbrp__rect.html">stbrp_rect</a> *rects)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03990"></a><span class="lineno"> 3990</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03991"></a><span class="lineno"> 3991</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i,j,k;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03992"></a><span class="lineno"> 3992</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03993"></a><span class="lineno"> 3993</span>&#160;   k=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03994"></a><span class="lineno"> 3994</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; num_ranges; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03995"></a><span class="lineno"> 3995</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> fh = ranges[i].font_size;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03996"></a><span class="lineno"> 3996</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale = fh &gt; 0 ? stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight(info, fh) : stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(info, -fh);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03997"></a><span class="lineno"> 3997</span>&#160;      ranges[i].h_oversample = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> char) spc-&gt;h_oversample;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03998"></a><span class="lineno"> 3998</span>&#160;      ranges[i].v_oversample = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span>) spc-&gt;v_oversample;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l03999"></a><span class="lineno"> 3999</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (j=0; j &lt; ranges[i].num_chars; ++j) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04000"></a><span class="lineno"> 4000</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x0,y0,x1,y1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04001"></a><span class="lineno"> 4001</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> codepoint = ranges[i].array_of_unicode_codepoints == NULL ? ranges[i].first_unicode_codepoint_in_range + j : ranges[i].array_of_unicode_codepoints[j];</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04003"></a><span class="lineno"> 4003</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (glyph == 0 &amp;&amp; spc-&gt;skip_missing) {</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04005"></a><span class="lineno"> 4005</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04006"></a><span class="lineno"> 4006</span>&#160;            stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBoxSubpixel(info,glyph,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04007"></a><span class="lineno"> 4007</span>&#160;                                            scale * spc-&gt;h_oversample,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04008"></a><span class="lineno"> 4008</span>&#160;                                            scale * spc-&gt;v_oversample,</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04010"></a><span class="lineno"> 4010</span>&#160;                                            &amp;x0,&amp;y0,&amp;x1,&amp;y1);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04015"></a><span class="lineno"> 4015</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04016"></a><span class="lineno"> 4016</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04017"></a><span class="lineno"> 4017</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04018"></a><span class="lineno"> 4018</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> k;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04019"></a><span class="lineno"> 4019</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04020"></a><span class="lineno"> 4020</span>&#160; </div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04045"></a><span class="lineno"> 4045</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt_PackFontRangesRenderIntoRects(<a class="code" href="structstbtt__pack__context.html">stbtt_pack_context</a> *spc, <span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> *info, <a class="code" href="structstbtt__pack__range.html">stbtt_pack_range</a> *ranges, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_ranges, <a class="code" href="structstbrp__rect.html">stbrp_rect</a> *rects)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04046"></a><span class="lineno"> 4046</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04047"></a><span class="lineno"> 4047</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i,j,k, return_value = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04048"></a><span class="lineno"> 4048</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04049"></a><span class="lineno"> 4049</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// save current values</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04050"></a><span class="lineno"> 4050</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> old_h_over = spc-&gt;h_oversample;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04051"></a><span class="lineno"> 4051</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> old_v_over = spc-&gt;v_oversample;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04052"></a><span class="lineno"> 4052</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04053"></a><span class="lineno"> 4053</span>&#160;   k = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04054"></a><span class="lineno"> 4054</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; num_ranges; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04055"></a><span class="lineno"> 4055</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> fh = ranges[i].font_size;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04056"></a><span class="lineno"> 4056</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale = fh &gt; 0 ? stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight(info, fh) : stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(info, -fh);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04057"></a><span class="lineno"> 4057</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> recip_h,recip_v,sub_x,sub_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04058"></a><span class="lineno"> 4058</span>&#160;      spc-&gt;h_oversample = ranges[i].h_oversample;</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04061"></a><span class="lineno"> 4061</span>&#160;      recip_v = 1.0f / spc-&gt;v_oversample;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04062"></a><span class="lineno"> 4062</span>&#160;      sub_x = stbtt__oversample_shift(spc-&gt;h_oversample);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04063"></a><span class="lineno"> 4063</span>&#160;      sub_y = stbtt__oversample_shift(spc-&gt;v_oversample);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04064"></a><span class="lineno"> 4064</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (j=0; j &lt; ranges[i].num_chars; ++j) {</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04066"></a><span class="lineno"> 4066</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (r-&gt;was_packed &amp;&amp; r-&gt;w != 0 &amp;&amp; r-&gt;h != 0) {</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04069"></a><span class="lineno"> 4069</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">int</span> codepoint = ranges[i].array_of_unicode_codepoints == NULL ? ranges[i].first_unicode_codepoint_in_range + j : ranges[i].array_of_unicode_codepoints[j];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04070"></a><span class="lineno"> 4070</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">int</span> glyph = stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(info, codepoint);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04071"></a><span class="lineno"> 4071</span>&#160;            stbrp_coord pad = (stbrp_coord) spc-&gt;padding;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04072"></a><span class="lineno"> 4072</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04073"></a><span class="lineno"> 4073</span>&#160;            <span class="comment">// pad on left and top</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04074"></a><span class="lineno"> 4074</span>&#160;            r-&gt;x += pad;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04075"></a><span class="lineno"> 4075</span>&#160;            r-&gt;y += pad;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04076"></a><span class="lineno"> 4076</span>&#160;            r-&gt;w -= pad;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04077"></a><span class="lineno"> 4077</span>&#160;            r-&gt;h -= pad;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04078"></a><span class="lineno"> 4078</span>&#160;            stbtt_GetGlyphHMetrics(info, glyph, &amp;advance, &amp;lsb);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04079"></a><span class="lineno"> 4079</span>&#160;            stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBox(info, glyph,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04080"></a><span class="lineno"> 4080</span>&#160;                                    scale * spc-&gt;h_oversample,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04081"></a><span class="lineno"> 4081</span>&#160;                                    scale * spc-&gt;v_oversample,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04082"></a><span class="lineno"> 4082</span>&#160;                                    &amp;x0,&amp;y0,&amp;x1,&amp;y1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04083"></a><span class="lineno"> 4083</span>&#160;            stbtt_MakeGlyphBitmapSubpixel(info,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04084"></a><span class="lineno"> 4084</span>&#160;                                          spc-&gt;pixels + r-&gt;x + r-&gt;y*spc-&gt;stride_in_bytes,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04085"></a><span class="lineno"> 4085</span>&#160;                                          r-&gt;w - spc-&gt;h_oversample+1,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04086"></a><span class="lineno"> 4086</span>&#160;                                          r-&gt;h - spc-&gt;v_oversample+1,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04087"></a><span class="lineno"> 4087</span>&#160;                                          spc-&gt;stride_in_bytes,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04088"></a><span class="lineno"> 4088</span>&#160;                                          scale * spc-&gt;h_oversample,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04089"></a><span class="lineno"> 4089</span>&#160;                                          scale * spc-&gt;v_oversample,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04090"></a><span class="lineno"> 4090</span>&#160;                                          0,0,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04091"></a><span class="lineno"> 4091</span>&#160;                                          glyph);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04092"></a><span class="lineno"> 4092</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04093"></a><span class="lineno"> 4093</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (spc-&gt;h_oversample &gt; 1)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04094"></a><span class="lineno"> 4094</span>&#160;               stbtt__h_prefilter(spc-&gt;pixels + r-&gt;x + r-&gt;y*spc-&gt;stride_in_bytes,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04095"></a><span class="lineno"> 4095</span>&#160;                                  r-&gt;w, r-&gt;h, spc-&gt;stride_in_bytes,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04096"></a><span class="lineno"> 4096</span>&#160;                                  spc-&gt;h_oversample);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04097"></a><span class="lineno"> 4097</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04098"></a><span class="lineno"> 4098</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (spc-&gt;v_oversample &gt; 1)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04099"></a><span class="lineno"> 4099</span>&#160;               stbtt__v_prefilter(spc-&gt;pixels + r-&gt;x + r-&gt;y*spc-&gt;stride_in_bytes,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04100"></a><span class="lineno"> 4100</span>&#160;                                  r-&gt;w, r-&gt;h, spc-&gt;stride_in_bytes,</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04101"></a><span class="lineno"> 4101</span>&#160;                                  spc-&gt;v_oversample);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04102"></a><span class="lineno"> 4102</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04103"></a><span class="lineno"> 4103</span>&#160;            bc-&gt;x0       = (stbtt_int16)  r-&gt;x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04104"></a><span class="lineno"> 4104</span>&#160;            bc-&gt;y0       = (stbtt_int16)  r-&gt;y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04105"></a><span class="lineno"> 4105</span>&#160;            bc-&gt;x1       = (stbtt_int16) (r-&gt;x + r-&gt;w);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04106"></a><span class="lineno"> 4106</span>&#160;            bc-&gt;y1       = (stbtt_int16) (r-&gt;y + r-&gt;h);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04107"></a><span class="lineno"> 4107</span>&#160;            bc-&gt;xadvance =                scale * advance;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04108"></a><span class="lineno"> 4108</span>&#160;            bc-&gt;xoff     =       (float)  x0 * recip_h + sub_x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04109"></a><span class="lineno"> 4109</span>&#160;            bc-&gt;yoff     =       (float)  y0 * recip_v + sub_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04110"></a><span class="lineno"> 4110</span>&#160;            bc-&gt;xoff2    =                (x0 + r-&gt;w) * recip_h + sub_x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04111"></a><span class="lineno"> 4111</span>&#160;            bc-&gt;yoff2    =                (y0 + r-&gt;h) * recip_v + sub_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04112"></a><span class="lineno"> 4112</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04113"></a><span class="lineno"> 4113</span>&#160;            return_value = 0; <span class="comment">// if any fail, report failure</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04114"></a><span class="lineno"> 4114</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04115"></a><span class="lineno"> 4115</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04116"></a><span class="lineno"> 4116</span>&#160;         ++k;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04117"></a><span class="lineno"> 4117</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04118"></a><span class="lineno"> 4118</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04119"></a><span class="lineno"> 4119</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04120"></a><span class="lineno"> 4120</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// restore original values</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04121"></a><span class="lineno"> 4121</span>&#160;   spc-&gt;h_oversample = old_h_over;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04122"></a><span class="lineno"> 4122</span>&#160;   spc-&gt;v_oversample = old_v_over;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04123"></a><span class="lineno"> 4123</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04124"></a><span class="lineno"> 4124</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> return_value;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04125"></a><span class="lineno"> 4125</span>&#160;}</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04180"></a><span class="lineno"> 4180</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt_GetScaledFontVMetrics(<span class="keyword">const</span> <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *fontdata, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> index, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> size, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *ascent, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *descent, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *lineGap)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04181"></a><span class="lineno"> 4181</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04182"></a><span class="lineno"> 4182</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i_ascent, i_descent, i_lineGap;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04183"></a><span class="lineno"> 4183</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04184"></a><span class="lineno"> 4184</span>&#160;   <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> info;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04185"></a><span class="lineno"> 4185</span>&#160;   stbtt_InitFont(&amp;info, fontdata, stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(fontdata, index));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04186"></a><span class="lineno"> 4186</span>&#160;   scale = size &gt; 0 ? stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight(&amp;info, size) : stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(&amp;info, -size);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04187"></a><span class="lineno"> 4187</span>&#160;   stbtt_GetFontVMetrics(&amp;info, &amp;i_ascent, &amp;i_descent, &amp;i_lineGap);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04190"></a><span class="lineno"> 4190</span>&#160;   *lineGap = (float) i_lineGap * scale;</div>
