```html
<div class="line"><a name="l04193"></a><span class="lineno"> 4193</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt_GetPackedQuad(<span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__packedchar.html">stbtt_packedchar</a> *chardata, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> pw, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> ph, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> char_index, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *xpos, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *ypos, <a class="code" href="structstbtt__aligned__quad.html">stbtt_aligned_quad</a> *q, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> align_to_integer)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04194"></a><span class="lineno"> 4194</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04195"></a><span class="lineno"> 4195</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> ipw = 1.0f / pw, iph = 1.0f / ph;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04196"></a><span class="lineno"> 4196</span>&#160;   <span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__packedchar.html">stbtt_packedchar</a> *b = chardata + char_index;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04197"></a><span class="lineno"> 4197</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04198"></a><span class="lineno"> 4198</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (align_to_integer) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04199"></a><span class="lineno"> 4199</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x = (float) STBTT_ifloor((*xpos + b-&gt;xoff) + 0.5f);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04200"></a><span class="lineno"> 4200</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y = (float) STBTT_ifloor((*ypos + b-&gt;yoff) + 0.5f);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04201"></a><span class="lineno"> 4201</span>&#160;      q-&gt;x0 = x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04202"></a><span class="lineno"> 4202</span>&#160;      q-&gt;y0 = y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04203"></a><span class="lineno"> 4203</span>&#160;      q-&gt;x1 = x + b-&gt;xoff2 - b-&gt;xoff;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04204"></a><span class="lineno"> 4204</span>&#160;      q-&gt;y1 = y + b-&gt;yoff2 - b-&gt;yoff;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04205"></a><span class="lineno"> 4205</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04206"></a><span class="lineno"> 4206</span>&#160;      q-&gt;x0 = *xpos + b-&gt;xoff;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04207"></a><span class="lineno"> 4207</span>&#160;      q-&gt;y0 = *ypos + b-&gt;yoff;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04208"></a><span class="lineno"> 4208</span>&#160;      q-&gt;x1 = *xpos + b-&gt;xoff2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04209"></a><span class="lineno"> 4209</span>&#160;      q-&gt;y1 = *ypos + b-&gt;yoff2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04210"></a><span class="lineno"> 4210</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04211"></a><span class="lineno"> 4211</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04212"></a><span class="lineno"> 4212</span>&#160;   q-&gt;s0 = b-&gt;x0 * ipw;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04213"></a><span class="lineno"> 4213</span>&#160;   q-&gt;t0 = b-&gt;y0 * iph;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04214"></a><span class="lineno"> 4214</span>&#160;   q-&gt;s1 = b-&gt;x1 * ipw;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04215"></a><span class="lineno"> 4215</span>&#160;   q-&gt;t1 = b-&gt;y1 * iph;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04216"></a><span class="lineno"> 4216</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04217"></a><span class="lineno"> 4217</span>&#160;   *xpos += b-&gt;xadvance;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04218"></a><span class="lineno"> 4218</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04219"></a><span class="lineno"> 4219</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04221"></a><span class="lineno"> 4221</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04222"></a><span class="lineno"> 4222</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// sdf computation</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04223"></a><span class="lineno"> 4223</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04224"></a><span class="lineno"> 4224</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04225"></a><span class="lineno"> 4225</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_min(a,b)  ((a) &lt; (b) ? (a) : (b))</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04226"></a><span class="lineno"> 4226</span>&#160;<span class="preprocessor">#define STBTT_max(a,b)  ((a) &lt; (b) ? (b) : (a))</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04227"></a><span class="lineno"> 4227</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04228"></a><span class="lineno"> 4228</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt__ray_intersect_bezier(<span class="keywordtype">float</span> orig[2], <span class="keywordtype">float</span> ray[2], <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q0[2], <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q1[2], <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q2[2], <span class="keywordtype">float</span> hits[2][2])</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04229"></a><span class="lineno"> 4229</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04230"></a><span class="lineno"> 4230</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q0perp = q0[1]*ray[0] - q0[0]*ray[1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04231"></a><span class="lineno"> 4231</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q1perp = q1[1]*ray[0] - q1[0]*ray[1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04232"></a><span class="lineno"> 4232</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q2perp = q2[1]*ray[0] - q2[0]*ray[1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04233"></a><span class="lineno"> 4233</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> roperp = orig[1]*ray[0] - orig[0]*ray[1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04234"></a><span class="lineno"> 4234</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04235"></a><span class="lineno"> 4235</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> a = q0perp - 2*q1perp + q2perp;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04236"></a><span class="lineno"> 4236</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> b = q1perp - q0perp;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04237"></a><span class="lineno"> 4237</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> c = q0perp - roperp;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04238"></a><span class="lineno"> 4238</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04239"></a><span class="lineno"> 4239</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> s0 = 0., s1 = 0.;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04240"></a><span class="lineno"> 4240</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_s = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04241"></a><span class="lineno"> 4241</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04242"></a><span class="lineno"> 4242</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (a != 0.0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04243"></a><span class="lineno"> 4243</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> discr = b*b - a*c;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04244"></a><span class="lineno"> 4244</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (discr &gt; 0.0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04245"></a><span class="lineno"> 4245</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> rcpna = -1 / a;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04246"></a><span class="lineno"> 4246</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">float</span> d = (float) STBTT_sqrt(discr);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04247"></a><span class="lineno"> 4247</span>&#160;         s0 = (b+d) * rcpna;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04248"></a><span class="lineno"> 4248</span>&#160;         s1 = (b-d) * rcpna;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04249"></a><span class="lineno"> 4249</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s0 &gt;= 0.0 &amp;&amp; s0 &lt;= 1.0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04250"></a><span class="lineno"> 4250</span>&#160;            num_s = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04251"></a><span class="lineno"> 4251</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (d &gt; 0.0 &amp;&amp; s1 &gt;= 0.0 &amp;&amp; s1 &lt;= 1.0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04252"></a><span class="lineno"> 4252</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (num_s == 0) s0 = s1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04253"></a><span class="lineno"> 4253</span>&#160;            ++num_s;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04254"></a><span class="lineno"> 4254</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04255"></a><span class="lineno"> 4255</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04256"></a><span class="lineno"> 4256</span>&#160;   } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04257"></a><span class="lineno"> 4257</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// 2*b*s + c = 0</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04258"></a><span class="lineno"> 4258</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">// s = -c / (2*b)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04259"></a><span class="lineno"> 4259</span>&#160;      s0 = c / (-2 * b);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04260"></a><span class="lineno"> 4260</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s0 &gt;= 0.0 &amp;&amp; s0 &lt;= 1.0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04261"></a><span class="lineno"> 4261</span>&#160;         num_s = 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04262"></a><span class="lineno"> 4262</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04263"></a><span class="lineno"> 4263</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04264"></a><span class="lineno"> 4264</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (num_s == 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04265"></a><span class="lineno"> 4265</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04266"></a><span class="lineno"> 4266</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04267"></a><span class="lineno"> 4267</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> rcp_len2 = 1 / (ray[0]*ray[0] + ray[1]*ray[1]);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04268"></a><span class="lineno"> 4268</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> rayn_x = ray[0] * rcp_len2, rayn_y = ray[1] * rcp_len2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04269"></a><span class="lineno"> 4269</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04270"></a><span class="lineno"> 4270</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q0d =   q0[0]*rayn_x +   q0[1]*rayn_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04271"></a><span class="lineno"> 4271</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q1d =   q1[0]*rayn_x +   q1[1]*rayn_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04272"></a><span class="lineno"> 4272</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q2d =   q2[0]*rayn_x +   q2[1]*rayn_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04273"></a><span class="lineno"> 4273</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> rod = orig[0]*rayn_x + orig[1]*rayn_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04274"></a><span class="lineno"> 4274</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04275"></a><span class="lineno"> 4275</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q10d = q1d - q0d;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04276"></a><span class="lineno"> 4276</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q20d = q2d - q0d;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04277"></a><span class="lineno"> 4277</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q0rd = q0d - rod;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04278"></a><span class="lineno"> 4278</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04279"></a><span class="lineno"> 4279</span>&#160;      hits[0][0] = q0rd + s0*(2.0f - 2.0f*s0)*q10d + s0*s0*q20d;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04280"></a><span class="lineno"> 4280</span>&#160;      hits[0][1] = a*s0+b;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04281"></a><span class="lineno"> 4281</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04282"></a><span class="lineno"> 4282</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (num_s &gt; 1) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04283"></a><span class="lineno"> 4283</span>&#160;         hits[1][0] = q0rd + s1*(2.0f - 2.0f*s1)*q10d + s1*s1*q20d;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04284"></a><span class="lineno"> 4284</span>&#160;         hits[1][1] = a*s1+b;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04285"></a><span class="lineno"> 4285</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04286"></a><span class="lineno"> 4286</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04287"></a><span class="lineno"> 4287</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04288"></a><span class="lineno"> 4288</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04289"></a><span class="lineno"> 4289</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04290"></a><span class="lineno"> 4290</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04291"></a><span class="lineno"> 4291</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04292"></a><span class="lineno"> 4292</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> equal(<span class="keywordtype">float</span> *a, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *b)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04293"></a><span class="lineno"> 4293</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04294"></a><span class="lineno"> 4294</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> (a[0] == b[0] &amp;&amp; a[1] == b[1]);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04295"></a><span class="lineno"> 4295</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04296"></a><span class="lineno"> 4296</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04297"></a><span class="lineno"> 4297</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt__compute_crossings_x(<span class="keywordtype">float</span> x, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> nverts, <a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a> *verts)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04298"></a><span class="lineno"> 4298</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04299"></a><span class="lineno"> 4299</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04300"></a><span class="lineno"> 4300</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> orig[2], ray[2] = { 1, 0 };</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04301"></a><span class="lineno"> 4301</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y_frac;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04302"></a><span class="lineno"> 4302</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> winding = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04303"></a><span class="lineno"> 4303</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04304"></a><span class="lineno"> 4304</span>&#160;   orig[0] = x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04305"></a><span class="lineno"> 4305</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">//orig[1] = y; // [DEAR IMGUI] commmented double assignment</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04306"></a><span class="lineno"> 4306</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04307"></a><span class="lineno"> 4307</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// make sure y never passes through a vertex of the shape</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04308"></a><span class="lineno"> 4308</span>&#160;   y_frac = (float) STBTT_fmod(y, 1.0f);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04309"></a><span class="lineno"> 4309</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y_frac &lt; 0.01f)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04310"></a><span class="lineno"> 4310</span>&#160;      y += 0.01f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04311"></a><span class="lineno"> 4311</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y_frac &gt; 0.99f)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04312"></a><span class="lineno"> 4312</span>&#160;      y -= 0.01f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04313"></a><span class="lineno"> 4313</span>&#160;   orig[1] = y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04314"></a><span class="lineno"> 4314</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04315"></a><span class="lineno"> 4315</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// test a ray from (-infinity,y) to (x,y)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04316"></a><span class="lineno"> 4316</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; nverts; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04317"></a><span class="lineno"> 4317</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (verts[i].type == STBTT_vline) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04318"></a><span class="lineno"> 4318</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x0 = (int) verts[i-1].x, y0 = (<span class="keywordtype">int</span>) verts[i-1].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04319"></a><span class="lineno"> 4319</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x1 = (int) verts[i  ].x, y1 = (<span class="keywordtype">int</span>) verts[i  ].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04320"></a><span class="lineno"> 4320</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y &gt; STBTT_min(y0,y1) &amp;&amp; y &lt; STBTT_max(y0,y1) &amp;&amp; x &gt; STBTT_min(x0,x1)) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04321"></a><span class="lineno"> 4321</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x_inter = (y - y0) / (y1 - y0) * (x1-x0) + x0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04322"></a><span class="lineno"> 4322</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x_inter &lt; x)  </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04323"></a><span class="lineno"> 4323</span>&#160;               winding += (y0 &lt; y1) ? 1 : -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04324"></a><span class="lineno"> 4324</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04325"></a><span class="lineno"> 4325</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04326"></a><span class="lineno"> 4326</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (verts[i].type == STBTT_vcurve) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04327"></a><span class="lineno"> 4327</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x0 = (int) verts[i-1].x , y0 = (<span class="keywordtype">int</span>) verts[i-1].y ;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04328"></a><span class="lineno"> 4328</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x1 = (int) verts[i  ].cx, y1 = (<span class="keywordtype">int</span>) verts[i  ].cy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04329"></a><span class="lineno"> 4329</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x2 = (int) verts[i  ].x , y2 = (<span class="keywordtype">int</span>) verts[i  ].y ;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04330"></a><span class="lineno"> 4330</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> ax = STBTT_min(x0,STBTT_min(x1,x2)), ay = STBTT_min(y0,STBTT_min(y1,y2));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04331"></a><span class="lineno"> 4331</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordtype">int</span> by = STBTT_max(y0,STBTT_max(y1,y2));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04332"></a><span class="lineno"> 4332</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y &gt; ay &amp;&amp; y &lt; by &amp;&amp; x &gt; ax) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04333"></a><span class="lineno"> 4333</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q0[2],q1[2],q2[2];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04334"></a><span class="lineno"> 4334</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> hits[2][2];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04335"></a><span class="lineno"> 4335</span>&#160;            q0[0] = (float)x0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04336"></a><span class="lineno"> 4336</span>&#160;            q0[1] = (float)y0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04337"></a><span class="lineno"> 4337</span>&#160;            q1[0] = (float)x1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04338"></a><span class="lineno"> 4338</span>&#160;            q1[1] = (float)y1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04339"></a><span class="lineno"> 4339</span>&#160;            q2[0] = (float)x2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04340"></a><span class="lineno"> 4340</span>&#160;            q2[1] = (float)y2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04341"></a><span class="lineno"> 4341</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (equal(q0,q1) || equal(q1,q2)) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04342"></a><span class="lineno"> 4342</span>&#160;               x0 = (int)verts[i-1].x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04343"></a><span class="lineno"> 4343</span>&#160;               y0 = (int)verts[i-1].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04344"></a><span class="lineno"> 4344</span>&#160;               x1 = (int)verts[i  ].x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04345"></a><span class="lineno"> 4345</span>&#160;               y1 = (int)verts[i  ].y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04346"></a><span class="lineno"> 4346</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (y &gt; STBTT_min(y0,y1) &amp;&amp; y &lt; STBTT_max(y0,y1) &amp;&amp; x &gt; STBTT_min(x0,x1)) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04347"></a><span class="lineno"> 4347</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x_inter = (y - y0) / (y1 - y0) * (x1-x0) + x0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04348"></a><span class="lineno"> 4348</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x_inter &lt; x)  </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04349"></a><span class="lineno"> 4349</span>&#160;                     winding += (y0 &lt; y1) ? 1 : -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04350"></a><span class="lineno"> 4350</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04351"></a><span class="lineno"> 4351</span>&#160;            } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04352"></a><span class="lineno"> 4352</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_hits = stbtt__ray_intersect_bezier(orig, ray, q0, q1, q2, hits);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04353"></a><span class="lineno"> 4353</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (num_hits &gt;= 1)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04354"></a><span class="lineno"> 4354</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (hits[0][0] &lt; 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04355"></a><span class="lineno"> 4355</span>&#160;                     winding += (hits[0][1] &lt; 0 ? -1 : 1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04356"></a><span class="lineno"> 4356</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (num_hits &gt;= 2)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04357"></a><span class="lineno"> 4357</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (hits[1][0] &lt; 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04358"></a><span class="lineno"> 4358</span>&#160;                     winding += (hits[1][1] &lt; 0 ? -1 : 1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04359"></a><span class="lineno"> 4359</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04360"></a><span class="lineno"> 4360</span>&#160;         } </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04361"></a><span class="lineno"> 4361</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04362"></a><span class="lineno"> 4362</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04363"></a><span class="lineno"> 4363</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> winding;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04364"></a><span class="lineno"> 4364</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04365"></a><span class="lineno"> 4365</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04366"></a><span class="lineno"> 4366</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">float</span> stbtt__cuberoot( <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x )</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04367"></a><span class="lineno"> 4367</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04368"></a><span class="lineno"> 4368</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (x&lt;0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04369"></a><span class="lineno"> 4369</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -(float) STBTT_pow(-x,1.0f/3.0f);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04370"></a><span class="lineno"> 4370</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04371"></a><span class="lineno"> 4371</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span>  (<span class="keywordtype">float</span>) STBTT_pow( x,1.0f/3.0f);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04372"></a><span class="lineno"> 4372</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04373"></a><span class="lineno"> 4373</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04374"></a><span class="lineno"> 4374</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// x^3 + c*x^2 + b*x + a = 0</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04375"></a><span class="lineno"> 4375</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt__solve_cubic(<span class="keywordtype">float</span> a, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> b, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> c, <span class="keywordtype">float</span>* r)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04376"></a><span class="lineno"> 4376</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04377"></a><span class="lineno"> 4377</span>&#160;    <span class="keywordtype">float</span> s = -a / 3;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04378"></a><span class="lineno"> 4378</span>&#160;    <span class="keywordtype">float</span> p = b - a*a / 3;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04379"></a><span class="lineno"> 4379</span>&#160;    <span class="keywordtype">float</span> q = a * (2*a*a - 9*b) / 27 + c;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04380"></a><span class="lineno"> 4380</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> p3 = p*p*p;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04381"></a><span class="lineno"> 4381</span>&#160;    <span class="keywordtype">float</span> d = q*q + 4*p3 / 27;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04382"></a><span class="lineno"> 4382</span>&#160;    <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (d &gt;= 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04383"></a><span class="lineno"> 4383</span>&#160;        <span class="keywordtype">float</span> z = (float) STBTT_sqrt(d);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04384"></a><span class="lineno"> 4384</span>&#160;        <span class="keywordtype">float</span> u = (-q + z) / 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04385"></a><span class="lineno"> 4385</span>&#160;        <span class="keywordtype">float</span> v = (-q - z) / 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04386"></a><span class="lineno"> 4386</span>&#160;        u = stbtt__cuberoot(u);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04387"></a><span class="lineno"> 4387</span>&#160;        v = stbtt__cuberoot(v);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04388"></a><span class="lineno"> 4388</span>&#160;        r[0] = s + u + v;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04389"></a><span class="lineno"> 4389</span>&#160;        <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04390"></a><span class="lineno"> 4390</span>&#160;    } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04391"></a><span class="lineno"> 4391</span>&#160;       <span class="keywordtype">float</span> u = (float) STBTT_sqrt(-p/3);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04392"></a><span class="lineno"> 4392</span>&#160;       <span class="keywordtype">float</span> v = (float) STBTT_acos(-STBTT_sqrt(-27/p3) * q / 2) / 3; <span class="comment">// p3 must be negative, since d is negative</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04393"></a><span class="lineno"> 4393</span>&#160;       <span class="keywordtype">float</span> m = (float) STBTT_cos(v);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04394"></a><span class="lineno"> 4394</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> n = (float) STBTT_cos(v-3.141592/2)*1.732050808f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04395"></a><span class="lineno"> 4395</span>&#160;       r[0] = s + u * 2 * m;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04396"></a><span class="lineno"> 4396</span>&#160;       r[1] = s - u * (m + n);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04397"></a><span class="lineno"> 4397</span>&#160;       r[2] = s - u * (m - n);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04398"></a><span class="lineno"> 4398</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04399"></a><span class="lineno"> 4399</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">//STBTT_assert( STBTT_fabs(((r[0]+a)*r[0]+b)*r[0]+c) &lt; 0.05f);  // these asserts may not be safe at all scales, though they&#39;re in bezier t parameter units so maybe?</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04400"></a><span class="lineno"> 4400</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">//STBTT_assert( STBTT_fabs(((r[1]+a)*r[1]+b)*r[1]+c) &lt; 0.05f);</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04401"></a><span class="lineno"> 4401</span>&#160;      <span class="comment">//STBTT_assert( STBTT_fabs(((r[2]+a)*r[2]+b)*r[2]+c) &lt; 0.05f);</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04402"></a><span class="lineno"> 4402</span>&#160;    <span class="keywordflow">return</span> 3;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04403"></a><span class="lineno"> 4403</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04404"></a><span class="lineno"> 4404</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04405"></a><span class="lineno"> 4405</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04406"></a><span class="lineno"> 4406</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> * stbtt_GetGlyphSDF(<span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> *info, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> glyph, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> padding, <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> onedge_value, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> pixel_dist_scale, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *width, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *height, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *xoff, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *yoff)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04407"></a><span class="lineno"> 4407</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04408"></a><span class="lineno"> 4408</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale_x = scale, scale_y = scale;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04409"></a><span class="lineno"> 4409</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> ix0,iy0,ix1,iy1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04410"></a><span class="lineno"> 4410</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">int</span> w,h;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04411"></a><span class="lineno"> 4411</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *data;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04412"></a><span class="lineno"> 4412</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04413"></a><span class="lineno"> 4413</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// if one scale is 0, use same scale for both</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04414"></a><span class="lineno"> 4414</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (scale_x == 0) scale_x = scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04415"></a><span class="lineno"> 4415</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (scale_y == 0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04416"></a><span class="lineno"> 4416</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (scale_x == 0) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> NULL;  <span class="comment">// if both scales are 0, return NULL</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04417"></a><span class="lineno"> 4417</span>&#160;      scale_y = scale_x;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04418"></a><span class="lineno"> 4418</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04419"></a><span class="lineno"> 4419</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04420"></a><span class="lineno"> 4420</span>&#160;   stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBoxSubpixel(info, glyph, scale, scale, 0.0f,0.0f, &amp;ix0,&amp;iy0,&amp;ix1,&amp;iy1);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04421"></a><span class="lineno"> 4421</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04422"></a><span class="lineno"> 4422</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// if empty, return NULL</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04423"></a><span class="lineno"> 4423</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (ix0 == ix1 || iy0 == iy1)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04424"></a><span class="lineno"> 4424</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">return</span> NULL;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04425"></a><span class="lineno"> 4425</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04426"></a><span class="lineno"> 4426</span>&#160;   ix0 -= padding;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04427"></a><span class="lineno"> 4427</span>&#160;   iy0 -= padding;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04428"></a><span class="lineno"> 4428</span>&#160;   ix1 += padding;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04429"></a><span class="lineno"> 4429</span>&#160;   iy1 += padding;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04430"></a><span class="lineno"> 4430</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04431"></a><span class="lineno"> 4431</span>&#160;   w = (ix1 - ix0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04432"></a><span class="lineno"> 4432</span>&#160;   h = (iy1 - iy0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04433"></a><span class="lineno"> 4433</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04434"></a><span class="lineno"> 4434</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (width ) *width  = w;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04435"></a><span class="lineno"> 4435</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (height) *height = h;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04436"></a><span class="lineno"> 4436</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (xoff  ) *xoff   = ix0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04437"></a><span class="lineno"> 4437</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (yoff  ) *yoff   = iy0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04438"></a><span class="lineno"> 4438</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04439"></a><span class="lineno"> 4439</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// invert for y-downwards bitmaps</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04440"></a><span class="lineno"> 4440</span>&#160;   scale_y = -scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04441"></a><span class="lineno"> 4441</span>&#160;      </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04442"></a><span class="lineno"> 4442</span>&#160;   {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04443"></a><span class="lineno"> 4443</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">int</span> x,y,i,j;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04444"></a><span class="lineno"> 4444</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">float</span> *precompute;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04445"></a><span class="lineno"> 4445</span>&#160;      <a class="code" href="structstbtt__vertex.html">stbtt_vertex</a> *verts;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04446"></a><span class="lineno"> 4446</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num_verts = stbtt_GetGlyphShape(info, glyph, &amp;verts);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04447"></a><span class="lineno"> 4447</span>&#160;      data = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *) STBTT_malloc(w * h, info-&gt;userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04448"></a><span class="lineno"> 4448</span>&#160;      precompute = (<span class="keywordtype">float</span> *) STBTT_malloc(num_verts * <span class="keyword">sizeof</span>(<span class="keywordtype">float</span>), info-&gt;userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04449"></a><span class="lineno"> 4449</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04450"></a><span class="lineno"> 4450</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0,j=num_verts-1; i &lt; num_verts; j=i++) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04451"></a><span class="lineno"> 4451</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (verts[i].type == STBTT_vline) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04452"></a><span class="lineno"> 4452</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x0 = verts[i].x*scale_x, y0 = verts[i].y*scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04453"></a><span class="lineno"> 4453</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x1 = verts[j].x*scale_x, y1 = verts[j].y*scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04454"></a><span class="lineno"> 4454</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt((x1-x0)*(x1-x0) + (y1-y0)*(y1-y0));</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04455"></a><span class="lineno"> 4455</span>&#160;            precompute[i] = (dist == 0) ? 0.0f : 1.0f / dist;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04456"></a><span class="lineno"> 4456</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (verts[i].type == STBTT_vcurve) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04457"></a><span class="lineno"> 4457</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x2 = verts[j].x *scale_x, y2 = verts[j].y *scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04458"></a><span class="lineno"> 4458</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x1 = verts[i].cx*scale_x, y1 = verts[i].cy*scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04459"></a><span class="lineno"> 4459</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x0 = verts[i].x *scale_x, y0 = verts[i].y *scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04460"></a><span class="lineno"> 4460</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> bx = x0 - 2*x1 + x2, by = y0 - 2*y1 + y2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04461"></a><span class="lineno"> 4461</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> len2 = bx*bx + by*by;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04462"></a><span class="lineno"> 4462</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (len2 != 0.0f)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04463"></a><span class="lineno"> 4463</span>&#160;               precompute[i] = 1.0f / (bx*bx + by*by);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04464"></a><span class="lineno"> 4464</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04465"></a><span class="lineno"> 4465</span>&#160;               precompute[i] = 0.0f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04466"></a><span class="lineno"> 4466</span>&#160;         } <span class="keywordflow">else</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04467"></a><span class="lineno"> 4467</span>&#160;            precompute[i] = 0.0f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04468"></a><span class="lineno"> 4468</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04469"></a><span class="lineno"> 4469</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04470"></a><span class="lineno"> 4470</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (y=iy0; y &lt; iy1; ++y) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04471"></a><span class="lineno"> 4471</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (x=ix0; x &lt; ix1; ++x) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04472"></a><span class="lineno"> 4472</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> val;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04473"></a><span class="lineno"> 4473</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> min_dist = 999999.0f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04474"></a><span class="lineno"> 4474</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> sx = (float) x + 0.5f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04475"></a><span class="lineno"> 4475</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> sy = (float) y + 0.5f;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04476"></a><span class="lineno"> 4476</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x_gspace = (sx / scale_x);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04477"></a><span class="lineno"> 4477</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">float</span> y_gspace = (sy / scale_y);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04478"></a><span class="lineno"> 4478</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04479"></a><span class="lineno"> 4479</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordtype">int</span> winding = stbtt__compute_crossings_x(x_gspace, y_gspace, num_verts, verts); <span class="comment">// @OPTIMIZE: this could just be a rasterization, but needs to be line vs. non-tesselated curves so a new path</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04480"></a><span class="lineno"> 4480</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04481"></a><span class="lineno"> 4481</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">for</span> (i=0; i &lt; num_verts; ++i) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04482"></a><span class="lineno"> 4482</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x0 = verts[i].x*scale_x, y0 = verts[i].y*scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04483"></a><span class="lineno"> 4483</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04484"></a><span class="lineno"> 4484</span>&#160;               <span class="comment">// check against every point here rather than inside line/curve primitives -- @TODO: wrong if multiple &#39;moves&#39; in a row produce a garbage point, and given culling, probably more efficient to do within line/curve</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04485"></a><span class="lineno"> 4485</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dist2 = (x0-sx)*(x0-sx) + (y0-sy)*(y0-sy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04486"></a><span class="lineno"> 4486</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (dist2 &lt; min_dist*min_dist)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04487"></a><span class="lineno"> 4487</span>&#160;                  min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04488"></a><span class="lineno"> 4488</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04489"></a><span class="lineno"> 4489</span>&#160;               <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (verts[i].type == STBTT_vline) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04490"></a><span class="lineno"> 4490</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x1 = verts[i-1].x*scale_x, y1 = verts[i-1].y*scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04491"></a><span class="lineno"> 4491</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04492"></a><span class="lineno"> 4492</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">// coarse culling against bbox</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04493"></a><span class="lineno"> 4493</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">//if (sx &gt; STBTT_min(x0,x1)-min_dist &amp;&amp; sx &lt; STBTT_max(x0,x1)+min_dist &amp;&amp;</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04494"></a><span class="lineno"> 4494</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">//    sy &gt; STBTT_min(y0,y1)-min_dist &amp;&amp; sy &lt; STBTT_max(y0,y1)+min_dist)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04495"></a><span class="lineno"> 4495</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dist = (float) STBTT_fabs((x1-x0)*(y0-sy) - (y1-y0)*(x0-sx)) * precompute[i];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04496"></a><span class="lineno"> 4496</span>&#160;                  STBTT_assert(i != 0);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04497"></a><span class="lineno"> 4497</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (dist &lt; min_dist) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04498"></a><span class="lineno"> 4498</span>&#160;                     <span class="comment">// check position along line</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04499"></a><span class="lineno"> 4499</span>&#160;                     <span class="comment">// x&#39; = x0 + t*(x1-x0), y&#39; = y0 + t*(y1-y0)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04500"></a><span class="lineno"> 4500</span>&#160;                     <span class="comment">// minimize (x&#39;-sx)*(x&#39;-sx)+(y&#39;-sy)*(y&#39;-sy)</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04501"></a><span class="lineno"> 4501</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordtype">float</span> dx = x1-x0, dy = y1-y0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04502"></a><span class="lineno"> 4502</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordtype">float</span> px = x0-sx, py = y0-sy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04503"></a><span class="lineno"> 4503</span>&#160;                     <span class="comment">// minimize (px+t*dx)^2 + (py+t*dy)^2 = px*px + 2*px*dx*t + t^2*dx*dx + py*py + 2*py*dy*t + t^2*dy*dy</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04504"></a><span class="lineno"> 4504</span>&#160;                     <span class="comment">// derivative: 2*px*dx + 2*py*dy + (2*dx*dx+2*dy*dy)*t, set to 0 and solve</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04505"></a><span class="lineno"> 4505</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordtype">float</span> t = -(px*dx + py*dy) / (dx*dx + dy*dy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04506"></a><span class="lineno"> 4506</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (t &gt;= 0.0f &amp;&amp; t &lt;= 1.0f)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04507"></a><span class="lineno"> 4507</span>&#160;                        min_dist = dist;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04508"></a><span class="lineno"> 4508</span>&#160;                  }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04509"></a><span class="lineno"> 4509</span>&#160;               } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (verts[i].type == STBTT_vcurve) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04510"></a><span class="lineno"> 4510</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x2 = verts[i-1].x *scale_x, y2 = verts[i-1].y *scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04511"></a><span class="lineno"> 4511</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> x1 = verts[i  ].cx*scale_x, y1 = verts[i  ].cy*scale_y;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04512"></a><span class="lineno"> 4512</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> box_x0 = STBTT_min(STBTT_min(x0,x1),x2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04513"></a><span class="lineno"> 4513</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> box_y0 = STBTT_min(STBTT_min(y0,y1),y2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04514"></a><span class="lineno"> 4514</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> box_x1 = STBTT_max(STBTT_max(x0,x1),x2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04515"></a><span class="lineno"> 4515</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordtype">float</span> box_y1 = STBTT_max(STBTT_max(y0,y1),y2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04516"></a><span class="lineno"> 4516</span>&#160;                  <span class="comment">// coarse culling against bbox to avoid computing cubic unnecessarily</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04517"></a><span class="lineno"> 4517</span>&#160;                  <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (sx &gt; box_x0-min_dist &amp;&amp; sx &lt; box_x1+min_dist &amp;&amp; sy &gt; box_y0-min_dist &amp;&amp; sy &lt; box_y1+min_dist) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04518"></a><span class="lineno"> 4518</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordtype">int</span> num=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04519"></a><span class="lineno"> 4519</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordtype">float</span> ax = x1-x0, ay = y1-y0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04520"></a><span class="lineno"> 4520</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordtype">float</span> bx = x0 - 2*x1 + x2, by = y0 - 2*y1 + y2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04521"></a><span class="lineno"> 4521</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordtype">float</span> mx = x0 - sx, my = y0 - sy;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04522"></a><span class="lineno"> 4522</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordtype">float</span> res[3],px,py,t,it;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04523"></a><span class="lineno"> 4523</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordtype">float</span> a_inv = precompute[i];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04524"></a><span class="lineno"> 4524</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (a_inv == 0.0) { <span class="comment">// if a_inv is 0, it&#39;s 2nd degree so use quadratic formula</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04525"></a><span class="lineno"> 4525</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordtype">float</span> a = 3*(ax*bx + ay*by);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04526"></a><span class="lineno"> 4526</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordtype">float</span> b = 2*(ax*ax + ay*ay) + (mx*bx+my*by);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04527"></a><span class="lineno"> 4527</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordtype">float</span> c = mx*ax+my*ay;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04528"></a><span class="lineno"> 4528</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (a == 0.0) { <span class="comment">// if a is 0, it&#39;s linear</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04529"></a><span class="lineno"> 4529</span>&#160;                           <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (b != 0.0) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04530"></a><span class="lineno"> 4530</span>&#160;                              res[num++] = -c/b;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04531"></a><span class="lineno"> 4531</span>&#160;                           }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04532"></a><span class="lineno"> 4532</span>&#160;                        } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04533"></a><span class="lineno"> 4533</span>&#160;                           <span class="keywordtype">float</span> discriminant = b*b - 4*a*c;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04534"></a><span class="lineno"> 4534</span>&#160;                           <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (discriminant &lt; 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04535"></a><span class="lineno"> 4535</span>&#160;                              num = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04536"></a><span class="lineno"> 4536</span>&#160;                           <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04537"></a><span class="lineno"> 4537</span>&#160;                              <span class="keywordtype">float</span> root = (float) STBTT_sqrt(discriminant);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04538"></a><span class="lineno"> 4538</span>&#160;                              res[0] = (-b - root)/(2*a);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04539"></a><span class="lineno"> 4539</span>&#160;                              res[1] = (-b + root)/(2*a);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04540"></a><span class="lineno"> 4540</span>&#160;                              num = 2; <span class="comment">// don&#39;t bother distinguishing 1-solution case, as code below will still work</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04541"></a><span class="lineno"> 4541</span>&#160;                           }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04542"></a><span class="lineno"> 4542</span>&#160;                        }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04543"></a><span class="lineno"> 4543</span>&#160;                     } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04544"></a><span class="lineno"> 4544</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordtype">float</span> b = 3*(ax*bx + ay*by) * a_inv; <span class="comment">// could precompute this as it doesn&#39;t depend on sample point</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04545"></a><span class="lineno"> 4545</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordtype">float</span> c = (2*(ax*ax + ay*ay) + (mx*bx+my*by)) * a_inv;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04546"></a><span class="lineno"> 4546</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordtype">float</span> d = (mx*ax+my*ay) * a_inv;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04547"></a><span class="lineno"> 4547</span>&#160;                        num = stbtt__solve_cubic(b, c, d, res);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04548"></a><span class="lineno"> 4548</span>&#160;                     }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04549"></a><span class="lineno"> 4549</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (num &gt;= 1 &amp;&amp; res[0] &gt;= 0.0f &amp;&amp; res[0] &lt;= 1.0f) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04550"></a><span class="lineno"> 4550</span>&#160;                        t = res[0], it = 1.0f - t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04551"></a><span class="lineno"> 4551</span>&#160;                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04552"></a><span class="lineno"> 4552</span>&#160;                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04553"></a><span class="lineno"> 4553</span>&#160;                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04554"></a><span class="lineno"> 4554</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (dist2 &lt; min_dist * min_dist)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04555"></a><span class="lineno"> 4555</span>&#160;                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04556"></a><span class="lineno"> 4556</span>&#160;                     }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04557"></a><span class="lineno"> 4557</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (num &gt;= 2 &amp;&amp; res[1] &gt;= 0.0f &amp;&amp; res[1] &lt;= 1.0f) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04558"></a><span class="lineno"> 4558</span>&#160;                        t = res[1], it = 1.0f - t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04559"></a><span class="lineno"> 4559</span>&#160;                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04560"></a><span class="lineno"> 4560</span>&#160;                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04561"></a><span class="lineno"> 4561</span>&#160;                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04562"></a><span class="lineno"> 4562</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (dist2 &lt; min_dist * min_dist)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04563"></a><span class="lineno"> 4563</span>&#160;                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04564"></a><span class="lineno"> 4564</span>&#160;                     }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04565"></a><span class="lineno"> 4565</span>&#160;                     <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (num &gt;= 3 &amp;&amp; res[2] &gt;= 0.0f &amp;&amp; res[2] &lt;= 1.0f) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04566"></a><span class="lineno"> 4566</span>&#160;                        t = res[2], it = 1.0f - t;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04567"></a><span class="lineno"> 4567</span>&#160;                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04568"></a><span class="lineno"> 4568</span>&#160;                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04569"></a><span class="lineno"> 4569</span>&#160;                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04570"></a><span class="lineno"> 4570</span>&#160;                        <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (dist2 &lt; min_dist * min_dist)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04571"></a><span class="lineno"> 4571</span>&#160;                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04572"></a><span class="lineno"> 4572</span>&#160;                     }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04573"></a><span class="lineno"> 4573</span>&#160;                  }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04574"></a><span class="lineno"> 4574</span>&#160;               }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04575"></a><span class="lineno"> 4575</span>&#160;            }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04576"></a><span class="lineno"> 4576</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (winding == 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04577"></a><span class="lineno"> 4577</span>&#160;               min_dist = -min_dist;  <span class="comment">// if outside the shape, value is negative</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04578"></a><span class="lineno"> 4578</span>&#160;            val = onedge_value + pixel_dist_scale * min_dist;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04579"></a><span class="lineno"> 4579</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (val &lt; 0)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04580"></a><span class="lineno"> 4580</span>&#160;               val = 0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04581"></a><span class="lineno"> 4581</span>&#160;            <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (val &gt; 255)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04582"></a><span class="lineno"> 4582</span>&#160;               val = 255;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04583"></a><span class="lineno"> 4583</span>&#160;            data[(y-iy0)*w+(x-ix0)] = (<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> char) val;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04584"></a><span class="lineno"> 4584</span>&#160;         }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04585"></a><span class="lineno"> 4585</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04586"></a><span class="lineno"> 4586</span>&#160;      STBTT_free(precompute, info-&gt;userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04587"></a><span class="lineno"> 4587</span>&#160;      STBTT_free(verts, info-&gt;userdata);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04588"></a><span class="lineno"> 4588</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04589"></a><span class="lineno"> 4589</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> data;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04590"></a><span class="lineno"> 4590</span>&#160;}   </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04591"></a><span class="lineno"> 4591</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04592"></a><span class="lineno"> 4592</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> * stbtt_GetCodepointSDF(<span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> *info, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> scale, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> codepoint, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> padding, <span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> onedge_value, <span class="keywordtype">float</span> pixel_dist_scale, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *width, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *height, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *xoff, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *yoff)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04593"></a><span class="lineno"> 4593</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04594"></a><span class="lineno"> 4594</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> stbtt_GetGlyphSDF(info, scale, stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(info, codepoint), padding, onedge_value, pixel_dist_scale, width, height, xoff, yoff);</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04597"></a><span class="lineno"> 4597</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keywordtype">void</span> stbtt_FreeSDF(<span class="keywordtype">unsigned</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *bitmap, <span class="keywordtype">void</span> *userdata)</div>

<div class="line"><a name="l04603"></a><span class="lineno"> 4603</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04604"></a><span class="lineno"> 4604</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// font name matching -- recommended not to use this</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04605"></a><span class="lineno"> 4605</span>&#160;<span class="comment">//</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04606"></a><span class="lineno"> 4606</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04607"></a><span class="lineno"> 4607</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// check if a utf8 string contains a prefix which is the utf16 string; if so return length of matching utf8 string</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04608"></a><span class="lineno"> 4608</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> stbtt_int32 stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix(stbtt_uint8 *s1, stbtt_int32 len1, stbtt_uint8 *s2, stbtt_int32 len2) </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04609"></a><span class="lineno"> 4609</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04610"></a><span class="lineno"> 4610</span>&#160;   stbtt_int32 i=0;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04611"></a><span class="lineno"> 4611</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04612"></a><span class="lineno"> 4612</span>&#160;   <span class="comment">// convert utf16 to utf8 and compare the results while converting</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04613"></a><span class="lineno"> 4613</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">while</span> (len2) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04614"></a><span class="lineno"> 4614</span>&#160;      stbtt_uint16 ch = s2[0]*256 + s2[1];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04615"></a><span class="lineno"> 4615</span>&#160;      <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (ch &lt; 0x80) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04616"></a><span class="lineno"> 4616</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i &gt;= len1) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04617"></a><span class="lineno"> 4617</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != ch) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04618"></a><span class="lineno"> 4618</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (ch &lt; 0x800) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04619"></a><span class="lineno"> 4619</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i+1 &gt;= len1) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04620"></a><span class="lineno"> 4620</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != 0xc0 + (ch &gt;&gt; 6)) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04621"></a><span class="lineno"> 4621</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != 0x80 + (ch &amp; 0x3f)) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04622"></a><span class="lineno"> 4622</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (ch &gt;= 0xd800 &amp;&amp; ch &lt; 0xdc00) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04623"></a><span class="lineno"> 4623</span>&#160;         stbtt_uint32 c;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04624"></a><span class="lineno"> 4624</span>&#160;         stbtt_uint16 ch2 = s2[2]*256 + s2[3];</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04625"></a><span class="lineno"> 4625</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i+3 &gt;= len1) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04626"></a><span class="lineno"> 4626</span>&#160;         c = ((ch - 0xd800) &lt;&lt; 10) + (ch2 - 0xdc00) + 0x10000;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04627"></a><span class="lineno"> 4627</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != 0xf0 + (c &gt;&gt; 18)) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04628"></a><span class="lineno"> 4628</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c &gt;&gt; 12) &amp; 0x3f)) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04629"></a><span class="lineno"> 4629</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c &gt;&gt;  6) &amp; 0x3f)) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04630"></a><span class="lineno"> 4630</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c      ) &amp; 0x3f)) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04631"></a><span class="lineno"> 4631</span>&#160;         s2 += 2; <span class="comment">// plus another 2 below</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04632"></a><span class="lineno"> 4632</span>&#160;         len2 -= 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04633"></a><span class="lineno"> 4633</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (ch &gt;= 0xdc00 &amp;&amp; ch &lt; 0xe000) {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04634"></a><span class="lineno"> 4634</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04635"></a><span class="lineno"> 4635</span>&#160;      } <span class="keywordflow">else</span> {</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04636"></a><span class="lineno"> 4636</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (i+2 &gt;= len1) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04637"></a><span class="lineno"> 4637</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != 0xe0 + (ch &gt;&gt; 12)) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04638"></a><span class="lineno"> 4638</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch &gt;&gt; 6) &amp; 0x3f)) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04639"></a><span class="lineno"> 4639</span>&#160;         <span class="keywordflow">if</span> (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch     ) &amp; 0x3f)) <span class="keywordflow">return</span> -1;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04640"></a><span class="lineno"> 4640</span>&#160;      }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04641"></a><span class="lineno"> 4641</span>&#160;      s2 += 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04642"></a><span class="lineno"> 4642</span>&#160;      len2 -= 2;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04643"></a><span class="lineno"> 4643</span>&#160;   }</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04644"></a><span class="lineno"> 4644</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> i;</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04645"></a><span class="lineno"> 4645</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04646"></a><span class="lineno"> 4646</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04647"></a><span class="lineno"> 4647</span>&#160;<span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keywordtype">int</span> stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal(<span class="keywordtype">char</span> *s1, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> len1, <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *s2, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> len2) </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04648"></a><span class="lineno"> 4648</span>&#160;{</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04649"></a><span class="lineno"> 4649</span>&#160;   <span class="keywordflow">return</span> len1 == stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix((stbtt_uint8*) s1, len1, (stbtt_uint8*) s2, len2);</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04650"></a><span class="lineno"> 4650</span>&#160;}</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04651"></a><span class="lineno"> 4651</span>&#160; </div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04652"></a><span class="lineno"> 4652</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// returns results in whatever encoding you request... but note that 2-byte encodings</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04653"></a><span class="lineno"> 4653</span>&#160;<span class="comment">// will be BIG-ENDIAN... use stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian() to compare</span></div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04654"></a><span class="lineno"> 4654</span>&#160;STBTT_DEF <span class="keyword">const</span> <span class="keywordtype">char</span> *stbtt_GetFontNameString(<span class="keyword">const</span> <a class="code" href="structstbtt__fontinfo.html">stbtt_fontinfo</a> *font, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> *length, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> platformID, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> encodingID, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> languageID, <span class="keywordtype">int</span> nameID)</div>
<div class="line"><a name="l04655"></a><span class="lineno"> 4655</span>&#160;{</div>
```

```js
function initMenu(relPath,searchEnabled,serverSide,searchPage,search) {
  function makeTree(data,relPath) {
    var result='';
    if ('children' in data) {
      result+='<ul>';
      for (var i in data.children) {
        result+='<li><a href="'+relPath+data.children[i].url+'">'+
                                data.children[i].text+'</a>'+
                                makeTree(data.children[i],relPath)+'</li>';
      }
      result+='</ul>';
    }
    return result;
  }

  $('#main-nav').append(makeTree(menudata,relPath));
  $('#main-nav').children(':first').addClass('sm sm-dox').attr('id','main-menu');
  if (searchEnabled) {
    if (serverSide) {
      $('#main-menu').append('<li style="float:right"><div id="MSearchBox" class="MSearchBoxInactive"><div class="left"><form id="FSearchBox" action="'+relPath+searchPage+'" method="get"><img id="MSearchSelect" src="'+relPath+'search/mag.png" alt=""/><input type="text" id="MSearchField" name="query" value="'+search+'" size="20" accesskey="S" onfocus="searchBox.OnSearchFieldFocus(true)" onblur="searchBox.OnSearchFieldFocus(false)"></form></div><div class="right"></div></div></li>');
    } else {
      $('#main-menu').append('<li style="float:right"><div id="MSearchBox" class="MSearchBoxInactive"><span class="left"><img id="MSearchSelect" src="'+relPath+'search/mag_sel.png" onmouseover="return searchBox.OnSearchSelectShow()" onmouseout="return searchBox.OnSearchSelectHide()" alt=""/><input type="text" id="MSearchField" value="'+search+'" accesskey="S" onfocus="searchBox.OnSearchFieldFocus(true)" onblur="searchBox.OnSearchFieldFocus(false)" onkeyup="searchBox.OnSearchFieldChange(event)"/></span><span class="right"><a id="MSearchClose" href="javascript:searchBox.CloseResultsWindow()"><img id="MSearchCloseImg" border="0" src="'+relPath+'search/close.png" alt=""/></a></span></div></li>');
    }
  }
  $('#main-menu').smartmenus();
}
/* @license-end */

```
